meta.name: Nyimbo za Mulungu
meta.title_rule: title = first line of the hymn, trailing punctuation removed; the first line also stays in the lyrics

stanza_types.verse: numbered verse (number may be null for single-verse hymns)
stanza_types.chorus: refrain, typeset in italics and indented in the book

hymns.title: Ndinu wakuyera
hymns.text:
1. Ndinu wakuyera!
E, wamphamvu zonse.
Nthawi ya m’mamawayi
Tiimba nyimboyi.
Mlengi wachifundo,
Tikuyamikani,
E! Mlungu Mmodzi
Mwa Atatuwo.

2. Ndinu wakuyera!
Anthu ochuluka
Akuimbirani,
Nakupempheranibe;
Akumwamba omwe,
Nagwadira Inu,
Wachikhalire
Ndi wosafa ’yi.

3. Ndinu wakuyera!
Ife akuchimwa
Zaulemerero zanu
Sitiona ’yi;
Mwayeradi nokha,
Wina saoneka
Wangwiro m’mphamvu
Ndi m’kuyeramo.

4. Ndinu wakuyera!
Zakumwamba zonse
Ndi zapansi zitamabe
Dzina lanulo
Mlengi wachifundo.
Mphambi, Ambuyathu,
E! Mlungu Mmodzi,
Mwa Atatuwo.

hymns.title: Inu Mulungu, tikuyamikani
hymns.text:
1. Inu Mulungu, tikuyamikani;
Tibvomereza ndinu Ambuyathu;
Ponse, Atate, akugwadirani,
Ndinu wamuyaya!

2. Nanu akukuzani amithenga,
Nanu zam’mwamba ndi zamphamvu zake,
Nanu angelo a mitundu yonse
Akuimbirani!

3. “Mbuye Woyera! E, Woyera
nokha!
Mbuye Woyera! Mbuye wa makamu!
Ponse ulemu wanu ndi wodzaza
Pansi ndi Kumwamba.”

4. Nanu Atumwi akumveka aja,
Ndi Aneneri oyanjana omwe,
Ndi aunyinji anakuferani
Akuyamikani.

5. Mpingo woyera wa kwa anthu
onse
Ukumverani, Mfumu ndi Atate,
Mwana woona wa ulemu wonse,
Mzimu Nkhoswe yemwe.

6. Kristu Mfumuyo yaulemerero!
Mwana wosatha wa Atate ndinu!
Simunanyoza mimba ya
Namwali
Potipulumutsa.

7. Imfa mutagonjetsa ndi zowawa,
Njira munatsegula tikalowe
Momwe mukhala Inu ndi Atate
Mwaulemerero.

8. Kumva milandu yathu mudzabwera
Mutithandize, atumiki anu;
Mwatiwombola nawo mwazi wanu:
Mutipulumutse.

9. Mtiwerengere m’Mwamba ndi oyera;
Mutidalitse, ndife anthu anu;
Moyo wosatha mutipatse tonse,
Mutilamulire.

10. Tsiku ndi tsiku timalemekeza;
Nanu tikukuzani osaleka;
Mbuye, mtisunge tingachimwe lero:
Mtichitire nsisi.

11. Mbuye, chifundo chanu chitigwere
Monga tikhulupira Inu nokha;
Ndakhulupira zedi mwanu, Mbuye,
Ndisagome konse!

hymns.title: Atate wa Kumwambako
Lemekeza Mlungu ’Tate
hymns.text:
1. Lemekeza Mlungu ’Tate,
Lemekeza Mlungu Mwana,
Lemekeza Mlungu Mzimu,
Mlungu Mmodzi ndi wamkulu.
Lemekeza, lemekeza,
Mlungu wathu yemweyo.

2. Mlemekeze, anakonda
Natitsuka m’mtima mwathu;
Anatiombola ife
Tikakhale ndi chifumu.
Lemekeza, lemekeza,
Yesu Mbuye Nsembeyo.

3. Lemekeza Mfumu yathu,
Mfumu ya mipingo yonse,
Ipambana anthu onse
Akumwamba ndi apansi.
Lemekeza, lemekeza,
Mfumu ya mafumuyo.

hymns.title: Ndi Aleluya imbirani
hymns.text:
1. Ndi Aleluya imbirani
’Tate wathu, wakumwamba,
Analenga zonse.
Chifundo chake chachikulu,
Nzeru, mphamvu ndi ufumu
Tiyamike tonse.

2. Ndi Aleluya imbirani
Yesu Khristu Mpulumutsi,
Anachoka kwawo,
Nakhala munthu, pansi pano,
Nasauka, natifera,
Natisiyira mawu.

3. Ndi Aleluya imbirani
Mzimu wake Wakuyera,
Amakhala nafe.
Atilangiza za Mulungu,
Nayeretsanso mitima
Ya akhristu ife.

4. Mulungu wathu tiyamika,
’Tate, Mwana, Mzimu yemwe
Aleluya Inu.
Woyera Inu ndi wamphamvu,
Muyenera anthu onse
Agwadire Inu.

hymns.title: Mitambo inu yakumwambako
hymns.text:
1. Mitambo inu yakumwambako,
Yogunda mvula ’mlengalengamo
Mawu akulu muzinenadi:
Aleluya.

2. Paphiri paja papakulupo,
Pamwala ponse pakuwala mbuu!
Mubvomereze mawu omwewo:
Aleluya.

3. Mphepo yay’kulu yakuombayo,
Chisanu chija chozizirachi,
Ndi kabvumbulu muzinenadi:
Aleluya.

4. Mitengo yaitalitali ’nu
Yachiimire mumaimabe,
Mubvomereze ndi kunenabe:
Aleluya.

5. Zam’madzi zonse zakuopsyazo,
Nyanja, matiti ndi mitsinjeyo,
Chigumula chakulindimacho.
Aleluya.

6. Zamoyo zili m’thengo zonsezo,
Zodzuma, zina zobangulazo,
Zinene ndi kulira konseko:
Aleluya.

7. Inu mumvere anyamatawo,
Okondwerera kusewerako,
Mumtima mubvomere monsemo:
Aleluya.

8. Ndi anamwali obvekedwa mbuu!
Ndi ana osakula msinkhu ’nu,
Ana a Mlungu mubvomeretu:
Aleluya.

9. Akulu nonse ndi mafumu ’nu,
Magulu nonse apadzikopa,
Mulemekeze Mbuye yemweyo:
Aleluya.

10. Ndi amithenga akumwambako,
Ndi anthu ndi zamoyo zonsezo,
Bvomerezani mawu omwewo:
Aleluya.

hymns.title: Tamani Ambuye
hymns.text:
1. Tamani Ambuye,
Wamphamvu ndi Iye,
Akhala m’ulemu
Kumwamba komweko;
Chikopa cholimba
Ndi kothawiranso
Kwa anthu akewo,
Kotero ndi Mlungu.

2. Uzani zamphamvu,
Imbani chisomo,
Za Mwini ulemu,
Ambuye wathuyo;
Powomba chimphepo
Mvulanso ndi bingu
Padziko, pathambo,
Akhala ponsepo.

3. Zozizwa za m’dziko,
Za m’mwamba zonsezi.
Mulungu wamphamvu,
Munalenga zonse;
Muyendetsa mwezi
Nyenyezi ndi dzuwa;
Zolengedwa zonse
Zimvera Ambuye.

4. Sititha ifedi
Kukamba zokoma
Za Inu Mulungu
Wolera anthuwa;
Zifika ndi mphepo
Ndi mvula ndi dzuwa,
Zigwera ponsepo
Pa anthu onsewo.

5. Wamphamvu yosatha,
Chikondi changwiro,
Angelo akonda
Kutama Mulungu;
Ndiponso ifetu
Ananu tonsefe
Tiimba nyimboyi
Yotama Ambuye.

hymns.title: Tsopano linoli
hymns.text:
1. Tsopano linoli
Tiimbe nyimbo zathu;
Tiimbe nyimbozi,
Titame Mlungu wathu;
Masiku onsewo
Anatisungadi,
Anatipatsanso
Zabwino zonsezi.

2. Mulungu yemweyo
Akhale m’fupi mwathu;
Mtendere wakewo
Ukhale m’mtima mwathu;
Timtsate Iyedi
Ndi nsoni zakezo,
Panjira yakeyi
Masiku onsewo

3. Tilemekezetu
Atate Wakumwamba,
Ndi Yesu Mbuyathu,
Ndi Mzimu Wakuyera;
Mulungu Mmodziyu
Wanthawi zonsezo,
Timlemekezetu
Masiku onsewo.

hymns.title: Ndi mitima yokondwera
hymns.text:
1. Ndi mitima yokondwera
Mbuye wathu tiyamika.

E, chifundo chake chonse
Ndichosatha nthawi zonse.

2. Dzina lake tibukitsa,
Mlungu ndiye yekhayekha.

3. Mphamvu yake inalenga
Dziko lonse ndikumwamba.

4. Anatsogolera kale
M’chipululu anthu ake.

5. Ndi chifundo atipenya
Ife anthu osauka.

6. Amaweta nyama zonse,
Zingasowe kanthu konse.

7. Tiimbire Mlungu wathu
Waulemu ndi wamkulu

8. Tithawire kwa Mulungu,
Ndiko tikapeze moyo.

hymns.title: Nditamatu Ambuyangayu

lines: Akazi amasiye maka ndi anawo onsewo,

hymns.text:
1. Nditamatu Ambuyangayu,
Moyo wanga wonse ndidzamtamatu,
Ndiponso m’dziko lakumwambako;
Masiku anga onse ndidzamlemekeza Iye;
Sindidzaleka konsekonse m’mene ndili m’moyotu,
Padziko pano pena m’Mwambamo.

2. Ndiye wokondwa, E, munthuyo
Wokhulupirira Mlungu yekhadi,
Wolenga dziko, nyanja, zonsezi;
Choona chake chonse chingokhalatu chosatha;
Apulumutsa onse namadyetsa anthu akewo,
Wokonda ndiye Mbuye wathuyo.

3. Mlungu kuona athiratu
Inde m’maso awo osapenyawo.
Natuma akumvera mpumulo;
Amathandiza inde aulendo ofokatu,
Akazi amasiye maka ndi anawo onsewo,
Olira atonthoza mtimadi.

4. Nditamatu Ambuyangayu,
Moyo wanga wonse ndidzamtamatu
Ndiponso m’dziko lakumwamba;
Masiku anga onse ndidzamlemekeza Iye;
Sindidzaleka konsekonse m’mene ndili m’moyotu,
Padziko pano pena m’Mwambamo.

hymns.title: Paphiri ndi padambo
hymns.text:
1. Paphiri ndi padambo
Ponsepo pali Mlungu,
Poyenda ife m’njira
Poima pali Mlungu;
Kokwera maganizo,
Komweko kuli Mlungu,
Kumwamba ndi pansipo
Ponsepo pali Mlungu.

(Mulungu ali nane!)
(Ali nane, ali nane, ali nane,
ali nane, Aa!
Mulungu ali nane!)

2. Ndi maso Ambuyathu
Apenyetsetsa ife;
Amadalitsa onse
Okhulupirira Iye;
Amamva timbalame,
Namveka dziko lonse;
Sataya tizilombo,
Asunga zina zonse.

3. Okwawa pansi inu,
Oyenda m’madzi inu,
Oyesa dziko nkwanu,
Am’mlengalenga inu,
Nonsenu ntchito zake
Muona tsiku n’tsiku,
Saleka kusamala
Ndi kudalitsa inu.

4. Nditama mphamvu yake
Ya Mlungu yondizinga;
N’kafoka an’limbitsa,
N’kadwala andichiza.
Pakundisiya bwenzi
Mulungu ali paja;
N’kalowa imfa ine
Alipo Mlungu wanga.

hymns.title: Mtima wanga uyamike
hymns.text:
1. Mtima wanga uyamike
Mfumu Yakumwambako;
Anandiwombola ine
Nanditsuka m’mtimamo.

Ife tonse, ife tonse,
Tiyamike Mlunguyo.

2. Tiyamike Mlungu wathu
Kaamba ka chifundocho;
Nthawi zonse sasanduka
Mlungu wathu yemweyo.

3. Nthawi zonse monga ’Tate
Atisamaliratu,
Atisunga m’manja mwake,
Atipulumutsatu.

4. Anthu a mitundu yonse,
Ndipo a Kumwambako,
Yamikani Mlungu wathu,
Ndiye wakukomatu.

Anthu onse, anthu onse,
Yamikani Mlunguyo.

hymns.title: Yehova ndiye Mbusa wanga

lines: E, m’nyumba ya Yehova ndidzakhala chikhalire.

hymns.text:
1. Yehova ndiye Mbusa wanga,
sin’ngasowe konse;
Andigonetsa pali busa
la misipu yonse.

(Ndiye M’busa wanga,
Ndiye M’busa wanga!
Yehova ndiye Mbusa wanga,
Sin’ngasowe konse.)

2. Kumadzi kuli njiratu
andiyendetsa bwino,
Nalimbikitsa moyo wanga
ndi chifundo chino.

3. Pabande lolunjika
Andilondolera njira;
Chifukwacho cha dzina lake
Anandisungira.

4. Chigwa choopsacho cha imfa ndikachilowera,
Ndilibe mantha, muli ndine,
ndodo ndiigwira.

5. Pamaso pa adaniwo
mwayala gome langa;
E, mutu mwaudzoza,
chisefuka chikho changa.

6. Zabwino ndi zokoma
zinditsata chitsatire;
E, m’nyumba ya Yehova ndidzakhala chikhalire.

hymns.title: Mtima wanga lemekeza
hymns.text:
1. Mtima wanga lemekeza
Mlungu wako ndi chimwemwe.
Nthawi zonse ndimtamanda;
Ndimwimbira nyimbo zanga.
Moyo, mphamvu, nzeru zonse,
Zidzamlemekeza konse.

2. Ndi wamwayi munthu uja
Amthandiza Mbuye wake.
Akachita mantha iye
Amchotsera nkhawa yake,
Ndipo likamgwera tsoka
Amakhulupira kokha.

3. Mbuye ndiye wachifundo,
Achiritsa akudwala;
Anyamula akufoka
Nawadyetsatu anjala.
Wakusunga mlendo ndiye,
Nathandiza amasiye.

4. Ndiye Mbuye wa ambuye;
Mphamvu yake ndi yokwana,
Adzakhala chikhalire,
Mfumu yathu yopambana,
Aleluya! Kondwerani!
Mlungu wathu yamikani!

hymns.title: Mulungu ndiye Mbusa wanga

lines: Za m’mdima, imfa, nkhondo ndi zoipa sindiopa;
Ndi m’nyumba ya Mulungu ndidzakhala nsiku zonse.

hymns.text:
1. Mulungu ndiye Mbusa wanga,
sindisowa konse;
Amandiweta nandidyetsa;
nandipatsa zonse.

(Ndiye M’busa wanga,
Ndiye M’busa wanga!
Mulungu ndiye M’busa wanga,
Sindisowa konse.)

2. M’mitsinje yamtendere mtima
wanga aumwetsa;
Mapazi omwe m’njira
yolungama nandiyendetsa

3. Za m’mdima, imfa, nkhondo ndi zoipa sindiopa;
Ndikakhumudwa ndikutopa,
Andipulumutsa.

4. Podwala ine pobvutidwa
Andisamalira;
Pondisautsa adani anga nandithangatira.

5. Chisomo ndi zokoma zake
sizileka konse;
Ndi m’nyumba ya Mulungu ndidzakhala nsiku zonse.

hymns.title: Zobvuta zoopsa ndi zosaukazi
hymns.text:
1. Zobvuta zoopsa ndi zosaukazi
Sitingathe ife kuzithawa tokha.
Koma Ambuyathu timtamande Iye,
Uthenga Wabwino timveretu tokha.

2. Amadyetsa Iye mbalame zam’mwamba,
Timtamande ndithu potisunga ife;
Timvere malembo a m’kalata mwake,
Ambuye yemweyo atisungirabe.

3. Abramu kalelo anamvera bwino;
Timverenso ngatitu yemwe wakale.
Pokhala alendo atsogoza iwo,
Timkhulupirire Ambuye tonsefe.

4. Timtamande Iye ndi moyo wathunso
Pakutsatatsata malembedwe awo.
Tipezemo malo okwanira ife
Ambuye wathuyo atipatsa kwawo.

hymns.title: Pokondwa ndi poona bvuto
hymns.text:
1. Pokondwa ndi poona bvuto
Ndi tsoka pena mwayi,
Ndikumbukira, ndiimbira
Mulungu wangayo.

2. Kwezani nane Ambuyathu,
Timlemekeze yekha;
Popsinja mtima ndinamtchula,
Nandithangata ’ne.

3. Angelo amazinga nyumba
Za anthu olungama;
Mulungu ateteza omwe
Amkhulupirira.

4. Lawani chikondano chake;
Mudzadziwitsa msanga
Kudala kwawo kwa anake
Omkonda Mbuyeyo.

5. Opani Iye, nimuleke
Kuopa kanthu kena;
Mumtumikire mokondwera,
Akusungani ’nu.

6. Mulungu wathu Mmodzi yekha
Atate, Mwana, Mzimu,
Akhale ndi ulemerero
Wachikhalirewo!

hymns.title: Kuzani Mlungu m’Mwambamo
hymns.text:
1. Kuzani Mlungu m’Mwambamo,
Mtamande m’kuyanso;
Nzozizwa nkhani zakezo.
Njolimba ntchito njo!

2. Pochimwa anthu onsewo
Nja Mlungu nzeruyi;
Adamu wachiwiriyo
Wathetsa tchimoli.

3. Thupi lamwazi wathu’li
Lochimwa kalelo,
Labweranso ku nkhondoyi,
Laposa monsemo.

4. Choposa nalo thupilo,
Chikhale momwemu,
Chiyeretsetsa m’katimo,
Ndi Mulungu Iyeyu.

5. Anatikondakonda ’Ye,
Ndi Mlungu Iyeyo,
Anatifera anthu ’fe,
Ndi Munthu Iyenso.

6. Ndi m’munda muja chete, phee!
Pamtanda pati njo!
Anaphunzitsa ’bale ’fe
Titero ifenso.

7. Kuzani Mlungu m’Mwambamo,
Mtamande m’kuyanso;
Nzozizwa nkhani zakezo,
Njolimba ntchito njo!

hymns.title: Kalelo anthu onse
hymns.text:
1. Kalelo anthu onse
Nachimwa kwa Mulungu,
Mulungu anaona,
Naona tchimo lawo,

Nafuna kwaononga
Nafuna kwaononga

2. Mulungu anatuma,
Natuma Nowa uja,
Wamanga chombo chake,
Ndi chachitalitali,

Nowayo nayendamo,
Nowayo nayendamo.

3. Mulungu anatuma,
Natuma mvula ija,
Yadzaza dziko lonse,
Anafa anthu onse,

Anafa m’mvula muja
Anafa m’mvula muja.

4. Nowayo anatuma,
Natuma chikwangwala,
Chatsika pansi pansi,
Chosabwerera konse,

Chithawa m’talitali
Chithawa m’talitali.

5. Kutuma wabwereza,
Natuma nkhunda ija,
Yatsika pamadzipo,
Yathyolatu mayani,

Yampatsa Nowa yemwe,
Yampatsa Nowa yemwe.

6. Kalelo Mbuye Yesu
Nafera anthu onse,
Ndiyeyo chombo chathu,
Tikabisala mommo,

Tipulumuka mommo,
Tipulumuka mommo.

hymns.title: Mulungu awakonda anthu
hymns.text:
1. Mulungu awakonda anthu
Ali pansi pano;
Afuna kuwapulumutsa
Kumilandu yawo

A! chikondi chachikulu
Mulungu ali nacho,
Chinan’tengera Mpulumutsi,
Andifere pano.

2. Ndikhulupira mwa Ambuye
Mlungu namukitsa,
Imfayo indipulumutsa,
Mwazi undiyeretsa.

3. Chikondi chake chindidzera
M’mtima mwanga muno,
Chipulumutsa nditalema
Ndi machimo anga.

4. Mukondwe anthu a Mulungu,
Tere mulandira.
Chimwemwe chija chakumwamba
Chidzalowa m’mtima.

5. Mulungu atipatsa mphamvu
Yoletsetsa tchimo;
Pofika tsikulo la imfa.
Tidzakhala bwino.

hymns.title: Tiimbe nyimbo zotamanda
hymns.text:
1. Tiimbe nyimbo zotamanda
Mulungu wathu wabwino,
Pakuti akondana nawo
Anthu okhala padziko;
Tero natuma Mwana wake,
Wakukondedwa kalelo,
Kutiphunzitsa ife tonse
Za chikondano chakecho.

2. Mulungu ndiye wachifundo,
Nadzalandira onsewa
Akuulula mphulupulu
Ndi kukondana ndi Yesu,
Tilondelonde njira yake,
Yopapatiza yaing’ono;
Adzatilondolera ndiye
Kutifikitsa m’Mwambamo.

3. Pakuwoloka mtsinje wa imfa
Dzanja Mbuyathu agwira;
Tikadagwira ntchito zake
Atipatsatu korona;
Komwe kulibe masauko,
Pena misozi maliro;
Mulungu tidzamtamandira,
Inde kosalekezanso.

hymns.title: Ndikonda Mlungu pomva Mbuye wanga
hymns.text:
1. Ndikonda Mlungu pomva Mbuye wanga
Amva pemphero ndi kulira kwanga,
Namatchereza khutu nditapfuula,
Andithandiza, nandipulumutsa.

2. Mulungu wanga ndiye wachifundo
Ndiwolungama mtima ndi wabwino;
Apulumutsa anthu akufoka,
Akathandiza nkhawa imachoka.

3. Mtimanga, bwera kuti upumule,
Wakuchitiranso zokoma Mbuye,
Wakuchotsera imfa ndi misozi,
Ndingakhumudwe asungira phazi.

4. Nditani ine kubwezera Mbuye
Zokoma zonse anandichitira?
Chipulumutso chake ndidzatama,
Ndinalumbira zija ndidzapatsa.

5. Imfa ya anthu ake imkomera,
Awalandira m’nyumba zokonzeka,
Mbuye, kapolo wanu ndipereka
Nsembeyi yonga yanu, ndine ndekha.

hymns.title: Titame Mlungu Wakumwamba

lines: Tilape m’mtima kuti tikakhale ndi Mulungu.

hymns.text:
1. Titame Mlungu Wakumwamba,
Timwimbire nyimbo,
Kukoma kwake kwatipatsa
Zonse tili nazo.

(Timwimbire nyimbo,
Timwimbire nyimbo!
Kukoma kwake kwatipatsa
Zonse tili nazo.)

2. Poyamba paja analenga
Zonse m’dziko muno,
Tsopano lomwe azisunga
Zonse zili moyo.

3. Tinasokera ngati nkhosa,
Moyo tinataya,
Tinakondwera ndi zoipa
Zonse tinatsata.

4. Komweko titasaukira,
Titafuna kufa,
Atate anatilondola
Naitana ife.

5. Tiyeni tizipita kwathu,
Tisasokerenso,
Tilape m’mtima kuti tikakhale ndi Mulungu.

hymns.title: Oonadi mtima
hymns.text:
1. Oonadi mtima,
’Dzani mokondwera,
Tiyeni, tiyeni ku Betelehemu;
Modyera ng’ombe
Muli Mfumu yathu.

Tiyeni timgwadire
Kristuyo.

2. Mulungu wamkulu
Wakuyerayera
Kubadwa mwa mkazi sanakana ’yi;
Mwana wa ’Tate,
Sanalengedwadi.

3. Angelo kwezani
Nyimbo zanu zonse,
M’mwambamo mumveke zoyamikazo;
Lemekezani
Mlungu Wakumwamba.

4. M’dzikomo Ambuye
Mnabadwira ife,
Ulemu wosatha muyeneradi,
Mawu a ’Tate
Munalowa m’thupi.

hymns.title: Ndilikulemekeza

lines: Moyo ndi mtima wanga ndilikukondwa mwa Mulungu.

hymns.text:
1. Ndilikulemekeza
Ambuye Mpulumutsi wanga;
Moyo ndi mtima wanga ndilikukondwa mwa Mulungu.

2. Ndiye anayang’ana
umphawi wa mdzakazi wake;
Onse adzandiyesa
ine wodala nsiku zonse.

3. Ndiye wamphamvu zonse
andichitira zazikulu;
Dzina la Ambuyanga
lili loyera kopambana.

4. Ndiye amachitira
chifundo anthu a mibadwo,
E! a mibadwo yonse
yakumuopa ndi kumvera.

5. Iye amazichita
zamphamvu nawo mkono wake;
Iye nabalalitsa
omwe anyada nadzitama.

6. Iye natsitsa kunsi
mafumu ku mipando yawo,
Iye nakweza konko
omwe afatsa nasauka.

7. Iye amakhutitsa
anjala ndi zabwino zake,
Ndi olemera onse
nawaingitsa opanda kanthu.

8. Monga anapangana
ponena kwa makolo athu,
Ali kithandizadi
lero anake a Yakobo.

9. Poti akumbukira
atate wathu Abrahamu;
Inde chifundo chokha
akuchitira ana ake.

hymns.title: Amithenga a Mulungu
hymns.text:
1. Amithenga a Mulungu
Anaimba nyimbo yomwe,
Posonkhana m’mlengalenga,
Natitu usiku womwe;
“Onse azilemekeza
Mlungu Wakumwambamwamba;
Akhalebe ndi mtendere
Anthu ali ponseponse"

Amithenga anaimba
Ndi usiku m’mlengalenga.

2. Anamva abusa omwe
Anaweta nkhosa zawo,
Mthenga nati: "Musaope;
Mumve ndikufotokoza:
Wabadwa usiku uno
Yesu Kristu Ambuyathu
Ndiye Mpulumutsi wathu;
Anabadwa m’Betlehemu"

Amithenga anaimba
Ndi usiku m’mlengalenga.

3. Yesu ndinu Mbuye wathu,
Munasiya za Kumwamba!
Munakhala mwana kuno;
Mnatifera mwaufulu.
Inu nonse amithenga,
Inu mumtamande Iye;
Anthu onse ali pansi
Adze akondane naye.

Zoonazi amithenga
Anaimba m’mlengalenga.

hymns.title: Mbuye ngwodalitsika
hymns.text:
1. Mbuye ngwodalitsika,
Mulungu wa Israyeli ndiye,
Poti anayang’ana
Nawawombola anthu ake,

2. Napulumutsa tonse
mwapfuko la Davide mwana wake;
Monga analankhula
mwa aneneri ake, kuti

3. Adzatipulumutsa
kudzanja la onse akutida,
Ndipo adzachitira
akulu chifundo ndi chisoni.

4. Ndiye akumbukira
pangano loyera lake lija,
Ndi chilumbiro chake
cha kwa atate Abrahamu.

5. Choti timtumikire
osawaopa ’dani athu,
Ndi kuyeranso mtima
mwa chilungamo nsiku zonse.

6. Mwana, adzakuyesa
mnneneritu wa Wamkulukulu;
Ndiwe udzakonzera
njira ya Mbuye Wakumwamba.

7. Udzadziwitsa anthu
za Mpulumutsi wawo yemwe
Awakhululukira
nafafaniza tchimo lawo.

8. Poti Mulungu wathu
ali ndi mtima wachifundo,
Ndiye kumwamba komwe
ationetsa mbandakucha.

9. Powalitsira omwe
ali mumdima ndi muimfa
Ndi potilunjikitsa
tonse munjira yamtendere.

hymns.title: Ambuye tsopano lino
hymns.text:
1. Ambuye tsopano lino,
monga mwa mawu anu aja,
Lolani kapolo wanu
ndikachokere mumtendere;

2. Chifukwa chipulumutso
chanu mwandionetsa zedi,
Chimene munachikonza
akachione anthu onse.

3. Ndi nyali yakuwalitsa
omwe sadziwa mawu anu;
Ndiwo ulemerero
wa Israyeli mpingo wanu.

hymns.title: M’kati mwa zobvuta zathu
hymns.text:
1. M’kati mwa zobvuta zathu
Yesu aitana ife,
Tsiku lonse amanena:
"Tsata Ine mkristu iwe."

2. Kale ophunzira ake
Namvanso kunyanja kwawo,
Zinthu zonse anasiya
Kukatsata Mbuye wawo.

3. Yesu aitana ife:
Tikakonda chuma chokha,
Ati Yesu: "Mwana wanga,
undikondetu koposa."

4. Mwachimwemwe, mwachisoni,
Pogwiritsa ntchito zonse,
Aitana Mpulumutsi
Kuti tizimkonda tonse.

5. Yesu aitana ife;
Mbuye, mutimvetse ndithu,
Tipereke mtima wathu,
Tikondane lero ndithu.

hymns.title: Ife timakufunani
hymns.text:
1. Ife timakufunani
Inu wotonthoza mtima.
Yesu nyimbo zathu zonse
Ziyamika Inu nokha.
Munasiya zonse m’Mwamba,
Kudzakhala pansi pano
Kuwombola akapolo,
Kumasula anthu anu.

2. Yesu, ndi chifundo chanu
Chachikulu munadzera
Ife anthu osauka,
Tsoka lathu mnachotsera.
Mwazi ndi misozi yanu
Munakhetsa m’munda muja,
Kukonzera ife njira
Yonkako Kumwamba kuja.

3. Yesu munalaswa m’mtima,
Ndi zonyoza munafoka,
Mnasenzera anthu mkwiyo
Wa Atate, Inu nokha.
Chikho chija ndi choopsa
Munamwacho m’phiri lija
M’mene munalola mtanda,
E! chifundo chanu chija.

4. Yesu ndinu moyo wathu,
Chuma chathu choposetsa.
E! tikondwerera mtanda,
Apo moyo munapatsa.
Mbuye tikondana nanu,
Yesu Mbuye Mwini zonse;
Ndi mitima ndi milomo,
Tikuyamikani tonse.

hymns.title: Senzani mtanda wanuwu
hymns.text:
1. "Senzani mtanda wanuwu."
Atero Yesu Mbuyathu;
"Mukanditsata Inetu,
Mudzikanize nokhanu."

2. "Sezani mtanda wanuwu."
Musaopsedwe nawotu;
Mphamvu za Yesu nzanunso;
Limbani mtima wanuwo.

3. Senzani mtanda wanuwu."
Bwanji manyazi mumva ’nu?
Yesu anapiriratu,
Kuti mupulumuketu.

4. "Senzani mtanda wanuwu."
Nawo muyende chetetu,
Mutsogoledwe nawonso
Kwanu Kumwamba komweko.

5. "Senzani mtanda wanuwo."
Tsatani Yesu m’njiramu;
Iye wakusalemayo
Ndiye alandiridwadi.

hymns.title: Munthu Wazisoniyo
hymns.text:
1. Munthu Wazisoniyo
Timtcha dzina lakelo,
Mpulumutsi linanso;
Aleluya, ndiye Yesu.

2. Anapeputsidwako,
Nandifera m’mtandamo,
Anandiwombolayo;
Aleluya, ndiye Yesu.

3. Ife tinachimwadi,
Iye sanachimwa ’yi,
Anachotsa tchimoli,
Aleluya, ndiye Yesu.

4. Anapachikidwatu,
Natha ntchito yake myu!
Anakwera m’Mwamba duu!
Aleluya, ndiye Yesu.

5. Adzabwera Iyenso
Kudzatenga akewo;
Nyimbo tidzaimbanso,
Aleluya, ndiye Yesu.

hymns.title: Unakhetsedwa mwazi do
hymns.text:
1. Unakhetsedwa mwazi do!
Wa Yesu Mfumuyo,
Poweramira mutuwo
Pamtanda pakepo.

Ambuye mthandize inetu
Kukonda Inudi,
Ndi kuli mpando wanuwo
Ndifuna kudzako.

2. Zochimwa zanga zonsezo
Anaziferadi,
Chikondi chake chonsecho
Sindingadziwe ’yi.

3. Linadetsedwa dzuwa bii!
Pakufa Iyeyo,
Pakumwalira indedi
Wakundilengayo.

4. Pokumbukira mtandawo
Wa Mpulumutsiyu,
Ndiphimba nkhope yangayi,
Ndi nsoni n’chitatu.

5. Zofuna zanga zonsezo
Za mtima wangawu
Ndizipereka kwa Inu,
Mundiweruzetu.

hymns.title: Ku Mzinda wakuyerawo
hymns.text:
1. Ku Mzinda wakuyerawo
Wapachikidwa Mbuyeyo,
Nasautsidwa Mbuyeyo,
Akatipulumutse ’fe.

2. Padzanja lachifundolo
Linapenyetsa ’khunguwo,
Lachiza nalo nthendazo,
Papyola msomaliwo.

3. Mapazi ake namvatu
Zowawa zopambanazo,
Napachikidwa kaamba ka
Zoipa zathu zonsezi.

4. Ambuye tikondweratu
Kupulumutsa kwanuko;
Satana tisammvere ’yi,
Komabe Mpulumutsiyo.

hymns.title: Tiyeni, dzalireni nane
hymns.text:
1. Tiyeni, dzalireni nane,
Tidze ku mtanda wa Ambuye,
Tonse tichitetu maliro;
Wapachikidwa Ambuyathu.

2. Kodi misozi itisowa,
Poona anthu amanyoza?
Onani umo apirira;
Wapachikidwa Ambuyathu.

3. Anena mawu m’mtanda momwe,
Mawu ochepa achifundo,
Apempherera ’dani ake;
Wapachikidwa Ambuyathu.

4. Mtima wangawe, uyenera
Kuduka ndi manyazi lero,
Zamlasa ndi zoipa zako;
Wapachikidwa Ambuyathu.

5. Ona chikondi cha Mulungu,
Ona zoipazo za anthu,
Koma chakula ndi chikondi;
Wapachikidwa Ambuyathu.

hymns.title: Pamtandapo Ambuyeyo
hymns.text:
1. Pamtandapo Ambuyeyo
anafera ifetu,
Nakhetsa mwazi wakewo
Kutiwombola tonsefe.

Pamtandapo, pamtandapo
Ambuye wanga ’nafatu;
Pamtandapo, pamtandapo
Anandiwombolerapo.

2. Kwa munthu wasokerayo
Kudziko lakutaliko,
Atero Yesu: "Bweratu
Ukhale nawo moyowo."

3. E! Yesu Mbuye wangadi,
Ndipatsa Inu mtimawu;
Ndithandizeni inedi
Ndisalekane nanu ’yi.

4. Zochimwa zanga zonsezo
Wandichotsera mwaziwo;
Mumtima mwanga muli mbee!
Mwayeretsedwa indetu.

hymns.title: Zathedwa zonsetu
hymns.text:
1. Zathedwa zonsetu
Za moyo wakewo,
Ambuye anatsikayo
Nafika pansipa.

2. Zintchito zakezi
Zofunika ’Tatewo
Anatsiriza zonsedi,
Sanazisiya ’yi.

3. Pa Iye padzapo
Chisoni m’mtimamo,
Mpweteko wonse wathuwo
Wa dziko lonseli.

4. Pamutu minga kwe!
Pamoyo wakewo
Zoipa zathu zonsezo
Zinaikidwapo.

5. Andiferatu ’Ye,
Afera inedi;
Athetsa nsembe zonsezi
Ambuye Nsembeyi.

6. Pakugomedwapo
Pa mlandu wangawo,
Ndidzaitana Mbuyeyo
Andilanditsepo.

hymns.title: A! Mutu wakuyera
hymns.text:
1. A! Mutu wakuyera,
Wolaswa wachisoni,
Abveka Inu anthu
Ndi minga ya udani;
Ambuye mwafokatu
Ndi masauko aja,
Mwatuwa m’maso mwanu,
Mumayerera kale.

2. Ambuye Mwini moyo,
Kokoma mnafumako;
Ndizizwa pomva mawu
Umo mwachitiramo.
Chisoni chija chanu
Mcha pamachimo anga,
Mwasaukira Inu
Kupalamula kwanga.

3. Nditani Bwenzi langa
Kulemekeza Inu
Chifukwa cha chifundo
Ndi imfa ija yanu?
Mundikhalitse wanu,
Wokhulupira Inu;
Musandilole konse
Kufulatira Inu.

4. Pakufa ine Mbuye
Mukhaletu pafupi,
Mundithandize ine,
E, mudzandimasula;
Ndipenyetsetsa Yesu,
Ambuye Mfumu yanga,
Ndikafa ndine wanu,
Ndikhale nanu m’Mwamba.

hymns.title: Pokumbukira mtandawo
hymns.text:
1. Pokumbukira mtandawo
Ambuye ’nandiferapo,
Ndiyesa zingochepazo
Ndinazitama kalelo.

2. Mndiletse, ndisateme ’yi
Zachabe, koma imfayo;
Zijazo ndinakondazo
Ndazilekera mwaziwo.

3. Onani m’mutu, m’manjanso
Mudzera nsoni m’mwazimo.
A! panalibe kalelo
Wondibvalira mingayo.

4. Chinkana dziko lonselo
Lichepa ndithu mtulowo,
Chikondicho chagwirabe
Mtimanga, moyo, ndense ’ne.

hymns.title: Lero Kristu anauka, Aleluya
hymns.text:
1. Lero Kristu anauka, Aleluya,
Ndilo tsiku lokondwera, Aleluya,
Iye kale anafera, Aleluya
Nawombola otaika. Aleluya.

2. Timwimbire zomtamanda, Aleluya
Ndiye Kristu wa Kumwamba, Aleluya
’Natsikirako kumanda Aleluya
Nalanditsa akuipa, Aleluya.

3. Koma masauko ake Aleluya
Anatiwombola ife, Aleluya
Ndiye Mfumu ya mafumu, Aleluya
Mwana ndithu wa Mulungu, Aleluya

4. Timwimbire Mlungu wathu, Aleluya
Kuti atikonda ndithu; Aleluya
Mtamenso angelo inu, Aleluya
Ndiye ’Tate, Mwana, Mzimu. Aleluya.

hymns.title: Nla Mlungu dzuwali
hymns.text:
1. Nla Mlungu dzuwali;
Pa m’banda kuchapo
Angelo ’nadzatu
Nachotsa mwalawo.

Ndi mtima wonse mwimbedi
Wauka Mbuye leroli.

2. Alonda onsewo
’Nagwidwa manthadi
Poona zo’psyazo
Zoonekerazi.

3. Mulibe m’mandamu,
Wadzuka Mbuyetu;
Woposa imfayo
Ndi Mwini moyowu.

4. Dzukani nayetu,
Oyera inunso,
Lekani m’mandamo
Zakufa zanuzo.

5. Titama Yesuyo,
Ambuye m’Mwambamo
Wofera anthu ’Ye,
Timkondakondako.

hymns.title: Aleluya, Aleluya, Aleluya

lines: Mphamvu za imfa ndi za Satana

hymns.text:
1. Aleluya, Aleluya, Aleluya!
Nkhondoyo yatha, imfa yagonja,
Yesu wamoyo anaiposa,
Msampha woipa wonse nawonja,
Aleluya!

2. Mphamvu za imfa ndi za Satana
Naye Ambuye zinalimbana,
Komatu Yesu anapambana.
Aleluya!

3. Atha masiku aja ansoni,
Mbuye wauka, ali ndi mboni;
Lero chimwemwe chatha chisoni,
Aleluya!

4. Nsinga za imfa Iye ’nadula,
Khomo la m’Mwamba nalitsegula;
Yesu timtama tonse tipfuula,
Aleluya!

5. Mbuye mabala anu olimba
Atichotsera mantha a imfa;
Tsono ndi mtima wonse tiimba;
Aleluya!

hymns.title: Kondwerani dzuwa lino Aleluya
hymns.text:
1. Kondwerani dzuwa lino Aleluya,
Yesu wanka m’Mwamba momwe;
Aleluya,
Wachokera mdzik’o lino, Aleluya.
Wabwerera kwawo komwe.Aleluya.

2. Zomkweza zili m’Mwamba,Aleluya,
Zodikira Mbuye wathu; Aleluya,
Mlowetseni n’kumlambira, Aleluya,
Mfumu yathu yaulemu. Aleluya.

3. Yesu nkana saoneka, Aleluya,
Atipempherera komwe; Aleluya,
M’nyumba yake yokonzeka Aleluya,
Atilinda ife tomwe, Aleluya.

4. Tiyamike Dzina lake, Aleluya,
Mfumu ya ulemu wonse, Aleluya,
Tibukitse mbiri yake Aleluya,
Pansipa padziko lonse. Aleluya.

hymns.title: Lambira Mfumuyo

lines: Nyenyezi, dziko, dzuwa, mwezi ndi mitamboyi;

hymns.text:
1. Lambira Mfumuyo,
Ndi Yesu Mbuyathu,
Tamvani nyimbo za ’mithenga a Kumwambako;
Nafenso pansipa
Timyamike ’Yo,
Ndi Mpulumutsi wathu wotifera kalelo.

2. Lambira Yesuyo
Wokonda tonsefe;
Mabala ake achikondi aonekabe;
Tisaiwale ’yi
Zowawa zakezo,
Tileke kumchimwira, kumsautsa Yesuyo.

3. Lambira Yesuyo,
Uthenga wakewu
Uyanjanitsa anthu onse m’dziko munomu;
Amaiwala za
Kudana kwawoko,
Nayamikira Mfumu yamtendere monsemo.

4. Lambira Mfumuyo
Wolenga zonsezi:
Nyenyezi, dziko, dzuwa, mwezi ndi mitamboyi;
Tikweze dzinalo
La Mbuye Yesuyo,
Timyamikire pansi pano ndi Kumwambako.

hymns.title: Yesu wakukoma mtima
hymns.text:
1. Yesu wakukoma mtima,
Akondadi!
Wakuposa m’bale ndiye,
Akondadi!
Wina asautsa iwe,
Pena adzasiya iwe,
Yesu sadzanyenga iwe,
Akondadi!

2. Kumdziwitsa ndiko moyo,
Akondadi!
Akhumbira mtima wako
Akondadi!
Mwazi wake ngwowombola,
M’chipululu wakufuna,
M’khola mwake akusunga,
Akondadi!

3. Ukafuna kumdziwitsa,
Akondadi!
Uzimpatsa moyo wako,
Akondadi!
Kodi umachita mantha?
Pena umadera nkhawa?
Yesu amasangalatsa
Akondadi!

4. Bwenzi ndiye wakufera,
Akondadi!
Nthawi zonse sakusiya,
Akondadi!
Anthu ena akunyenga,
Yesu sadzanyenga iwe,
Zakubvuta adzachotsa,
Akondadi!

5. Akhululukira iwe,
Akondadi!
Nadzainga mdani wako,
Akondadi!
Adzakudalitsa iwe,
Nadzaletsa tsoka lonse,
Nadzakutsogoza kwawo,
Akondadi!

hymns.title: Msandipitire, Yesu
hymns.text:
1. Msandipitire, Yesu,
Mundimvere ine;
Mulikudalitsa ena,
Msandipitirire.

Yesu Mbuye,
Khutu munditchere
M’mene muitana ena
Msandipitirire.

2. Ndigwadira Inu, Yesu,
Musandikanize;
Ndikalapatu machimo
Mbuye, mndithandize.

3. Nkhope yanu ndifunitsa,
Sind’yenera konse;
M’mtima mwanga muchiritse
Nthenda zanga zonse.

4. Yesu, ndinutu chitsime
Cha chimwemwe chokha;
Sindifuna wina konse,
Koma Inu nokha.

hymns.title: Idza wolema
Mbuye, mutsaganetu
hymns.text:
1. Mbuye, mutsaganetu
Nane ndingachimwenso;
Nanu ndisungidwedi,
Mwa chikondi chanucho.

Mbuye Yesu,
Mundiperekeze inetu!
Ndine mlendo, Mbuye ’Nu,
Mutsagane nanetu.

2. Inu mundibisadi
Mmene ndabvutidwamo,
Ngati muli ndinedi
Bwino ndidzakhalamo.

3. Mbuye, mutsaganebe
Mpaka moyo watha zi!
Kwanu mindifitseko,
Komwe nsoni zathadi.

hymns.title: E, moyo wanga’we
hymns.text:
1. E, moyo wanga’we
Utsitsimuketu;
Ambuye Yesuyo
Akhala m’Mwambamo,
Pampandopo
Akhalabe, natchula dzina langali.

2. Kwa Mulungu m’Mwambamo
Amapempherako;
Chikondi chakenso
Chikhala chosatha;
Ndi mwaziwo
Akhalatu Wansembe wanga Yesuyo.

3. Mabala ajawo
A m’thupi mwakemo
Amukumbutsanso
Za ine pansipa;
Zoipazo
Achotsadi kotero sindingafe ’yi

4. Mulungu ali wokhulula mtimatu,
Ndilibe mantha ’yi,
Andisungiradi;
Ndibwera kwa
Atatewo, titayanjana leroli.

hymns.title: M’khola mwa ng’ombe ku Betelehemu
hymns.text:
1. M’khola mwa ng’ombe ku Betelehemu
Anabadwamo Ambuyangayo;
Etu, ndizizwa! Natsikirako,
Kufuna inetu.

Kufuna inetu, kufuna inetu,
Etu ndizizwa! Natsikirako
Kufuna inetu.

2. Popachikidwa pa Golgotapo
Yesu anandiwombola ine,
Etu, ndizizwa! Nakondetsadi
Nafera inetu.

Nafera inetu, nafera inetu,
Etu, ndizizwa! Nakondetsadi
Nafera inetu.

3. M’busa wokoma ndi Mbuyangayo,
Nandiitana posokerapo,
Konse koipa nalondolako
Kubweza inetu.

Kubweza inetu, kubweza inetu,
Konse koipa nalondolako
Kubweza inetu.

4. Uko Kumwambako Mbuyangayo
Andikonzera mokhaliramo;
Tsiku linalo adzabweranso
Kutenga inetu.

Kutenga inetu, kutenga inetu,
Tsiku linalo adzabweranso
Kutenga inetu.

hymns.title: Alinkudza wansoni Munthu
hymns.text:
1. Alinkudza wansoni Munthu
Wakukhala Kumwamba,
Alinkudza m’ulemerero
Ndi Mwamuna wa mtanda.

Aleluya, aleluya,
Alinkudza kwa ife;
Ndi chimwemwe tidzamkomana
Pakufika Ambuye.

2. Alinkudza Ambuye Yesu
Wakuphedwa padziko,
Alinkudza kukhala Mfumu
Yoweruza maiko.

3. Pakufika asonkhanitsa
Anthu ake oyera;
Adzafuna m’mitundu yonse
Omwe Iye ’nafera.

hymns.title: Pakwitana Mbuye wanga
hymns.text:
1. Pakwitana Mbuye wanga
Potsiriza dzikoli,
Pakufika tsiku lakuwalalo
Posonkhana akumvera,
Pakuona Yesuyo,
Ndidzakondwerera naye komweko.

Pakwitana Mbuye wanga,
Pakwitana Mbuye wanga,
Pakwitana Mbuye wanga,
Ndidzakondwerera naye komweko.

2. Potuluka m’manda mwawo
Anthu ake onsewo,
Tidzasanganatu nawo nthawiyo,
Pakuuka osankhidwa,
Kunka naye Yesuyo,
Ndidzakondwerera naye komweko.

3. Tisaleke kugwirabe
Ntchito ya Mulunguyo,
Tibukitse mbiri yake m’dzikoli,
Ndi podzatha moyo wathu
Ndi zintchito zathuzo,
Tidzakondwerera naye komweko.

hymns.title: Mbuye Yesu adzabwera
hymns.text:
1. Mbuye Yesu adzabwera,
Asekere anthu onse;
Mawu awa achimwemwe
Azimveka m’dziko lonse.

Adzabwera, adzabwera;
E! bwerani Mbuye wathu.

2. Dziko lino linaona
Masauko a Mbuyathu,
Lidzaonanso ulemu,
M’mene adzabwera Iye.

Adzabwera, adzabwera;
Tibvomera, E! mubwere.

3. Anthu anu amafoka,
Pa ulendo nasokera;
Ha! Adzaonana nanu
Atabvalanso zoyera.

Mudzabwera, mudzabwera;
Inde, Mbuyetu mubwere.

4. Ndi chiyembekezo ichi
Sitikhala chete ife;
Tiimbitsa nyimbo zathu
Zakulemekeza Mlungu.

Adzabwera, adzabwera;
E! mubwere msanga Yesu.

hymns.title: Yang’anani anthu onse
hymns.text:
1. Yang’anani anthu onse,
Yesu Mbuye wathuyo;
Alinkudza ndi ulemu,
Kuoneka m’Mwambamo.

Anthu onse amlambire
Yesu Mwana wa Mulungu;
Alinkudza ndi ulemu
Wopambana, indetu’

2. Adzatenga anthu ake
Akummvera pansipo,
Iwo adzakhala naye
M’dziko la Kumwambako.

3. Koma anthu onse omwe
Anamnyoza pansipo,
Nthawi Yesu alinkudza
Adzaopa m’mtimamo.

4. Ife tonse tikumbuke
Mawu ake onsewo;
Timuyang’anire Iye,
Yesu Mbuye wathuyo.

hymns.title: A Mulungu
hymns.text:
1. A Mulungu
Munatuma Yesuyo,
Mwana wanu yekhayo.

2. Anabadwa,
Anabadwa motere,
Monga mphawi m’kholamo

3. Anakonda,
Anakonda anthuwo
Nawapulumutsanso.

4. Anafera
Anafera m’mtandamo,
Anafera ifenso.

5. Anadzuka,
Anadzuka m’mandamo,
Anatenga moyowo.

6. Anakwera,
Anakwera m’Mwambamo
Kwa Mulungu ’Tatewo.

7. Adzabwera,
Adzabwera Iyeyo
Tsiku lomalizalo.

8. Aleluya,
Aleluya Yesuyo,
Tizitama dzinalo.

hymns.title: Idzani nose ’nu
hymns.text:
1. Idzani nose ’nu
Okonda Yesuyo;
Libuke Dzinalo,
Timtame konseko.
Uzani onse m’Mwambamo,
Uzani onse pansipa,
Wafera Iye anthuwo.

2. Waleka koronayo,
Nasiya ’Tatewo,
Natsika m’Mwambamo,
Nalira, nafatu.
Zowawa zake zonsezi
Nazimva, zinaposatu
Kuti tipulumukedi.

3. Nadzuka m’mandamo
Moopsya m’mdimamo,
Nigonja imfayo
Ndi mdani waketu;
Nakweradi Kumwambako,
Nakhala Mfumu monsemo,
Ambuye wathu Mlunguyo.

4. Adzadza indetu
Kudziko linoli;
Tidzanka nayeyu
M’ufumu wakedi.
Momwemo tidzampenya ’Ye,
Momwemo tidzakhala ’fe,
Nkuwala kwake koti mbee!

hymns.title: Yesu, dzina lakukonda
hymns.text:
1. Yesu, dzina lakukonda,
Lopambana onse ena,
Tonse tidzaligwadira
Ndi mitima yochepetsa.

2. Yesu, dzina lokondwetsa
Akuipa a padziko,
Kale linatidziwitsa
Mpulumutsi ndiye Yesu.

3. Yesu, dzina lakufatsa,
Anamutcha ’kali Mwana,
M’mene analowa kale
M’dziko lino lakudana.

4. Yesu, dzina ndi lomweli
La pa dziko lino lonse,
Ndi la mphamvu yolanditsa
Anthu mu masoka onse.

5. Yesu, dzina lakukonda
La Mwanayo wa Mulungu,
Ife anthu osauka
Tithawira nalo kwanu.

hymns.title: Inde, ndifuna kumvatu
hymns.text:
1. Inde, ndifuna kumvatu
Za chikondano chakecho
Cha Yesu Mbuye wangayo,
Zomwe anamva kalelo.

E! dzina la Yesu,
E! dzina la Yesu,
Inde, ndilira m’mtimamo
Chipulumutso chakecho.

2. Zina za Yesu ndimvetu,
Kuti ndichite zakezo;
Mzimu Woyera, mudzetu,
Ndiphunzitseni zonsezo.

3. M’mawu a Yesu Mbuyeyo,
Inde, acheza nanemo;
Liu ndimamva m’Bukumo
Ndilo la Yesu Mbuyeyo.

4. Zina za Yesu m;Mwambamo,
Ali pampando pakepo;
Udze Ufumu wakewo,
Ndiyetu Mfumu ponsepo.

hymns.title: Wina atikonda ife
hymns.text:
1. Wina atikonda ife,
Bwenzi lathu ndiyeyu;
Atifunafuna ife,
Inde, nthawi zonsetu.

Chikondano chakechi
Nchachikulukuludi.

2. Ndani mwa abale athu
Akanatifera ’fe?
Koma Yesu m’malo mwathu
Anapachikidwatu.

3. Anamnyoza pansi pano,
Bwenzi la ochimwawo;
Muulemerero wake
Alikonda Dzinali.

4. Timchimwira kopambana,
Ndi kumusautsa ’Ye,
Koma Bwenzi lathu Yesu
Atikondakondabe

5. Mtiphunzitse, Mbuye Yesu,
Tikondane nanutu;
Tisaiwalire konse
Bwenzi lathu ndinutu.

hymns.title: Nditama Mlungu m’mtimamo
hymns.text:
1. Nditama Mlungu m’mtimamo,
Wakundifera pansipo,
Nafafaniza tchimolo,
Nanditengera dipolo.

Wandiwombola inetu
Pokhetsa mwazi wakewo;
Timlemekeza Iyetu
Wotilipirira dipolo.

2. Ndinasokera. kalelo,
Ndamkana. Iye Yesuyo,
Koma ndiimba leroli:
Wandiwombola inedi

3. Mtima ndimakondweramo,
Popenyetsetsa Yesuyo
Pamtanda pake pomwepo,
Pakundifera inenso

4. Sizitha ntchito zangazo,
Kundiyeretsa mtimamo,
Anandiyesa inetu
Wakulungama Yesuyo

5. Tsono mubwere inunso,
Mtetetezi wanu ndiyedi
Apulumutsa onsewo Akumkhulupiriradi

hymns.title: Konda dzinalo la Yesu
hymns.text:
1. Konda dzinalo la Yesu
Mwana wosauka ’we;
Ndilo lothandiza anthu;
Khala nalo ponse phee!

Dzina la Yesuyo
Nlokondwetsa onsewo,
M’mwambamo ponsepo
Litonthoza m’mtimamo.

2. Konda dzinalo la Yesu
M’moyo mwako monsemo;
M’mene ulikuyesedwa,
Tchula Dzina lakelo.

3. Dzina ili ndi lokoma
La Mtetezi wathuyo;
M’mene adzatilandira
M’mwamba, tidzakondwadi.

4. M buye Yesu timtamanda
Ndi zinyimbo zathuzo;
Mfumu ya mafumu onse
Yesu timayesadi.

hymns.title: Khamulo liliko
hymns.text:
1. Khamulo liliko
Kumwambako mbuu!
Pakukhala ndi Yesu
Aimbirako:

"Kwa Iye atikonda
Natsuka ’fe mbuu!
E! kukhale ulemu
Kwa Mbuyathuyu.”

2. Onsewa ’nachimwa
Nadetsedwa bii,
Nthawi yino ayera
Naimbiradi:

3. Akhala mafumu
Kwa Mbuyathuyo,
Anawombola onse
Ndi mwaziwo pyu!

4. Akadakhalabe
Osaukako
Ngati Yesu sakana-
wombolatuwo.

5. Ndi nyimbo yabwino
Tidzamtamako,
Kuti ena pakumva
Amwimbirenso:

hymns.title: Tamani mphamvu ya Yesu
hymns.text:
1. Tamani mphamvu ya Yesu,
Angelo agwade;
Tulutsanitu korona,

Mumbveke, mbveke, mbveke,
Mbveke, Mbuyeyo!

2. Inu osankhidwa ake,
Owomboledwa ’nu,
Tamani Mpulumutsiyo,

3. Anthu ose ndi mitundu
Pa dziko linotu,
Amlemekeze Mfumuyo,

4. Tifuna kuti komweko
Tikamgwadire ’Ye;
Tidzaimba kosaleka;

hymns.title: Mubwere Mzimu Wakuyera
hymns.text:
1. Mubwere Mzimu Wakuyera,
Kuyatsa moto m’mtima mwathu;
Ntchito ndi yanu kudzozera
Ndi kutininkha mphatsozo.

2. Kudzoza kwanu kutipatsa
Chimwemwe, moyo ndi mtendere;
Kuwala kwanu kupenyetsa
A m’mdima ndi a m’ndendemo.

3. Mtima wodetsa mukonzere,
Chisomo chanu chakwanira;
Adani athu muthawitse
Ndi mphamvu yaikulu.

4. Mutidziwitse ’Tate wathu,
Ndi Mwana wake ndinu Mmodzi;
Mnafuma kwa awiri onse,
Koma Mulungu Mmodziyo.

hymns.title: Mzimu Woyera, mudze mumitima mwathumo

lines: Tikhale tonse nazo mphamvu zanu zonsezo.

hymns.text:
1. Mzimu Woyera, mudze mumitima mwathumo,
Mufike nazo mphamvu zanu zazikuluzo.

2. Mufike monga nyali younika m’mtimamo,
Mutidziwitse zakuipa zakukhalamo.

3. Mufike monga moto wakuotcha zomwezo.
Mutiyeretse ifetu m’mitima mwathumo.

4. Mufike monga ngati njiwa yamtenderewo,
Kutitu anthu anu onse akondanetu.

5. Mufike monga ngati mphepo yokokomayo,
Tikhale tonse nazo mphamvu zanu zonsezo.

hymns.title: Mzimu Woyera, mudzetu kwa ine
hymns.text:
1. Mzimu Woyera, mudzetu kwa ine,
E, ngati mvula m’dziko lakuuma;
Ndikhale munda wanu wakupatsa
Zipatso zoyenera Mbuyeyo.

2. M’phunzitsi, ndinu mudziwitse ine
Chikondi chanu chija chachikulu;
Lembani mawu anu pamtimanga,
Kuti ndikumbukire zanuzo.

3. Wosangalatsa, ine ndikalira
Muchotse nsoni, m’mtimamo mudikhe;
Mundigoneke pachifuwa chake
Cha Yesu kuti ndikakondwepo.

4. Wotsogolera, munditsogolere
Kuti n’kafike kwawo kwa Atate,
Nditsate Yesu ndikuyendayenda
M’njira yomweyo anapondamo.

5. Mthandizi ndinu, mndithangate ine
Kupempha bwino izo zindisowa,
Kupempha monga Mlungu amafuna,
Kulingalira zake zokhazo.

6. Mzimu Woyera, n’dzipereka ndense,
Mundichitire ntchito yaikulu;
Mtima woyera ndi womvera mpatse,
Wodzala ndi chikondi chanucho.

hymns.title: Mpume pa inetu, Mpweya wa Mulungu

lines: Mpume pa inetu, Mpweya wa Mulungu,
Mpume pa inetu, Mpweya wa Mulungu,
Mpume pa inetu, Mpweya wa Mulungu,
Mpume pa inetu, Mpweya wa Mulungu,

hymns.text:
1. Mpume pa inetu, Mpweya wa Mulungu,
Ndi kundidzaza moyo wanuwo,
Kuti ndikonde zomwe mukondanso,
Ndichite chomwe mumachitanso.

2. Mpume pa inetu, Mpweya wa Mulungu,
Mpaka mtimanga ukayeretu,
Ndipo zokhumba zanga zilingane
Nazo zanuzo zakuyera mbuu!

3. Mpume pa inetu, Mpweya wa Mulungu,
Mpaka ndikhale wanu nokhatu;
Ayeretsedwe makhalidwe anga
Ndi mphamvu yanu yondisunga nji!

4. Mpume pa inetu, Mpweya wa Mulungu,
Kuti inedi ndisafe ’yitu,
Koma ndikhale nanu m’moyo womwe.
Wangwiro ndi wa nthawi zonsetu.

hymns.title: Mubwere Mzimu Inu
hymns.text:
1. Mubwere Mzimu Inu
Woyera wakufatsa,
Muchotse mdima m’mtima mwathu
Tikapenye m’maso.

2. Mtisangalatse m’zonse,
Ndi wachifundo Inu,
Tiyembekeze kumapazi
A Mbuyathu Yesu.

3. Mtitsitsimutse ife
Kuchotsa nkhawa zathu,
Muyatse moto wachikondi
Mu mitima yathu.

4. Mtitsutse titachimwa
Kutilapitsa m’mtima,
Mwonetsenso chikondi chokhululukira tchimo.

5. Kutiyeretsa m’mtima
Ndi ntchito yanu yokha,
Kupatsa moyo watsopano
M’mene timafoka.

6. Mukhale m’kati mwathu,
Mutichotsere mantha,
Tidzayamika ’Tate wathu,
Mwana wawo ndi ’Nu.

hymns.title: Idzani, Mzimu Inu
Mzimu Woyera, mudzetu
hymns.text:
1. Mzimu Woyera, mudzetu
Tiyeretsedwe m’mtimamu;
Mupatse anthu anuwa
Mitulo yanu yonseyo.

2. Kudzoza kwa Kumwambako
Kutitonthoza m’mtimamo,
Ndi kutidzutsa m’moyomu,
Tikhale okondanatu.

3. Pankhope pathu mthirepo
Chisomo chanu chijacho;
Mtendere mutininkhebe,
Mutiyendetse ponse phee!

4. Tionetseni tonsetu
Umodzi wanu monsemo,
Atate, Mwana, Mzimu ’Nu
Tiimbe nthawi zonsezo:

Titamire nthawi zonse
’Tate, Mwana, Mzimu, Nonse.
Amen.

hymns.title: Mubwere kuno Mzimu ’Nu
hymns.text:
1. Mubwere kuno Mzimu ’Nu,
Chitsime cha chikondicho;
Mudziwa ndimaliratu,
Mukhale m’mtima mwangamo,

Ndipatsa inu mtimawu,
Masiku onse mkhalemu.

2. Mukonze mtima wangawu,
Muyere ndithu m’katimo;
Ndilinda tere, Mzimu ’Nu,
Mupatsetu chikondicho;

Lichepa dontho lokhali,
Ndipempha mundidzazedi.

3. Ndilira Mzimu leroli,
Mutsimikize Mawuwo;
Ya Mbuye Yesu mphamvuyi,
Ikhale yathu, yanganso;

Mulowe m’mtima, mdzazetu
Ndi mphamvu nzeru, moyowu.

hymns.title: Mbuye wondipulumutsa
hymns.text:
1. Mbuye wondipulumutsa
Mulandire mtima wanga,
Mwandipatsa Mzimu wanu
Womeretsa zopatsomo.

Ndiye Mzimu Wakuyera
Atipatsa ife makhalidwe
Wofanana naye Yesu,
Anatsika Kumwambako.

2. Naye Mzimu mndiphunzitse
Kukondwera nsiku zonse
Ndi kukhala ndi mtendere
Osaderatu nkhawa ’yi.

3. Mndithandize kukondana
Ndikuthangatira onse,
Ndi kukhululukirabe
Akundichimwirawo.

4. Mndilimbitse ndipirire
Osadandaula konse,
Ndi kulamulira thupi
Ndi zofuna zakezo.

5. Kudzirala ndi kufatsa,
Inde, zonse muzikonda,
Mndiphunzitse pondipatsa
Mzimu wanu Woyerawo.

hymns.title: Mbuye, Mawu anu
hymns.text:
1. Mbuye, Mawu anu
Atikondweretsa,
Atitsogolera,
Salephera konse.

2. Poyensedwa ife
Atipambanitsa,
Natonthoza mtima
Natipulumutsa.

3. Tikaona bvuto,
Tikalowa m’mdima,
Kuunika kwake
Kusonyeza njira.

4. Atisangalatsa,
Atilemeretsa
Powerenga mommo
Nawo mtima wonse.

5. Ndiwo alimbitsa
Omwe akufooka,
Nawapatsa moyo
Akafuna kufa.

6. Mbuye, mtiphunzitse
Nzeru zake zonse,
Tikayenderane
N’tiyanjane nanu.

hymns.title: Cholimbitsa mtima ndi
hymns.text:
1. Cholimbitsa mtima ndi
Chonditsogolera
M’njira ya Mulunguyo;
Ine ndili nacho.

M’Bukuli ine ndi
Onse owerenga
Mawu a Mulunguwo,
Timapeza moyo.

2. Dzinthu zakumundazo
Zilimbitsa thupi;
Zolembedwa m’Bukumo
Zimadyetsa mtima.

3. Ndikachimwa, Bukuli
Lindiyambotsutsa;
Limanditonthoza ndi
Mawu a mtendere.

4. Pakudera nkhawa ’ne,
Pakuchita mantha,
N’kawerenga m’Bukuli
Lindipatsa mphamvu.

5. Lindionetsera ’ne,
Chifuniro chake
Cha Mbuyanga Yesuyo,
Ndikamvere bwino.

6. Zonse mwazilembamo,
Mzimu Wakuyera,
Kuzimvera zonsezo
Mundithangatire.

7. M’Buku lakuyerali
Powerenga ife,
Mbuye mutipatsemo
Moyo, moyo, moyo.

hymns.title: Mundinyemere ’ne
hymns.text:
1. Mundinyemere ’ne
Mkate wamoyo
Monga kunyanja kuja kalelo;
Ndipyola Mawuwo,
Ndifuna Inu,
Ndikhumba Inu mwini moyowo.

2. Mkate wamoyowo
Ndinu Ambuye;
Mawu oyera anu n’khumbanso
Mun’dyetse omwewo
Ndikhale moyo,
Ndikonde zakuona zanuzo.

3. Mtume tsopanoli
Mzimu Woyera,
Kuti andikonzere m’masomo;
Abvumbulutse zinsinsi za m’Mawu,
Kuti ndionemo Ambuyeyo.

4. Mndidalitsere ’ne
Mawu amoyo,
Monga munadalitsa mkatewo;
Ndikhale mfuludi,
Wosamangika,
Mukhale moyo wanga wonsewo.

hymns.title: Mbiri yakalelomwe
hymns.text:
1. Mbiri yakalelomwe
Mundisimbiretu
Ya Yesu Mbuye yemwe
Anandiferatu.

2. Simbani bwinobwino-
Ndilibe nzeru ’yi-
Ndimve tsopano lino
Mbiri ya moyowo.

Mbiri yakalelomwe,
Mbiri yakalelomwe,
Mbiri yakalelomwe,
Mundisimbiretu.

3. Mawu amveke bwino,
Alowe m’mtimamo,
Ndizindikire tsono
Chipulumutsocho.

4. Simbani mobwereza,
Ndisaiwale ’yi,
Koma ndisunge bwino
Mumtima Mbiriyi.

5. Simbani Mbiri yonse
Ya Mbuye wangayo;
Zochimwa zanga ndizo
Zinapha Yesuyo.

6. Simbanitu mwachete
Mbiri ya Yesuyi,
Pakubvitidwa ine
Inditonthozepo.

7. Simbani Mbiri yomwe,
Ndikhulupiredi,
Kuti pakuyesedwa
Ndipulumukepo.

8. Inde, pakufa panga
M’maso mukhale mbee!
Mbiri ya Mbuye wanga
Mundisimbiredi.

hymns.title: Kodi ulikulemedwa
hymns.text:
1. Kodi ulikulemedwa
Ndi zoipazo?
Idza kuno, ati Yesu,
Pumako.

2. Ndikamzindikira ninji
Mbuye wangayo?
Ali ndi mabala m’manja
Mwakemo.

3. Kodi ali ndi chilemba
M’mphumi mwakemo?
E, chilembacho chaminga
Chilimo.

4. Ndikampeza, ndikamtsata
Ninji pansipa?
Masauko ndi misozi
Zilipo.

5. Ndikamfunafuna Iye,
Ndipezenjiko?
Kumaliza kwa chisoni
Chonsecho.

6. Ndikampempha anditenge,
Akataniko?
Ati Yesu, "Idza msanga,
Idzatu."

hymns.title: Musawalole mawuwo
hymns.text:
1. Musawalole mawuwo
Apite ngati mphepozi,
Musaumitse mtimatu,
Polira Yesu Mbuyedi.

Idzanitu, idzanitu,
Idzani kwa Ambuye,
Idzanitu, idzanitu
Apulumutse inunso.

2. Musachitenso nthantha ’yi,
Mufulumire inutu;
Tsiku labwino nleroli,
Mulandirenso moyowu.

3. Zokandweretsa m’dzikomu
Nzosakhutitsa m’mtimamo;
Koma za Yesu zonsezo
Zikwaniritsa inudi.

4. Sakukanani Yesudi,
E, mukalapa m’mtimamo;
Lolani kuti Mzimuyo
Agwire ntchito zakezo.

hymns.title: Pakupempha ife pano
hymns.text:
1. Pakupempha ife pano,
Pakwitana ’Tatewo,
Pakudziwa tsoka lako,
Bweratu kwa Mbuyeyo.

Idzatu, idzatu
Kwa Mbuyathu Yesudi,
Idzatu, idzatu,
Iwe bwera leroli.

2. Unachimwachimwa ndithu,
Wasokera m’talimo;
Unachedweranji kudza
pakulinda Yesuyo?

3. M’dziko lino pansi pano
Sungapeze kanthumo
Kokwanitsa mtima wako;
Bweratu kwa Mbuyeyo.

4. Bvumbulutsa zonse zako
Zobisika m’mtimamo;
Ayeretse moyo wako
Nawo mwazi wakewo.

hymns.title: Mipingo iyo idzatu
hymns.text:
1. Mipingo iyo idzatu,
Yoyenda mangu pajapo,
Afuma kuti anthuwo?
Afika bwanji komweko?

Anena anthu onsewo,
"Yesu Sing’anga apitapo."
Anena anthu onsewo,
"Yesu Sing’anga apitapo."

2. Azizwa anthu ajawo,
Nafunsa, "Ndani mlendoyo?
Wanzeru monga Iyeyo
Kulibe wina konseko."

3. Ndi Yesu yemwe kalelo
’Nakhala munthu pansipa;
Anthenda onse nthawiyo
Nachira yake mphamvuyo.

4. Afika Yesu leroli,
Chifundo m’mtima mwakemo,
Timfitse msanga kwathuko,
“Akhale nafe ponsepo.

5. Timsankhe Yesu Mbuyeyo,
Timyese Mfumu yathuyo,
Chifukwa tikamkanatu
Tikhala otayikawo.

Tsopano inu ’dzanitu,
Asanapitirirepo.
Tsopano inu ’dzanitu,
Asanapitirirepo.

hymns.title: Ukapenya kwa Yesu uliko moyoko

lines: Kuli moyo kwa yense apenya Yesuyo
Khulupira mwa mphamvu ya Mlungu wathuyi

hymns.text:
1. Ukapenya kwa Yesu uliko moyoko,
Inde, moyo tsopanopanutu;
Wolakwira upenye kwa Yesu Mbuyeyo,
Kuwombola naferatu ’we.

Ona! Ona! Onatu!
Kuli moyo kwa yense apenya Yesuyo
Wakuferatu pamtandapo.

2. Anasenza pa bwanji uchimo wonsewo,
Ngati wanu pa Yesu sulipo?
Bwanji mwazi wakhetsa kutsuka ifetu,
Ngati uwu sitikwanako?

3. Zilepheradi zonse kugula moyowo,
Koma mwazi wa Yesu Mbuyeyo.
Khulupira mwa mphamvu ya Mlungu wathuyi
Kuyeretsa ’we m’mtimakomo!

4. Anathera pamtanda zintchito zonsezi
Zowombola mizimu yathuyi;
Ndipo yense akadza mokondwakondwadi
Moyo apeza kwa Yesuko.

hymns.title: Ambuye wathu Yesu
hymns.text:
1. Ambuye wathu Yesu
Akhala Mfumunso;
Zoipa zazikulu
Azigonjetsa ’Ye;
Anena mawu ake
Ochotsa zonsezo,
Kalelo nalamula;
Pakhale bata duu!

2. M’ulemerero mwake
Anenanenabe;
Munkhondo apambana
Ndi mawu akewo.
Akristu akondwera
Poona mphamvuyo
Ya Mbuye wathu Yesu
Wotiwombolayo.

3. Zobvala zake zonse
Nza mwazi woti pyu!
Pamphumi pake pomwe
Korona waketu.
Unyolo wa Satana
Umasulidwako;
Kumwamba amithenga
Atama Mbuyeyo.

4. M’kufatsa kwake komwe
Anena nafenso,
Tonsefe omangidwa
Ndi zakuipazi;
Ambuye amanena
Zotichenjezazi:
Ananu, msiye zonse,
Mupulumuketu.

5. Chikondi cha Mbuyathu
Chiposa zonsetu;
Chisomo chake chomwe
Chikondweretsabe;
Ulemu wake wonse
Umapambanadi;
Tiyeni, tikondwere
Popita m’Mwambamo.

hymns.title: Sing’anga ’mkulu ndiye Yesu
hymns.text:
1. Sing’anga ’mkulu ndiye Yesu,
Mwana wa Mulungu;
Asangalatsa achisoni,
Ali wachifundo.

Dzina la Yesu ndi lokoma,
Dzina la Yesu lipambana,
Dzina lake lakukonda,
Yesu, inde Yesu.

2. Zoipa zakhululukidwa,
Yesu amatero;
Tiyende bwino m’njira yake,
Tilowemo lero.

3. Nditama Nsembe ya Mulungu,
Ndilandira Yesu;
Ndikonda dzinalo labwino,
Dzina lanu, Yesu.

4. Akulu inu m’bwere nonse,
Ana inu nomwe,
Ambuye akuitanani,
Bvomerani nonse.

hymns.title: Uthenga wa Mulungu
hymns.text:
1. Uthenga wa Mulungu
Walowa m’mtimamu,
Wochotsa zakuipa
Zakundidetsazo.

Pakuti anthu akumvera
Yesu awapulumutsa,
Inde, awapulumutsa, indetu.

2. Ndidziwa kuti Yesu
Anafa kalelo,
Nafafaniza zonse
Tinazichimwazo.

3. Satana ndi unyolo
Anandimanga nji!
Ambuye Yesu yekha
Nandimasuladi.

4. Ambuye mulowetse
Mtendere m’mtimamo
Ndimvetse mawu anu
Masiku onsewo.

Akuti anthu akumvera
Yesu awapulumutsa,
Inde, awapulumutsa, indetu.

hymns.title: Okoma ndiwo mawu
hymns.text:
1. Okoma ndiwo mawu
A Yesu Mbuyeyo,
Wopatsa ife anthu
Mtendere wakowo.
Kwa ife akumvera
Kulibe mantha ’yi;
Timamva liu lake
Lingoti, "Mudza ’nu.”

Inu akutopawo,
Yesu aitana ’nu;
Mudze kwa Ambuyeyo,
Mudze msangatu.

2. Mukana Iye bwanji,
Wokoma Bwenzilo?
Mutsate Yesu yekha,
E, mpaka imfayo.
Mwafoka osokera,
Mwafoka osokera,
Mwadetswa nazozi
Zoipa mwazichita;
Mumvere Mbuyedi.

3. Ambuye, musendeze
Pafupi nafedi,
Timvetse Inu msanga,
Poyenda m’dzikoli.
M’ulendo m’moyo uno
Titsate Inutu;
Kumwamba mutifitse,
Tidzamve: "Idzani."

hymns.title: Inu nonse obvutidwa
hymns.text:
1. Inu nonse obvutidwa,
Mbuye ali panopa;
M’maso mwanu muli msozi;
’Dzani kwa Mbuyathuyo.

Yesu ngwachifundodi,
E! wafera inutu,
E! wafera inutu.

2. Yesu ndiye Bwenzi lanu,
Ali wa chikondicho;
Kodi inu mumkanabe?
Mlape msanga m’mtimamo.

3. Pena imfa idza mawa,
Manda ali m’fupimo;
Nthawi yino ndi yabwino,
Mlole Yesu m’mtimamo.

4. Ndi angelo akumwamba
Anke ndi uthengawo
Kuti wina wadza lero
Kwa Mbuyathu Yesuyo.

hymns.title: Wochimwa iwe, bweratu
hymns.text:
1. Wochimwa iwe, bweratu
Kwa Yesu Mbuyeyo;
Atero Iye; pumatu,
umvere mawuwo.

Khulupira mawu onse
A Mbuyathuyo;
Uli nawo pakumvera,
Inde, moyowo.

2. Ambuye Yesu anatsira
Mwazi wake pyu!
Ubire m’mwazi womwewo,
Uyereyere mbuu!

3. Wamoyo ndiye Yesudi,
Nzoona zakezo;
Akhala Iye njiratu
Yofika m’Mwambamo.

4. Tiyeni tonse, tinkeko
Ulendo wakewo
Kudziko lake m’Mwambamo,
Tikhale nayeko.

hymns.title: Yesu ndi wokonda
hymns.text:
1. Yesu ndi wokonda;
Ati "Idzatu,
Yense wakufuna,
Bwera msangatu."
Ali wachifundo
Ndi wamphamvunso
Nthawi zonse Yesuyo
Alindatu.

Yesu akukonda,
Idza msanga ’we,
Adikira iwenso;
Wachedwatu.

2. Iwetu afuna,
Inde, kalelo;
Leronso adika
Mbuye wathuyo.
Uza Iye zonse
Za uchimowo;
Yesu ati leroli;
"Wachedwa ’we."

3. Yesu alindira,
Inde, iwetu;
Idza ndi kukhala
Ndi chimwemwenso
Ku mikono yake
Yachikondiyo;
Sankha Iye msangatu;
Wachedwatu.

hymns.title: Lero lino m’bale wanga
hymns.text:
1. Lero lino m’bale wanga,
Ndilo dzuwa lakukoma;
Talandira Mpulumutsi
M’mene ali kuitana.

2. Lero lino m’bale wanga,
Usazengereza ayi;
Ngati ulandira Yesu
Lero, udzachita mwayi.

3. Lero lino ndi labwino;
Moyo wako uli nawo;
Pena m’mawa umwalira,
Udzatani mlandu wako?

4. Lero lino m’bale wanga,
Lapa mtima, lapa tchimo,
Yesu adzakulandira,
Ukapempha lero lino.

5. Ndiwe mlendo lero lino,
Mvera ndikupempha iwe;
Yesu Mwana wa Mulungu
Akufuna ndithu iwe.

6. Inde, lero lino Yesu
Aitana inu nonse.
Landirani Mpulumutsi,
Musazengereze konse.

hymns.title: Penyetsetsa Yesu
hymns.text:
1. Penyetsetsa Yesu,
Mtima wosauka;
Anafera iwe,
Idza, nupulumule,
Iye anachotsa
Nsoni ndi zoipa;
Penyetsetsa Yesu,
Ndi kukhulupira.

2. Penyetsetsa Yesu
Likatentha dzuwa;
Yachuluka ntchito,
Mphamvu idzakula.
Akonzera kwawo
Nyumba zokhalamo;
Penyetsetsa Yesu,
Mtsatetu tsopano.

3. Penyetsetsa Yesu
Pogwirana nawo;
Nkhondo ikabvuta
Tamva Mbuye wako.
Achuluka ’dani,
Iwe ungofoka;
Penyetsetsa Yesu,
Mantha adzachoka.

4. Ndipo pakulowa
M’dziko la Kumwamba,
Udzapeza komwe
Onse adzatama.
Mwa zowala zija
Za Kumwamba kwawo;
Udzapenya maso
Yesu Mbuye wako.

hymns.title: Malo anachepa
hymns.text:
1. Malo anachepa,
Nyumba anammana,
Agona m’modyera,
Mutu paudzuwo.
Anthu sanamtama,
Nyimbo panalibe,
M’nyumba ya alendo
Malo munalibe.

Apempha malo Ambuye;
E, mlandiretu m’mtimamo,
Ungomvetu Kumwambako,
"Akusowanso malo."

2. Wina panalibe
Kumlandira Iye,
Wakumsangalatsa,
Womkonda nasowa,
Anthu sanafuna
Chumacho chosatha,
Sanamkondweretsa,
Malo munalibe.

hymns.title: Atate ’nu, atate ’nu
hymns.text:
1. Atate ’nu, atate ’nu,
Mverani Ambuye.

Khulupirani kuti mukalowe m’Mwambamo,
Khulupirani kuti mukalowe m’Mwambamo.

2. Amayi ’nu, amayi ’nu,
Tsatani Ambuye.

3. Abale ’nu, abale ’nu,
Kondani Ambuye.

4. Alongo ’nu, alongo ’nu,
Kondani Ambuye.

5. Abwenzi ’nu, abwenzi ’nu,
Tamani Ambuye.

6. Oipa inu nonsetu,
Mverani Ambuye.

hymns.title: Ndichitenji kukapeza
hymns.text:
1. Ndichitenji kukapeza
Moyo? Thandizeni!
Ndili wakutopa; Mzimu,
Muthandize ine.
Zonse zinathedwadi;

Yesu watha zonsezo;
Sutha ntchito, ungomvera
Mawu ake omwewo.

2. Iye anatsika m’Mwamba,
Anachoka kwawo,
Anafera anthu, nati:
"Ndatha zonse zawo."

3. Mbuye wanga ndilikumva,
Ndikondana nanu;
Umapuma mzimu wanga;
Kwathu ndiko kwanu.

hymns.title: Kodi mwalandira Yesu
hymns.text:
1. Kodi mwalandira Yesu?
Iye anakuferani.
Afunitsa inu nonse;
Kodi mumufunanso?

Kodi mufunatu Yesu?
Bvomerani msangatu:
"Inde, Yesu ndifunadi,
Ndinu Mbuye wangatu."

2. Nthawi zonse mufunabe
Zinthuzo za pansi pano;
Koma munyozabe Yesu
Wopachikwa kalelo.

3. Yesu akuitanani
Kwanja kwake kwakukulu;
’Mvani mawu ake lero,
Musachite nthantha ’yi.

4. Imfa idzafika msanga;
Ndipo mdzaikidwa m’manda;
Nthawi yomwe simudzamva
Kuitana kwakeko.

hymns.title: ’Mvani liwu lomwe
hymns.text:
1. ’Mvani liwu lomwe
M’Khutu mwakomo,
Alikuitana
Mpulumutsiyo:
"Undipatsetu

Mtima wakowo;
Ndinakuferatu Kalekalelo."

2. Ati: "Undiuze
Nsoni zakozo;
Ine ndidzachotsa
Zonse zomwezo."

3. Kodi ukafuna
Kupumulatu?
Yesu aitana:
"Udze kunoku."

4. Tula mtolo wako
Pali mtandapo,
Akanyamula
Mpulumutsiyo.

hymns.title: Yesu ponong’oneza, idzanitu
hymns.text:
1. Yesu ponong’oneza, idzanitu;
Mupempherera ife, idzanitu;
Njabwino nthawi yino, idzanitu,
Yomdziwa Mpulumutsi, idzanitu.

2. Tulani zoipazi, idzanitu,
Yesu adzatha zonse,. idzanitu,
Olema ndi ochimwa, idzanitu,
Sakumbukira izo, idzanitu.

3. Imvani mawu ake, idzanitu,
Mudzalandira dalo, idzanitu,
Nacho chisomo chake, idzanitu,
Yesu alainda inu, idzanitu.

4. Mverani Iye ati: idzanitu;
Tiyeni mudzamwone, idzanitu,
E! Akuitanani, idzanitu,
Ife tibvomereza,. Tibweratu.

hymns.title: Iwe tiye, iwe tiye
hymns.text:
1. Iwe tiye, iwe tiye,
Tiye tsopanoli;
Pano tiye kuli Yesu,Tiye. tsopanoli.
(Ndaima pano, ndaima pakhomo:
Lowa, lowa, lowa, lowa!
Ndaima pano, ndaima pakhomo!)

2. Akukonda, akukonda,
Tiye tsopanoli;
Pano akukonda iwe,
Tiye tsopanoli.

3. Akupeza, akupeza,
Tiye tsopanoli;
Pano akupeza iwe,
Tiye tsopanoli.

4. Salephera, salephera,
Tiye tsopanoli;
Pano salephera Iye,
Tiye tsopanoli.

5. Mvera Yesu, mvera Yesu,
Tiye tsopanoli;
Pano mvera Yesu iwe,
Tiye tsopanoli.

6. Aleluya, Aleluya,
Aleluya, Amen;
Aleluya, Aleluya,
Aleluya, Amen.

hymns.title: Tadza kukudyaku
Mwamva mawu a Mulungu
hymns.text:
1. Mwamva mawu a Mulungu;
Mukabvomeranjiko?
Kodi musandula mtima
Ndi kumvera Yesuyo?

Bvomerani, Bvomerani,
Bvomerani msangatu
Musazengereze ayi,
Landirani Yesuyo.

2. Munachita nthantha kale,
Musazengereze ’yi;
Yesu akulindirani,
Sadzakana inu ’yi.

3. Musaope pokumbuka
Zakuipa zanuzo;
Khulupirirani Yesu,
Adzachotsa zonsezo.

4. Perekani mtima wanu
Kwa Mulungu wathuyo;
Khulupirirani Yesu,
Wotifera kalelo.

hymns.title: Yesu wathu Mbuyeyo
hymns.text:
1. Yesu wathu Mbuyeyo
Alandira onsewo
Akuipa omwewo,
Osokera m’talimo.

Imba kawiri ndi kawirinso,
Yesu Ambuye sakanatu,
Mvetsa Uthenga Wabwinowo,
Wakuchimwa adzetu.

2. Idzatu kwa Yesuyo,
Apumitsa inunso,
Inde m’mtima mwanumo
Ndi mtendere wakewo.

3. Walandira inetu
Tsiku lija kalelo,
Wanditsuka ine mbuu
M’mtima mwanga momwemo.

4. Wandifera Yesuyo
Pansi pano kalelo,
Sindiopa mlanduwo
Pakubwera Iyeyo.

hymns.title: A! Mbusa wathu amvatu
hymns.text:
1. A! Mbusa wathu amvatu
Uko kuchipululuko
Zilira nkhosa zakezo,
Zili kuthengo kunjako.
Bwezatu, bwezatu,
Bweza zonse m’moopsyamo;
Bwezatu, bwezatu,
Bweza zakezo kwa Yesu.

2. Ndani afuna kunkako
Kukazipeza nkhosazo?
Ndani adzathandizako
Kuti zifunde m’kholamo?

3. M’tali mutali m’phirimo
Mvetsa, zilira nkhosazo;
A! Mbusa wathu atitu:
"Bweza zothodwa m’khkolamo."

4. Etu, zilira konseko
Zili m’phiri moopsyamo.
Imva, anena Mwiniyo:
"Kweye, upeze nkhosazo"

hymns.title: Thanthwe long’ambikatu
hymns.text:
1. Thanthwe long’ambikatu,
Ndibisale momwemu!
Madzi ndipo mwaziwo
Zotuluka m’nthitimo
Zonditsuke m’mtima mbuu!
Zindilimbikitsetu.

2. Ntchito zanga zonsezo
Sizikondweretsa ’Nu;
Ndikazigwiritsadi,
Ndikalira nsonizi,
Zonse sizikwanazi,
Koma Yesu yekhayo.

3. M’manja mopanda kanthu,
Mtanda ndingogwiradi;
’Maliseche mbveke ’ne;
Ndili ndekha, msunge ’ne;
Ndithawire m’mtsinjewo.
Munditsuke m’mtimamo.

4. M’moyo uno kunsiku
Pena ndimwaliratu,
M’mene ndidzakwerako
Tionane masowo;
Thanthwe long’ambikatu,
Ndibisale momwemu.

(Maiwe! Thanthwe long’ambikatu,
Ndibisale momwemu!)

hymns.title: Ambuye ’naitana ’ne
hymns.text:
1. Ambuye ’naitana ’ne:
’Dzapumulire kuno,
Tsamira mutu, mwana ’we,
M’chifuwa mwanga muno."

2. Ndabwera kwa Ambuyeyo:
Wolema, wachisoni;
Anandipulumutsako,
Nakondweretsa ine.

3. Ambuye naitana ’ne:
"Ndipatsa anthu madzi.
Wotopa ndi waludzu ’we,
Dzamwere moyo kuno."

4. Ndibwera kwa Ambuyeyo,
Ndamwera madzi awa;
Laleka ndithu ludzulo,
Tsopano moyo wadza.

5. Ambuye naitana ’ne:
"La dziko ndine Dzuwa,
Yang’ana Ine, kwacha ’we,
Wachoka mdima uja."

6. Ndayang’anira Mbuyeyo,
Ndapeza Dzuwa langa
Londiyendetsa bwinolo
Pa njira yonse yanga.

hymns.title: Yesu wondikondadi

lines: Ali nane, ali nane, ali nane, ali nane, Aa!

hymns.text:
1. Yesu wondikondadi,
Ndithawire mwanumo
Pakugunda mvulazi.
Pakubvuta madziwo,
Yesu mundibise ’ne!
Ikaleka mphepoyo
Tsidya ilo chete phee!
Mndilandire momwemo.

2. Pothawira pena ’yi,
Ndikhulupirira ’Nu;
Musasiye inedi,
Mundigwiriziretu.
Ndinu wothandiza ’ne,
Wolimbitsa mtimawu;
Pansi pamapiko phee!
Mundifungatiretu.

3. Wina sindifuna ’yi,
Zokhutitsa nzanuzo;
M’utsetu akugwawo,
Mchizetu odwalawo.
Ndine wakuipa bii!
Ndinu wakuyera mbuu!
Ndimadzala tchimoli,
Wolungama ndinutu.

4. Zindichulukirazi
Nsoni zanu m’mtimamu;
Zindichiza nthendazo,
Zindiyeretsa mbuu!
Pachitsime panupo
Moyo ndimwe ndimwebe;
Mubukatu m’mtimamo,
Mundidalitsetu ’ne.

(Mulungu ali nane!
Ali nane, ali nane, ali nane, ali nane, Aa!
Mulungu ali nane!)

hymns.title: Ndi inetu sinditha ’yi
hymns.text:
1. Ndi inetu sinditha ’yi
Kunenako milanduyi,
Kupempha zachisonizi;
Ndagonjatu Mbuyanga ’Nu.

(Aa! Mulungu wanga,
- Mundilembe pamphumipo!
Chidzakhala chizindikiro
Cha mpumulo ulinkudza ndi Yesu.)

2. Ndi ine sizitheka ’yi
Kuchoka zakuipazi;
Ndisambe m’mwazi wanuwo;
Ndagonjatu Mbuyamba ’Nu.

3. Ndi ine pondibvutapo
Kugwira nazo m’mtimamo,
Mundithandize monsemo;
Ndagonjatu Mbuyanga ’Nu.

4. Ndi ine ndasaukadi,
Zabwino m’mtima zonsezi
Mwa Inu ndingapezezi;
Ndagonjatu Mbuyanga ’Nu.

5. Ndi ine simufuna ’yi
Ndingatayike m’mdima bii,
Ndimvere mwandiuzazi;
Ndagonjatu Mbuyanga ’Nu.

6. Ndi ine, m’mtima Mwanu mbee!
Mokoma ndingakhalebe,
Ndikhale wanu wanudi;
Ndagonjatu Mbuyanga ’Nu.

7. Ndi inetu ndidziwedi
Chikondi chodabwitsachi
Pansipa ndi Kumwambako;
Ndagonjatu Mbuyanga ’Nu.

hymns.title: Ndikhulupira ’Nu
hymns.text:
1. Ndikhulupira ’Nu,
Mwana wa Mulungutu,
Mbuyangayo;
Mumve popempha ’ne,
Tchimo muchotsebe,
Lero ndikhale ’ne
Wa Mlunguyo.

2. Mzimu mndipatseko,
Wondilimbitsayo
Mumtimamu.
Munandiferadi;
Ndiyambe leroli
Kukonda Inu ndi
Mtimangawu.

3. Poyenda m’mdima bii,
M’mtimamo nsonizi
Mndigwirepo;
Mdima uchoke zi,
Msozi ulekedi,
Ndisasokere ’yi
Kwa Inuko.

4. Moyo ukatha zi,
Pofika imfadi,
Mndisungepo;
Yesu Mbuyanga ’Nu.
Mantha mthawitsetu,
Ndifike m’Mwambamo,
E, wanuyu.

hymns.title: Chitsimecho cha mwaziwo
hymns.text:
1. Chitsimecho cha mwaziwo
Udzera mwa Mbuyanga;
Wochimwa ndikasambamo,
Nditaya tchimo langa.

2. Wakuba uja nachiona,
Nangokhulupira,
Ambuye namva pempholo,
M’Mwambamo namlambira.

3. Ambuye, mwazi wanuwo
Siitha mphamvu yake,
E, mpaka Mpingo wonsewo
Wayera m;kati mwake.

4. Chionerere mwaziwo
Wofuma m’bala lanu,
Sindinaleke ineyo
Kutama mtima wanu.

5. Kumwamba komwe n’dzaimbira
Mpulumutsi wanga,
Chifukwa ayeneratu,
Wakonza m’mtima mwanga.

hymns.title: Yesu mundimve, ndikuliratu
hymns.text:
1. Yesu mundimve, ndikuliratu,
’Dzani kwa inetu;
Mtimangawu ufuna Inudi,
Bwerani, Yesudi.
Ndinasokeratu kutaliko,

Ndalekana naye Mulungudi;
Tsopano koma mndilandirenso,
Bwerani Yesudi.

2. Ndilibe malo mokhaliramo,
’Dzani kwa inetu;
Khalani nane m’mtima mwangamo,
Bwerani Yesudi.

3. Njobvuta njira ndimayendamo,
’Dzani kwa inetu;
Adetswa m’maso ndimapunthwamo,
Bwerani Yesudi.

4. Wolapa mtima simunyozadi,
’Dzani kwa inetu;
Pemphero mumve langa lonseli,
Bwerani Yesudi.

hymns.title: Ndilinkudza kwa Ambuye
hymns.text:
1. Ndilinkudza kwa Ambuye,
Ndisauka, ndinachimwa;
Zonse zanga ndizisiya,
Kudzapeza moyo wina.

Yesu ndikhulupirira
Munafera ine ndemwe;
Mwa umphamwi ndipemphera,
Mundipulumutse tere.

2. Kale ndinalira Inu,
Kale lomwe ndangochimwa;
Mund’tana, "Idza bwino,
Kuti nkuchotsere tchimo."

3. Yesu, n’kupatsani zonse,
Zili zanu zokhazokha,
Thupi lonse, mtima womwe,
Mwini wake ndinu nokha.

4. E, ndikukhulupirani,
Ndauona mwazi wanu;
Tere ndikugwadirani,
Tere ndapachikwa nanu.

5. Wadza Yesu wandidzoza,
Ndakonzeka mwa Iyeyu;
Ndine wake, tikondana,
Ndiyamika Mbuye Yesu.

hymns.title: Ndikhulupirira, Yesu
hymns.text:
1. Ndikhulupirira, Yesu,
Inu nokhadi
Mundipulumutsa konse
Leroli.

2. Kuti mukhululukira
Tchimo langalo
Ndi chifundo chachikulu
Chanucho.

3. Kuti muyeretsa mtima
Ndibvomeratu;
Mwazi wanu unditsuka
M’mtimamu.

4. Kuti munditsogolera
Paulendopo;
Mukwanitsadi zosowa
Zangazo.

5. Kuti mundipatsa mphamvu
Yopambanayo;
Mawu mndilonga m’kamwa
Mwangamo.

6. Ndikhulupirira, Yesu,
Mndibvomereko;
Ndine wanu lero, mawa,
Konseko.

hymns.title: Ndasiya zonse ndi Yesu kalelo
hymns.text:
1. Ndasiya zonse ndi Yesu kalelo,
Inde, zakuipa zangazo;
Anafera ine m’phirimo;
Pomva Mawu ake m’kondwako;
Mumachoka m’mtima
mwangamo nsonizo,
Mumachoka m’mtima
mwangamo nsonizo.

2. Chisoni andichotsera Mbuyeyu,
An’thandiza ine teretu;
Ndikhulupirira Iyeyu,
Andisunga m’manja mwakemu;
Alimbitsa mtima
wangawu teretu,
Alimbitsa mtima
wanga teretu.

3. Mtima ’we siya ndi Yesu nsonizi,
Usabisa tchimo lakoli;
Zichuluka mphamvu zakezi,
Likusunga dzanja lakeli;
Bwera kwa Mbuyathu
leroli mwana ’we,
Bwera kwa Mbuyathu
leroli mwana ’we.

hymns.title: Kwa Inu Yesu ndilira
Yesu, mulikundipempha
hymns.text:
1. Yesu, mulikundipempha,
Munaterodi:
"Mwana, gonja, ndikupatsa
Chimwemwe."

2. Kale ndinakana Inu,
Ndinathawatu;
Ndinazengereza, ndati:
"Mawatu."

3. Lero mtima ungolema,
Usaukadi;
Wina wakundimasula
Ndilibe.

4. Mbuye, ndingogonja tere,
Ndibvomerapo;
Mundithyole, mundikonze
M’mtimamo.

5. Chifuniro change, Mbuye,
Ndiperekachi;
Mutsogole, ndidzatsata
Inudi.

6. Tere moyo wanga wonse,
Mawu, ntchitonso
Zidzakondweretsa Inu
Zonsezo.

7. E, chimwemwe chachikulu,
N’taperekadi
Mtima wanga, ndimapeza
Mtendere.

hymns.title: Chitha nchiani kund’yeretsa
hymns.text:
1. Chitha nchiani kund’yeretsa?
Mwazi wa Ambuye Yesu;
Nchiani chindipulumutsa?
Mwazi wa Ambuye Yesu.

Chitsime ndi chokoma
Chindiyeretsa bwino;
Chinanso sindifuna,
Mwazi wa Ambuye ndiwo.

2. Mtanda m’mtima ndiyang’na,
Mwazi wa Ambuye Yesu;
Ndikhululukidwa nawo
Mwazi wa Ambuye Yesu.

3. Zonse zina sizikwana,
Mwazi wa Ambuye ndiwo;
Ntchito zanga sinditama,
Mwazi wa Ambuye ndiwo.

4. Ndikhulupirira bwino
Mwazi wa Ambuye Yesu;
Chilungamo change ndicho
Mwazi wa Ambuye Yesu.

hymns.title: Mndilandire ine Mbuye
hymns.text:
1. Mndilandire ine Mbuye
Yesu wondifera ’ne;
M’mtima mwanga muzikhala
Mawu anu okhawa.;

2. Ndasokera m’tali ndithu
M’njira zopwetekazo;
Wolemedwa ndingopempha,
Mndilandire inetu.

3. Pakukumbukira zanga
Ndili ndi manyazitu;
Ndingogwera pansi, ’Tate,
Mlapo wandigwiratu.

4. Ndingopatsa Inu Mbuye
M’manja mwanu mtimawu,
Moyo, mzimu, zonse zanga,
Mzilandire Mbuyetu.

5. Mukhululukire ine,
’Tate mundikondadi;
Mundisunge nthawi zonse
Ndi chikondi chomwechi.

hymns.title: A Chikondi chopambana
hymns.text:
1. A Chikondi chopambana,
E, chinadza ndi Mbuye;
Chinasangalatsa m’Mwamba,
Chinalowanso mwa ’fe.
Yesu ndinu wachifundo,
Wa chikondi changwiro.
Ee, mulowetu m’mtimanga,
Mumuyese mwanutu.

2. ’Dzanitu Wamphamvu yonse,
Mtilanditse konseko;
Musachoke, thandizeni,
Muchotse mwangamu:
Inu nokha timakuza
Ndititumikirabe;
Tinyadira chikondicho,
Tichitame konseko.

3. Tsirizani ntchito yanu
Yakulenganso ife;
Idzakhalatu yangwiro,
Ndiyo yoyenera ’Nu;
Usinthika ’lemu wathu,
Udzakula momwemo,
Mpakatu Kumwamba komwe
Tidzalemekeza ’Nu.

hymns.title: Ndilikuva m’mtima mwanga
hymns.text:
1. Ndilikuva m’mtima mwanga
Mawu ake a Mbuyanga,
Ati, "Ndakukonda iwe,
Kodi undikonda Ine?"

2. Ati: "Mwana, kumbukira
Zonse ndinakuchitira;
Ndakukonda, ndakuferea,
Ndakufuna posokera.

3. "Ku zoipa zonse zako,
Goli la pakhosi pako,
Ndi kunthenda zosautsa
Ndine ndakupulumutsa.

4. "Kodi mayi wobereka
Mwana wake adzamleka?
Pena adzamwalira,
Koma ndikukumbukira.

5. "Nthawi ilikudza yonse
Sindisinthanika konse;
Imfa sindiletsa Ine
Ndisakondekonde iwe.

6. "Ine ndidzakuonetsa
Zonse zakukondweretsa
Za Kumwamba zanga izo,
Mwana, sundikonda ine?"

7. Ambuyanga, ndalephera,
Mwachisoni ndipemphera
Mundipatse ine ndithu
Mtima wakukonda Inu.

hymns.title: Ati Yesu Mbuyeyo
hymns.text:
1. Ati Yesu Mbuyeyo:
"Ofoka ndinutu,
Mudikire, mpemphedi,
Ndidzapatsa mphamvutu.”

Yesu wathadi
Za mangawatu,
Inde ndinaipa bii!
Watsuka ine mbuu!

2. Mbuye ndimva leroli
Za mphamvu zanuzi
Zomwe zisandutsadi
Mtima wanga woti bii!

3. Ine kanthu ndilibe
Kogula moyowu;
Ndingotsuka m’mtimamo
M’mwazi wa Ambuye ’Nu.

4. M’mene ndifa inedi,
Kumwamba mzimuwu
Udzakwera komweko
Kuonana Mbuyeyo.

5. Ndipo pakuima phe!
Pokhala Yesuyo,
Ndidzamtama Mlunguyo
Kosaleka konseko.

hymns.title: Lindikomera dzina la Ambuye Yesu wanga

lines: Lindikomera dzina la Ambuye Yesu wanga,
Lindikomera dzina la Ambuye Yesu wanga.
Lidyetsa mtima wonse, lipumitsa thupi langa.
Nlokoma dzinalo la Yesu, ndilo thanthwe langa,

hymns.text:
1. Lindikomera dzina la Ambuye Yesu wanga,
Lisangalatsa, lichiritsa, lin’chotsera mantha.
Dzinalo la Yesu,
Dzinalo la Yesu!

Lindikomera dzina la Ambuye Yesu wanga.

2. Lichiza mzimu wophwetekwa ukakhale bata,
Lidyetsa mtima wonse, lipumitsa thupi langa.

3. Nlokoma dzinalo la Yesu, ndilo thanthwe langa,
Chikopa changa, linga langa
m’mene ndibisala.

4. Ambuye ndinu Mbusa, Bwenzi, ndi
Wansembe wanga,
Ndi Mfumu, Moyo, Njira yomwe,
Inu ndimatama.

5. Tsopano ndibukitsabe chikondi chanu chija,
Pakufa ine Dzina lanu lindilimbikitsa.

hymns.title: Ndidzaimba za Mulungu
hymns.text:
1. Ndidzaimba za Mulungu,
Za kukonda kwakeko;
Anatuma Mwana wake
Kundifera kalelo.

Inde ndidzaimba nyimbo
Za kukonda kwakeko,
Ndidzaimba ndi angelo
Akukhala m’Mwambamo.

2. Ndinachita mphulupulu,
Waiwala zonsezo!
Ndinakhala ndi zoipa,
Wazichotsa zonsezo!

3. Wandipatsa moyo wake,
Moyo wakuyera mbuu!
Ine ndili mwana wake,
Wandilera inetu.

4. Ndiyamika Mbuye wanga
Ndidzamlemekezabe;
Ndipititsa mbiri yake
Ya kukonda kwakeko.

hymns.title: Bwenzi ndinamkomanayo
hymns.text:
1. Bwenzi ndinamkomanayo
Anandikonda kale;
Kukonda kwandigwirako,
M’kukondamo nditsale.
Kumtima kundimangako
Kosamasuka konse;
Ambuye ndine wanutu
Kunthawi nthawi zonse.

2. Bwenzi ndinamkomanayo
Anandifera yekha,
Anandipatsa moyowo,
Ndatenga ine ndekha.
Zimene ndili nazozi
Nza Yesu mwini zonse,
Ndi moyo wanga wonse ndi
Wakenso nthawi zonse.

3. Bwenzi ndinamkomanayo,
Ndapeza mphamvu zanga,
Zakundisunga inemo,
Ndiyende m’njira mwanga.
Zolemerera zoti mbee!
Zindilimbitsa monse;
Ndalema kuno, komweko
N’kupuma nthawi zonse.

4. Bwenzi ndimamkomanayo
Wokoma mtima wake,
Wotsogolera nzeruzo
Zisunga m’njira mwake.
Palibe wondichotsa ’ne
Kwa Iye wondikonda;
Pamoyo, imfa, nayeyo
Ndilipo nthawi zonse.

hymns.title: Ndimkonde Kristuyo
hymns.text:
1. Ndimkonde Kristuyo,
Ndimkondebe;
Pemphero langali
Mlandiretu;
Ndipempha Inutu,
Ndimkonde Kristuyo,
Ndimkondebe,
Ndimkondebe.

2. Ndatsatatsatabe
Za pansipa;
Ndisiye zonsezi,
Nditsate ’Nu.
M’mtimanga wonsewu
Ndimkonde Kristuyo,
Ndimkondebe,
Ndimkondebe.

3. Chisoni chonsecho
Chidzatha phe!
Angelo anuwo
Afiketu;
Nawo ndiimbetu,
Ndimkonde Kristuyo,
Ndimkondebe,
Ndimkondebe.

4. Pakufa pangapo
Ndinenebe;
Myamiko wangawu
Ndikwezebe,
Ndidzapempheradi,
Ndimkonde Kristuyo,
Ndimkondebe,
Ndimkondebe.

hymns.title: Mwakhulupiriradi
hymns.text:
1. Mwakhulupiriradi
Yesu Ambuyathu;
Muli nazo zakezo,
Zidzatu zinanso.
Mlungu wachisomocho
Mbuye wathu ndiye,
Ati zinthu zonsezo
Nzatha mwa Iyeyo.

(Zina ndi zinanso
Zidza kwa ifedi,
Inde mtima wakewo
Uli wokomadi.)

2. Mwamva Yesu m’mtimamo,
Adzanso kawiri,
M’mene ali nanutu
Muli ndi chimwemwe.
Ntchito zachifundozi
Iye watha izi,
Kuti mwawo m’Mwambamo
Naye tikhalebe.

3. Mwamva Mzimu wakewo,
Zake zimvekanso
Kugwa ngati mvulayo
Yachisomo chake.
Mzimu ndiye mphamvudi
M’moyo mwathu muno,
Mpaka tidzafikako
Komwe kuli Yesu.

hymns.title: Poyambapo ndakondwadi
hymns.text:
1. Poyambapo ndakondwadi,
N’tapeza Inu Mbuyetu,
Ndiimba nyimbo yomweyi,
Kukondwa sindikhala duu!

Kalelo! Kalelo!
Wandisambitsa m’mtimamo,
Wandiweruza lomwelo,
Kupempha ndi kukondwako.
Kalelo! Kalelo!
Wandisambitsa m’mtimamo.

2. Mnyamata wake ndinetu,
Ndimvera Mawu akewo;
Ndampatsa mtima wonsewu,
Ndimtumikire pansipa.

3. Kumwamba ndidzanenadi
Za chipangano chathucho.
Wamoyo sindimsiya ’yi,
Nditafa ndinka kwawoko.

hymns.title: Ambuyanga Yesu
hymns.text:
1. Ambuyanga Yesu,
N’kukondani Inu;
Ndisiya zoipa
Chifukwa cha Inu.
Ambuye wabwino
Mndipulumutse konse;
Ndikonda tsopano
Koposa kale lonse.

2. Ndikonda chifukwa
Mnayamba kukonda;
Mnafera pamtengo,
Munandiwombola.
Mukhululukira
Zoipa zanga zonse;
Ndikonda tsopano
Koposa kale lonse.

3. Ndidzakukondani
Mwa moyo ndi m’imfa;
Ndidzakutamani;
Chikondi n’dzaimba.
Mpakatu ndidzafa,
N’dzanena nthawi zonse;
"Ndikonda tsopano
Koposa kale lonse."

hymns.title: Ambuye, m’imfamo
hymns.text:
1. Ambuye, m’imfamo
Munakonda ine;
Sindikaniza ’Nu
Kanthu konse ’yi.
Ndimagwadira ’Nu,
ndikonda m’mtimamu,
Ndidzaperekatu
Nsembe yangayi.

2. Kumwamba kwanuko
Mundipempherere;
Ndikhulupirako,
N’dzalandiradi;
Ndisenze mtandawo,
Ndikhale mboniyo,
Ndikaperekeko
Mitoloyi.

3. Ndikhumba mtimawo
Wofatsa ndithu,
Kuti ndiyamba ’ne
Ntchito zanuzi;
Akusokerawo,
Ofuna zawowo
Abwere kwawoko,
Inde, kwanutu.

4. Zambiri zangazo
Mnandipatsa kale,
Ndibweza zonsezi
Kwa Mbuyanga ’Nu;
Ndikadzaona ’Nu,
Mbuye wabwinotu,
Nsembe yokomatu
Ndidzakhalabe.

hymns.title: Wafunafuna ine
hymns.text:
1. Wafunafuna ine
Ambuye Yesuyo;
Wapeza ine ndithu
Wodwala m’mtimamo;
Zochimwa zanga zonsezo
Wachotsa izo zomwezo.

E! chikondi ndithu,
E! chikondi ndithu,
Ndi chisomo chake chonsecho,
Ndi zozizwa zake zonsezo.

2. Ndafoka ine kale,
Ndafuna kufaku;
Anadza kundichiza
Zinthenda zangazo;
Ndi mwazi wake woti pyu!
Ndayera nawo m’mtimamu.

3. Mabala ake m’manja
Ndaona indetu,
Ndi minga ya pamutu
Yolasa Mbuyeyu;
Etu, wakonda inedi,
Pamtandapo kufera ’ne.

4. Ndikhumba ine ndithu
Madalo akewo;
Ndifuna kumyamika
Masiku onsewo;
Ndikafa ine pansipa,
Kumwamba ndidzamtamanso.

hymns.title: Ambuye Mulungu
hymns.text:
1. Ambuye Mulungu,
Ndikondwera maka,
Ndapeza chimwemwe
Ndi moyo wosatha.

Aleluya, mlemekeze,
Aleluya, ndiye Mfumu;
Aleluya, mumpembedze
Ambuye Mulungu.

2. Ambuyanga Yesu
Nandikhetsera mwazi,
Nakonzera ine
Milandu yangayi.

3. Pamtanda woopsa
Adakandifera,
Natsuka m’mtimanga
Mukhale moyera.

4. Tsopano Mulungu
Alandira ine,
Popeza Mbuyanga
Nawombola ine.

5. Padziko lapansi
Ndikumva chisoni,
Komatu Kumwamba
Ndikhala ndi Mboni.

hymns.title: Imfa ndi mfumu ya mdimawo
hymns.text:
1. Imfa ndi mfumu ya mdimawo,
Anthu oipa imangawo,
Akristu amapulumuka.
Omwe aimbira moyo,
Moyo ndi moyo ndi moyo,
Wosalekana ndi moyo
Wosamaliza Mulunguyo.

2. Yesu anafa pamtandapo,
Mzimu woipa nugomapo,
Ndi ife titame Mulungu,
Ndife tamasudwa m’moyo,
Imfa ithedwa ndi moyo,
Tsiku lomaliza moyo
Wosamaliza Kumwambako.

3. M’mitima mwathu mwakhala mbee!
Mtanda wamdima wang’ambwa ke!
Panyanjapo pagawanika.
Ndife tipita ku moyo,
Mtima wabwino ndi moyo;
Kumbanda kucha kwa moyo
Kumatiuza za dzuwalo.

4. Akumangidwa ndi mzimuwo,
Mudze ndi ife kwa Yesuko,
Akuchotserani magoli,
Nadzakupatsani moyo,
Mlandu walipa ndi moyo,
Moyo ndi moyo ndi moyo
Tiimbirana za moyowo.

hymns.title: Adalitsika munthuyo
hymns.text:
1. Adalitsika munthuyo
Wopeza dalo lomwelo
Chisomocho cha Mlunguyo
Chogwera m’Mpingo wakewo.

2. Chikhulupiro chomwenso
Chogweratu m’chikondicho;
Akhala nazo nzeruzi
Zofumatu mwa Mbuyedi.

3. Adalitsika, indetu,
Wodziwa wadza Yesuyu
Nafera iye kalelo
Ampatse moyo wosatha.

4. Akondwerera nthawiyi
Pomvera mwini Mlungudi;
Mtendere ngwake panotu,
Nakhala nawo m’Mwambanso.

hymns.title: Ndidziwitsitsa Yesu ndi wanga
hymns.text:
1. Ndidziwitsitsa Yesu ndi wanga,
Tsiku ndi tsiku ndimakondwera.
Anandigula ndi mwazi wake,
Anandipatsa Mzimu woyera.

Mawu omwewo, nyimbo yomweyi,
Yesu ndimtama tsiku lonseli;
Mawu omwewo, nyimbo yomweyi,
Yesu ndimtama tsiku lonseli.

2. N’kamvera Yesu ndikakondwera,
Ndiyang’anitsa nkhopeyo yake;
Ndipo angelo anditengera
Ine chisomo ndi chuma chake.

3. Ndine kapolo wa Mbuye wanga;
Andigwirtsa zintchito zake.
Ndimyembekeza adzabweranso,
Adzanditenga kwawo ndikhale.

hymns.title: Sindinanyengedwa konse
hymns.text:
1. Sindinanyengedwa konse
Pakutsata Yesuyo;
Yesu apambana zonse
Ndinalingalirazo.
Pakuyenderana naye
Ndimamdziwa ndi woona;
Ndifunitsa anthu onse
Adziwenso Yesuyo!
Ndifunitsa anthu onse
Adziwenso Yesuyo!

2. Sindinanyengedwa konse;
Yesu wachotsera phe!
Zakuchimwa zanga zonse
Zakupsinja mtimazo.
Yesu potsagana nane
Wandidzaza ndi mtendere;
Kundisunga, kundikonda
Sadzaleka konse ’yi!
Kundisunga, kundikonda,
Sadzaleka konse ’yi!

3. Sindinanyengedwa konse,
Yesu adzabwerabe;
Mtima wanga udiuza
Akuyandikiradi.
Omwe sangamzindikire
Andinyoza nandijeda,
Koma Yesu ati zedi:
"Ine ndidzabweradi."
Koma Yesu ati zedi:
"Ine ndidzabweradi."

4. Sandinyenga, salephera;
Yesu wadalitsa ’ne,
Mpulumutsi ndi Myeretsi
Ndi Mchiritsi yemweyo.
Wandiyanjanitsa naye,
Mtima wanga nakhutitsa;
Sindinanyengedwa konse,
Yesu akwaniradi!
Sindinanyengedwa konse,
Yesu akwaniradi!

hymns.title: Mulungu wanga
hymns.text:
1. Mulungu wanga,
Ndapeza moyo;
Ndili wokondwera
Masiku onse.

Aleluya, muyenera!
Aleluya, Amen.
Aleluya, ndidzamtama
Mulungu wanga.

2. Mwazi wa Yesu
Unditsukatu,
Ndiye Mbuye wanga
Ndi Mpulumutsi.

3. Pamtanda wake
’Nafera ine,
Ndi zoipa zanga
’Nazichotsadi.

4. Mulungu wanga
Andilandira,
Chifukwa cha Yesu
Mwana wakeyo.

5. Adzabweranso
Kundilandira
Ndikhale ndi Iye
Masiku onse.

hymns.title: Tili ndi mtendere
hymns.text:
1. Tili ndi mtendere
Wopambanatu,
Monga ngati mtsinje
Mumitimamo;
Koma mtsinje uno
Umayenda phee,
Nthawi zonse mtima
Nutonthozabe.

Tikakhulupira
Mlungu wathuyo,
Tidzaona mwayi
Ndi mtenderewo.

2. Dzanja la Mulungu
Litisunga nji!
Nkhondo ya Satana
Sitiopa ’yi.
Zaphokoso zonse
Ndi zoopsyazo
Sizibvuta mtima,
Sizilowamo.

3. Masauko athu
Ndi zokondwazo,
Azilola zonse
Ndi Atatewo.
Ponkhulupirira
Tidzapezabe
Kuti mtima wake
Utikonda ’fe.

hymns.title: Yesu ndiye Mbuye wanga
hymns.text:
1. Yesu ndiye Mbuye wanga,
Ndamva Mawu akewo;
Anandilandira ine,
Nandipulumutsatu.

Mwalembedwa mukalata
Mawu ake omwewo,
Kuti iwo akumvera
Akalandiridwatu.

2. Ndinakhala wakuipa,
Ndinamkana kalelo;
Koma Yesu waiwala
Mphulupulu zangazo.

3. Wapumitsa mtima wanga,
Kaamba ndaphunziratu
Mawu ake olembedwa
Mukalata mwakemo.

4. Mumvetu abwenzi athu,
Musakanirire ’yi;
Yesu aitana inu,
Zalembedwa zomwezi.

hymns.title: Mtendere uli m’mtima mwathumu
hymns.text:
1. Mtendere uli m’mtima mwathumu,
Chifukwa mwazi watitsuka mbuu!

2. Zakutsogolo sitidziwa ’yi;
Adziwa Yesu wathu zonsezi.

3. Abale angakhale m’talimo
Mbuyathu asungira onsewo.

4. Imfa ndi manda sitiopa ’yi,
Chifukwa Yesu wazithetsadi.

5. Mtendere wapambana
m’Mwambamo
Pakufa ife tidzaonanso.

hymns.title: Ndiimba mumtima mokondwa
hymns.text:
1. Ndiimba mumtima mokondwa
Ndi nyimbo yokoma yoyera;
Ndiimba za Yesu Mbuyanga,
Anditonthoza ’ne phee!

Chete! Chete!
M’mtima mtenderemu phee!
Udzera kwa Yesu wokonda
Mtendere mumtimamu.

2. Pamtanda Mbuyanga ’nafera,
Akandichotsera zochimwa;
Anandigulira mtendere,
Anditonthoza ’ne phee!

3. Pomulambira Yesu Mbuyanga,
Mumtima mtendere walowa;
Mdalitso woposa ndapeza,
Anditonthoza ’ne phee!

4. Pokonda Yesuyo, mtendere!
Kunthawi zosatha, mtendere!
Potsata Mbuyanga apatsa
Mtendere mumtimamu.

hymns.title: Khalani duu! Ambuye adzatu
hymns.text:
1. Khalani duu! Ambuye adzatu;
Senzani chete mtanda wanuwo;
Mulungu adzakonza zanuzo,
Sangasinthike mtima Iyeyu.
Khalani duu! Bwenzilo Yesuyo
Atsogolera m’njira mwathumu.

2. Khalani duu! Mulungu wanuyu
Akonzeratu nthawi zonsedi;
Musakayike mtima; zo’psyazo
Zimasulidwa pomalizapo.
Khalani duu! A Yesu mawuwo
Ngamphamvu lero monga kalelo.

3. Khalani duu! Pakufa mnzathuyo,
Pakumlira ndi misoziyo;
Panthawizo abwera Yesutu,
Mitima yathu natonthazadi.
Khalani duu! Ambuye athadi
Kutibwezera zochotsedwazi.

4. Khalani duu! Pakufa ifetu,
Ndi Yesu tidzakhala indetu
Popanda mantha ndi zowawazi,
Chikondi chokha koma m’mtimamo.
Khalani duu! Pakutha zonse phe
Tidzasonkhana tonse kuli ’Ye.

hymns.title: Namondwe akawombabe
hymns.text:
1. Namondwe akawombabe,
Mafunde akakulanso,
Palipo pobisala ’fe,
Ndi popemphera Yesuyo.

2. Paja athira Yesutu
Chimwemwe muli m’manthamo,
Paja pokometsatu
Mwazi wa Yesu nukhapo.

3. Pakulekana ifetu
Mitima ikomanapo;
Tikumbukana ’bwezi ’fe,
Popemphererana komweko.

4. Tidzathawira kuti ’fe
Pochita mantha nkhawanso?
Pakuyesedwa, tinke ku?
Tipemphe Yesu mphamvuyo.

5. Tikhale ndithu pomwepo;
Zapansi zisalowe ’yi.
Sitidzapempha m’Mwambamo;
Tidzayamika Mlungudi.

hymns.title: Mulungu anditsogolera
hymns.text:
1. Mulungu anditsogolera,
Ndapumula m’mtimamo;
Ayang’anira njira zanga zonsezo.

Mulungu anditsogolera
Nsiku zanga zonsezo;
Ndidzatsatira Mbuye wanga
M’njira mwake momwemo.

2. Masiku ena pali mdima,
Ndibvutidwa m’mtimamo;
Masiku ena ndikondwera
Ndi zabwino zangazo.

3. Masiku onse m’mtima mwanga
Ndili ndi mtenderewo,
Chifukwa ndimakhulupira
Mtsogoleri wangayo.

hymns.title: M’mene ine ndisauka
hymns.text:
1. M’mene ine ndisauka
Ndi zoipa zangazo,
Ndidzapita lwa Mulungu,
Adzandilandiratu.

Mlungu adzandilandila,
Iye ndiye ’Tate wanga;
Watumiza Mwana wake
Andifere kalelo.

2. Ngatitu abwenzi anga
Sandikonda ine ’yi,
Ndikhulupirire Mlungu,
Iye sandikana ’yi.

3. Pansi pano ndili mlendo,
Kwathu ndi Kumwambako;
M’mene ndimwalira ine
Ndidzapita komweko.

hymns.title: Mbuyanga Yesu, mundigwire dzanja
hymns.text:
1. Mbuyanga Yesu, mundigwire dzanja;
Kuyenda ndekha sindikwana ’yi;
Mukandigwira dzanja langa, Mbuye,
Sindikaopa kanthu kena ’yi.

2. Mbuyanga Yesu, mundisunge ine
Pafupi ndi ’Nu nthawi yonseyo;
Ndikasowatu Inu, Mpulumutsi,
Ndingosokera m’talimo.

3. Mbuyanga Yesu, ndikapanda Inu
Ukadza mdima m’mtima mwangamu;
Koma ndinutu dzuwa langa ndithu
Lakuwalitsa m’mtima momwemu.

4. Mbuyanga Yesu, mundigwire dzanja
Pamene ine ndimwalirapo.
Mkhaletu m’fupi nthawi yomwe Mbuye,
Mundilowetse ine m’Mwambamo.

hymns.title: Ndifuna Inu, Yesu
hymns.text:
1. Ndifuna Inu, Yesu,
Ndadzala ndi machimo,
Mumzimu muli mdima,
Ndikufatu m’katimo.
Ndifuna kutsukika
M’chitsimecho cha mwazi
Wa Inu wokondedwa,
Munandifera kale.

2. Ndifuna Inu, Yesu,
Lisowa bwenzi lina
Losungiritsa ine,
Londithandiza mwina.
Ndifuna mtima wanu
Wodziwa nkhawa zanga,
Wondisenzera mtolo
Wa tchimo lonse langa.

3. Ndifuna Inu, Yesu,
Ndimasauka ndithu,
M’ulendo andisowa
Kambayo wa padziko.
Ndifunanso chikondi
Cha Inu chondisunga,
Chakundisangalatsa
Panjira ponse panga.

4. Ndifuna Inu, Yesu,
Ndidzaonana nanu,
Mudzadza pamitambo
Ikhale mpando wanu;
Pamodzi ndi ananu
Ndidzakondwera kuti;
Ndilemekeze Inu,
Ambuye, Mpulumutsi.

hymns.title: Ndifuna Yesuyo
hymns.text:
1. Ndifuna Yesuyo
Ambuyanga,
M’mtendere ndinkemo
Mwa Iyeyu.

Ndifuna Inu Yesu,
Nthawiyi ndifuna;
Kwa Yesu Ambuyathu
Ndifunako.

2. Ndifuna Yesuyo
Mobvutamo,
Ndipulumukemo
Mwa Iyeyo.

3. Ndifuna Yesuyo
Mokondwa ndi
Mowawa, adzemo
Ndi moyodi.

4. Ndifuna Yesuyo,
Ndichite ’ne
Zofuna zakezo,
Ndidzazebe.

5. Ndifuna Yesuyo
Woyeratu,
Ndikhale wakeyo
Wa Iyeyu.

hymns.title: Mtima wa Mbuyako
hymns.text:
1. Mtima wa Mbuyako
Ukukonda ’we;
Ndiye wakuona
Wopirirabe;
Ukasowa bwenzi,
Usaope ’yi;
Chikondano chake
Chikwaniradi.

2. Akukumbukira
Yesu yemweyo;
M’kuyanjana naye
Muli moyomo.
Uderanji nkhawa?
Mpulumutsiyo
Atisamalira,
Atisungatu.

3. M’munda wa Mbuyako
Muli ntchitomo;
Amithenga ake
Aigwirayo.
Usaime chabe,
Usakhale duu!
Yesu akufuna
Umthandizetu.

4. Kwawo kwa Mbuyako
Udzafikako;
Mwa ulemerero
Udzapuma phee!
Usalowerere,
Mvera Yesuyo,
Ati: "Mwana wanga,
Bwera kwathuko."

hymns.title: Pamene ndisauka
hymns.text:
1. Pamene ndisauka,
Pamene ndibvutidwa,
Mizimu yakuipa
Ikadza nindiyesa,

Mulungu wanga,
Mwini mphamvu,
Mkandikumbukire ’ne.

2. Pamene ndilemedwa
Ndi zakuipa zanga,
Polowa mdima m’mtima,
Pochita ine mantha,

3. Masiku anga onse
Mulungu mundisunge;
Pamene ndimwalira,
Ndi tsiku lomaliza,

hymns.title: Khala chete mtima wanga
hymns.text:
1. Khala chete mtima wanga
Mlungu wako ndiye Mfumu;
