Zinthu zonse zisinthika,

Mlungu ndi wachikhalire.
(Khala chete,
Chidzakupinga ninji?
Usaope,
Mulungu ali nawe.)

2. Anthu onse pansi pano
Sakhutitsa mtima wawo;
Amadera zinthu zawo,
Namakhumba zakutali.

3. Khala chete mtima wanga,
Zikwanire zinthu zako;
Usakhumbe zapansipa,
Koma Mlungu wako yekha.

hymns.title: Ngati mtima sumakonda
hymns.text:
1. Ngati mtima sumakonda
Yesu, supumula bwino;
Mbuye, suwu mtima wanga,
Ndiwo wanu, mulandire.

2. Dziko lonse ndilitaya;
Ndikondetsa Yesu Mbuye;
An’komera kopambana
Andikondweretsa ndiye.

3. Ndakudani, mnandikonda
Ndi kukhetsa mwazi wanu.
Simuleka kundikonda;
Ine sindidzalekanso.

4. Mndisungire mtima wanga,
Uzikhalupira Inu,
Kuti moyo wanga wonse
Ubisaletu mwa Yesu.

hymns.title: Njira yanga sindidziwa
hymns.text:
1. Njira yanga sindidziwa,
’Tate muikonza;
Komatu ndizindikira
Kuti mundikonda.

2. M’mene mantha andigwira,
Andidetsa m’mtima,
Mbuye, ndithawire kwanu
Poti mundikonda.

3. Sindidziwatu zamawa,
Koma sindiopa;
Ndidzakhulupira Inu
Kuti mundikonda.

4. Inde wakukonda ndinu;
Mawuwo oona
Andidzaza ndi chimwemwe:
Mlungu andikonda.

hymns.title: Odala ndi onsewo
hymns.text:
1. Odala ndi onsewo
Oyera m’mtima mwawo;
Adzaonana ndi Mulungu,
Yesu ndiye wawo.

2. Ambuye anachoka
Kumwamba, Mwini moyo,
Wofatsa anakhala nafe,
Mfumu yachisomo.

3. Mumtima wakufatsa
Akonda kukhalabe;
Asankha mtima wakuyera,
Ndiwo nuymba yake.

4. Tifuna Inu, Mbuye,
Mtininkhe mtima uwu
Wodzichepetsa, wakuyera,
Woyenera Inu.

hymns.title: Mndiyandikitse nanu, Yesu
hymns.text:
1. Mndiyandikitse nanu, Yesu,
Ndiyenderane nanu;
E, nditsamire panu, Yesu,
Panjira yonseyi.

2. Ndionetsere kuunika
Kokoma kwanu, Yesu!
Yabwino mbiri ndibukitse
Yokondweretsayo.

3. Chitsime chakuyera ine
Ndifanefane nacho;
Mundigwiritse ntchito zanu
E! zanu zokhazo.

4. Mulamulire mtima, Yesu,
Ndi chifuniro changa;
Mulowe mwanga ngati Mfumu;
Mundimveretsedi.

5. Ndimamva njala kuno, Yesu,
Yakufunitsa Inu;
Kumwamba kwanu ndikukhumba
Kukondwa nanuko.

hymns.title: Khala mwa Ine," Yesu anatero
hymns.text:
1. "Khala mwa Ine," Yesu anatero;
Mawu abwino, koma Mbuye wanga
Sin’ngathe ndekha, mukhalitse ine
Mwa ’Nu ndikhale nawo moyotu.

2. "Khala mwa Ine," munachotsa tsoka,
Mletse Satana anganyenge ine;
Mibvi yamoto yake muizime
M’mtimamo, ndikhulupirire ’Nu.

3. "Khala mwa Ine," ndinu mwini
mphamvu,
Mundithandize ine ndikafoka;
Mzimu Woyera andiululire
Zoona zanu m’mtima mwangamu.

4. "Khala mwa Ine," ndinu mwini moyo,
Nthambi zouma zidulidwa m’mtengo;
Ine wopanda Inu ndifokanso,
Zipatso zikasowa msadze ’ne.

5. "Khala mwa Ine," Mbuye, ndifunitsa;
Mzimu Woyera mlonge m’mtima mwanga,
Akagonjetsetu machimo anga
Mtima woyera andipatsenso.

hymns.title: Ambuye mundisunge
hymns.text:
1. Ambuye mundisunge
Pafupi ndinutu;
Palibe malo pena
Popuma pansipa.
Adani andizinga,
Zoipa m’katimo;
Chifundo chanu Yesu
Chikonze m’mtimamo.

2. Ndikabisala mwanu
Ndilibe mantha ’yi;
Ndikasungidwa kwanu
Mumtima muti phee!
Ndi mphamvu yanu yokha
Ndiposa ’daniwo;
Chifundo chanu Mbuye
Chitchinjirize ’ne.

3. Ndidzaonana nanu
Mokondwadi.
Oyera mtima onse
Apenya Mbuyeyo.
Kumwamba n’dzaimbira
Kukoma kwanuku;
N’dzatama nthawi zonse
Chikondi chanucho.

hymns.title: Khalatu woyera
hymns.text:
1. Khalatu woyera,
Pempheratu m’tseri;
Werengani Mawu
Masiku onsewo.
Uthangate omwe
Ali akufoka,
Madalitso ake
Ufunefunebe.

2. Khalatu woyera,
Dziko laipadi;
Pemphera kolimba
Kwa Yesu Mbuyathu.
Yang’anitsa Yesu
Ndi kumutsatira,
Kuti anthu ena
Aonenso Iye.

3. Khalatu woyera
Akutsogozetu;
Usamtsogolere
Munjira zakozo.
Pokondwa ndi m’nsoni
Tsata Ambuyako.
Khulupira Yesu
Ndi Mawu akewo.

4. Khalatu woyera,
Khalatu wofatsa;
Alilamulire
Ganizo lakolo
Utatsogozedwa
Ndi Mzimu wakeyo,
Msanga udzagwira
M’Mwamba ntchito yake.

hymns.title: Mudzaze Yesu mtima wanga ndi chikondicho

lines: Mudzaze Yesu mtima wanga ndi chikondicho,
Mwa ine myatse moto wanu wakuyera mbuu,
Ndi Yesu ndikondanetu, si kanthu kena ai.

hymns.text:
1. Mudzaze Yesu mtima wanga ndi chikondicho,
Ukhazikike pa Mulungu wosachokapo.

2. Mwa ine myatse moto wanu wakuyera mbuu,
Utenthemo zoipa zonse zidakhalamo.

3. Mubweretu nomwe ’Nu munatsika kalelo;
Ndilira Ine mundidzaze mphamvu yanuyo.

4. Ndikhazikike inetu, mumtima muli mwai,
Ndi Yesu ndikondanetu, si kanthu kena ai.

hymns.title: Mbuye ndamva mwawazira
hymns.text:
1. Mbuye ndamva mwawazira
Anthu ena madalitso;
Mvula yanu yawagwera;
Mbuye, ine mudalitse.

Etu ine, etu ine,
Mbuye, ine mudalitse.

2. ’Tate msandipitirire,
Ndimaipa mtima ine
Ndiyenera munditaye,
Koma mukhululukire.

3. Yesu, msandipitirire
Kuti ndinu ndikondane;
Ndinalira Inu Mbuye,
Msandileke poitana.

4. Mzimu, msandipitirire,
Mupenyetsatu akhungu;
Mboniyo ya Mbuye Yesu,
Mundipatse ine mphamvu.

5. Ndinagona mwa zoipa,
Ndinakunyozani ine,
Dziko lino ndinakonda,
Mbuye, mukhululukire.

6. Ha! Chikondi cha Mulungu,
Mwazi wa Mbuyathu Yesu,
Chiyanjano cha Mzimuyo,
Zonse ndidzalemekeza.

hymns.title: Ambuye, thandizenitu
hymns.text:
1. Ambuye, thandizenitu
Ndi mphamvu zanuzo;
Pantchito zathu zonsezi
Mthandize Mbuyathu.

2. Zochimwa zathu m’mtimamo
Tilira nazotu;
Mumtima mwathu muti zii;
Mthandize Mbuyathu.

3. Mthandize Mbuye, timvetu,
Tikalandiredi
Zimene muperekazo
Zakudalitsa ’fe.

4. Kumwamba Yesu mthandize,
Tilibe wina ’yi;
M’moyo muimfa mthandize,
Tikhale kwanuko.

hymns.title: Pokhala mtendere mu mtimangamu
hymns.text:
1. Pokhala mtendere mu mtimangamu,
Pamene ndisaukanso,
Pamene mavuto ndi akuludi,
Moyo wangawu ngwabwinotu.

Moyowo
Ngwabwino,
Moyo wanga ulitu bwino.

2. Ngakhale Satana andizunza ’ne,
Chilipo chitonthozacho;
Chifundo cha Kristu anafera ’ne,
Kundipatsa ’ne moyo wake.

3. Uchimo unapachikidwa pomwe
Pamtanda wa Yesu Mbuye;
Machimo angawo anatherapo;
Mbuye wanga, ndiyamika ’Nu.

4. Ambuyathu, ndikhumba tsiku lija
Limene ndidzaona ’Nu;
Lipenga limveke, ndidzakondwatu
Pakukomana ndi Yesuyo.

hymns.title: Ndilira ine kukayenda
hymns.text:
1. Ndilira ine kukayenda
M’njira ndi Mulungu;
Ndilira nyali ndikaone
Njira ya kwa Yesu.

2. Chimwemwe chija chamumtima
Ndinalawa kale
Poyambutsata ine Yesu,
Chili kuti tere?

3. Kalelo m’mtima ndinakondwa,
Tere ndingolira,
Zokoma zonse zapadziko
Sizindikwanira.

4. Mubwere, Mzimu wa mpumulo
Mundileze m’kati;
Ndidana nazo zoipazo
Zinakuchotsani.

5. Mundichotsere tchimo lonse
Ndinakonda kale,
E, muligwetse kuti ndinu
Mfumu mukakhale.

6. Mkatero ndidzayenda m’njira
Ndi Mulungu wanga,
Idzandiunikira nyali
Njira ya Kumwamba.

hymns.title: Ndilira mtima wotamanda
hymns.text:
1. Ndilira mtima wotamanda
Mlungu, ndi woyera,
E, mtima woyamika mwazi
Munandikhetsera.

2. Mtimatu wopirira ndi
Wofatsa m’kati mwake,
Mumveke Mbuye Yesu yekha,
Ndiye Mfumu yake.

3. Ndilira mtima wakulapa
Ndi womvera Yesu,
Wosasiyana ndi Ambuye
Wakukhala m’mwemo.

4. E, mtima watsopano ndi
Wodzala ndi chikondi,
Wangwiro ndi wokoma, Mbuye
Wakukhala wanu wonse.

5. Mkhalidwe wanu mundipatse,
Ndifane nanu,
Mulembe m’mtima mwanga Dzina
La chikondi chanu.

hymns.title: Zoipa zangazi
hymns.text:
1. Zoipa zangazi
Zidetsa m’mtimamu;
Mnditsuke, Yesutu,
Kutsuka koti mbuu!

2. Ndafoka inetu,
Ndalema m’mtimamu;
Andilimbitsa ’Ye,
Kulimba koti njo!

3. Zin’sowa indedi
Zabwino m’mtimamu;
Ambuye, mdzazebe,
Kudzaza koti tho!

hymns.title: Ambuye, ndifuna nditsukenitu
Usafune chuma chokha
hymns.text:
1. Usafune chuma chokha,
Pena masewera okha,
Koma za Mulungu zokha
Zipambana zinazo.

2. Ukafuna kulemera,
Pempha chuma chosathera,
Ndiwo mtima wakuyera
Ndi wokonda Yesuyo.

3. Zosauka unvomere,
Ndipo Yesu chaulere
Chikondano ndi mtendere
Alowetsa m’mtimamo.

4. Zonse umazinyadira
Udzaleka kusirira;
Uli nazo zokwanira
Pakupeza Yesuyo.

5. Mbiri yake ubukitse,
Anthu onse nuphunzitse,
Kwa Mulungu nufikitse
Osokera onsewo.

6. Yesu sakusiya konse;
Mphamvu, nzeru, chuma chonse
Akupatsa nsiku zonse;
Tsata Yesu yekhayo.

hymns.title: Mkristu, ulimbike
hymns.text:
1. Mkristu, ulimbike
M’ntchito yakeyo;
Yesu anafera
Anthu akewo.

2. Mphamvu zathu zonse
Tionetsenso,
Kuti kudziwike
Tili akewo.

3. Mtima wakufatsa
Amakondako;
Ndipo anthu onse
Angatengewo.

4. Mapemphero athu
Tikakwezebe,
Dzina lake lomwe
Tiyamike ’fe.

5. Limbikani nonse
Mpaka imfayo,
Ndipo Mfumu yathu
Idzakondwako.

hymns.title: Gwira zintchito zako
hymns.text:
1. Gwira zintchito zako,
Pomva usiku udza;
Yamba mamawa ndithu
Potuluka dzuwa.
Gwiranso m’nsana monse
Dzuwalo likatentha;
Gwira tsopano ntchito;
Msanga udzaleka.

2. Ntchito za Yesu gwira
Pomva usiku udza;
Lero lonseli gwira,
Bwino udzapuma.
Gwiratu tsiku lonse
Ntchito tsopano ntchito,
Tere udzaleka.

3. Mkristu gwiratu ntchito
Pomva usiku udza;
Dzuwalo lopendeka
Tere lidzalowa.
Gwiranso ’dzulodzulo
Kutada mdima bii!
Tsono zintchito zonse
Zatha zonsezi.

hymns.title: Tithawiranji ifetu
Mbuye, nditsate bwanjiko
hymns.text:
1. Mbuye, nditsate bwanjiko?
Ine ndikonde bwanjinso?
Bwanji kuyenda m’njiramo
Yonka Kumwamba kwawoko.

2. Kodi m’njiramo ndimvadi
Nsoni zowawa, nkhawazi
Ndi masauko, mingayi?
E, nkana izi n’tsatabe.

3. Anasauka Mbuyeyo,
Mwini nalola zonsezo;
Anatsiriza ntchitozo,
Osabwerera imfayo.

4. Ndikamayenda m’mdimamo,
Mletse zodandaulazo;
Mundikumbutse mtandawo;
Zanga zichepa zonsezo.

5. Inde nditaya chumacho,
Ndikondweretse Mbuyeyo,
Thupi liopa mingayo
Koma mlimbitse mtimawo.

hymns.title: Yesu afuna iwe unnke kwawoko
Mbuye, mwatiuza ’fe
hymns.text:
1. Mbuye, mwatiuza ’fe
Tizikhala mchere
Wokometsa onsewo
Akumanga kwathu.
Mcherewu ndi ifetu;
Mtifanize nanu,
Tikakope ndi chitsanzo
Onse akuchimwa.

2. Mbuye, mwatiuza ’fe
Tizikhala nyali
Yoonetsa onsewo
Njira yonka kwanu.
Njaliyi ndi ifetu;
Kuunika kwanu
Mutipatse tiwalire
Osokera onse.

3. Tisasungaluke ’yi,
Tisasiye Yesu.
Tisabise nyaliyi
Pakuchita mantha.
Mcheretu ndi nyaliyi
Tizikhala tonse;
Mbuye, mtiyeretse m’mtima
Tikatero ndithu.

hymns.title: M’mawa tizifesa
hymns.text:
1. M’mawa tizifesa
Mbewu zakukoma,
Msana ndi usiku
Tizifesa momwe.
Nyengo yamasika
Tidzatema m’munda
Tidzabwera tonse
Ndi zipatsozo.

Ndi zipatsozo,
Ndi zipatsozo,
Tidzabwera tonse
Ndizipatsozo.

2. Tizifesa m’dzuwa,
Tizifesa m’mthunzi,
Sitiopa ife
Mtambo ndi chisanu.
Athatu masika
Ntchitozi zidatha;
Tidzabwera tonse
Ndi zipatsozo.

3. Tingolira kaya,
Koma tidzafesa
Mbewu za Ambuye;
Ntchitoyo nja Yesu.
Adzachotsa msozi,
Adzatilandira,
Tidzabwera tonse
Ndi zipatsozo.

hymns.title: M’mene umauka m’mawa
hymns.text:
1. M’mene umauka m’mawa,
Sunagwire ntchitozo,
Sunayambe kukayenda,
Ugwadire Mlunguyo.
Pena ulikusekera,
Pena nkhawa m’mtimamo,
Wachimwemwe, wachisoni,
Uza Yesu zonsezo.

2. Wakuchezacheza naye
Ukagwira ntchitozo;
Pakukumbukira Yesu,
Nkhawa zidzachokanso.
Ndi zapansi zikafuna
Kukudzaza m’mtimamo
Utsogole kopemphera,
Uza Yesu zonsezo.

3. Ndi m’kutero udzadziwa
Chifuniro chakecho;
Iye adzakuthandiza
Uthangate enanso;
Ndi ofoka ulimbitse,
Akulapa bwezatu;
Ndi za ntchito zake izi
Uza Yesu zonsezo.

4. Ndipo ngati ungolema,
Ulefuka m’dzulomo,
Ndi Satana akayesa
Kukukola m’mtimamo;
Wakufola, wakuopa,
Penyetsetsa Iyeyo;
Udzakhazikika m’mtima
Pakumuza zonsezo.

hymns.title: Haya! ’Nzanga taonani
hymns.text:
1. Haya! ’Nzanga taonani
Yoonekayo
Yakumwamba iti: "Yesu
Alinkudzako.”

Kanganani nkhondo yanu
Ndi mbendera mbuu!
Tibvomere: "Inde Mbuye
Mtithangatetu."

2. A! mizimu yakuipa
Isautsabe,
Tikanize zakuipa
Zotizinga ’fe.

3. Mdani adza nazo mphamvu,
Koma ifetu
Tidzamthetsa nkhondo yake Timwingitsetu.

4. Yesu ati, "Ndidza msanga!"
Thangateni phee!
Mbweze mawu akulimba:
Tikanganabe.

hymns.title: Anatilemba Yesu tikagwire nkhondo yake

lines: Kwa Satana n’ziwembu zake sitigonja konse;
Mtheradi, ndi lupanga ndilo Mawau a Mulungu;
Ndi kumasula goli la anzathu akuopa.

hymns.text:
1. Anatilemba Yesu tikagwire nkhondo yake,
Natilimbitsa tipirire osaopa kanthu.
Kwa Satana n’ziwembu zake sitigonja konse;
Tiyenderana naye Mfumu yathu yopambana.

2. Amaliwongo ochuluka amalowa m’mtima
Nafuna kuipitsamo usana ndi usiku;
Tikatsatabe Mfumu yathu sitidzagwa konse,
Pakuti atipatsa mphamvu tipambane nazo.

3. Amatininkha zida zoteteza mtima,
ndizo:
Kupempherabe, kukhulupirira ndi kufatsa;
Mtheradi, ndi lupanga ndilo Mawau a Mulungu;
Pogwira zida zakezi sitilephera konse.

4. Mafumu atiuza tikaletse ukapolo,
Ndi kumasula goli la anzathu akuopa.
Tiyeni, tiwauze za Mbuyathu Mpulumutsi,
Nitiwanditse mlathu.

hymns.title: Limba mtima mbale wanga
hymns.text:
1. Limba mtima mbale wanga,
Usapunthwe m’njirayi;
Onatu nyenyezi ija
Ikutsogoleradi.
Tamveratu Mlungu yekha,
Chita zolungama ’we,
Yenda bwino, khulupirira
Mbuyeyo, Mbuyeyo,
Ndi kuchita zakezi.

2. Taya zako zochenjera,
Taya zamumdimanso;
Nthawi zonse khulupira,
Chita zolungamazo.
Usayang’anire wina
M’khondo yako yomweyi,
Koma m’zonse khulupirira
Mbuyeyo, Mbuyeyo,
Ndi kuchita zakezi.

3. Leka zakuipa zako,
Myambi yonse yoti bii,
Usakhulupire mommo;
Tamveratu Mbuyedi.
Adzadana nawe ena,
Ena adzakonda ’we;
Kweza maso, khulupirira
Mbuyeyo, Mbuyeyo,
Ndi kuchita zakezi.

4. Mawu ake atipatsa
Mphamvu ndi mtenderenso,
Bwino atitsogolera,
Tikhulupirira ’wo.
Limba mtima, usapunthwe
M’njira yamumdimayi;
Yenda bwino khulupirira
Mbuyeyo, Mbuyeyo,
Ndi kuchita zakezi.

hymns.title: Poyesedwa ine
hymns.text:
1. Poyesedwa ine
Yesu mudzetu,
Mundipempherere
Ndisachimwetu.
Mukaona kuti
Ndilefukatu,
Mbuye mndilimbitse
Nazo mphamvutu.

2. Ndi zapansi pano
Ndikokedwadi,
Koma ndi chisoni
Mndiphunzitsedi;
Ndisaiwalire
Za Getsemane,
Pena mtanda wanu
Yesu Mbuye ’Nu.

3. Mukandipweteka,
Ndipirirapo;
Nsembe yanga ndiyo,
Landirani ’yo.
Ndikachita mantha
Sindithawa ’yi;
Mtima udzalimba,
Ndidzaima nji!

4. Pakumalizidwa
Moyo wangawu,
Pomwalira ine,
Mudze Mbuyetu.
Ndidzadzipereka
M’manja mwanumo;
Mpulumutsi Yesu
Mndilandireko.

hymns.title: Ambuye wa Kumwamba
hymns.text:
1. Ambuye wa Kumwamba,
Mundithangatetu
Kuyenda bwino lomwe
M’elendo unowu.
Kawiri ndi kawiri
Ndipunthwa m’njiramo;
Mlimbitse mtima wanga,
Ndingatayikeko.

2. Ndikhumba Mzimu wanu
Kundiyeretsa mbuu!
Pang’ono ndi pang’ono
Mundiphunzitsetu;
Ndifuna nzeru zanu
Zakundifitsako
Kumwamba kuli Inu,
Ambuye wangayo.

3. Yochita ndi yodikha
Mupatse mphamvuyo,
Ndikhale wochenjera,
Wogwira ntchitozo.
Zoipa zanga zonse
Mufafanizezo,
Ndiye nde nanu nokha
Masiku onsewo.

hymns.title: Tiyeni Akristu
hymns.text:
1. Tiyeni Akristu,
Nkhondo tiigwire;
Yesu Mbuye wathu
Atitsogolera.
Mfumu yathu mwini
Atipatsa moyo;
Taonanitu mbendera,
Yailowa nkhondo!

Tiyeni Akristu,
Nkhondo tiigwire;
Yesu Mbuye wathu
Atitsogolera.

2. Nkhondo ya Satana
Idzakuthawani;
Tiyeni Akristu,
Kaipambaneni.
Idzanjenjemera
Mukapfu’litsatu;
Imbitsanitu anzathu,
Mawu mukwezetse.

3. Mpingo wa Mulungu
Uli ngati nkhondo;
Titsagane nawo
Ana a Mulungu.
Sitipatukana,
Ndifetu amodzi;
Ch’yembekezo, chikondano,
Chonse ndi chimodzi.

4. Zonse zapadziko
Zidzamalizika,
Koma Mpingo wake
Uli chikhalire;
Udzalaka ndithu
Mphamvu za Satana,
Yesu analonjezetsa,
Mawuwo sakana.

5. Tiyeni anzathu
Tizithandizana;
Imbirani nafe
Nyimbo zopambana.
Kristu ayenera
Mphamvu ndi ulemu;
Tidzamlemekeza kwawo
Komwe kuli Yesu.

hymns.title: Tiyeni, Akristu inu
hymns.text:
1. Tiyeni, Akristu inu,
Mumenyane nkhondo iyi,
Mukafoka nonse, koma
Yesu akulimbitsani.

2. Muyendenso kunka komwe,
Mugonjetse mdani wanu;
Musafoke, musaleme,
Musagone konse inu.

3. Musagonje, anthu inu,
Mtamiretu Yekha Mbuye;
Ipambana mphamvu yake,
Ya Mtsogoli wanu yemwe.

4. Mtima wanu wonse ndithu
Udzakhala ndi chimwemwe.
Zida zanu mbvale bwino
Zakudzera m’Mwamba momwe.

5. Limbikani inu nonse,
Msangalalo ngwanu nokha;
Musaope kanthu kena,
Mumtamire Mbuye Yekha.

6. Tiyeni ku nkhondo iyi,
Mugonjetse zonse konko;
Muingitse mdani uja,
Muyendetse m’njira momwe.

hymns.title: Akristu limbikani
hymns.text:
1. Akristu limbikani,
Imani mtima nji!
Mbendera nyamulani,
Msatenthemere ’yi.
Wotsogolera wathu
Ndi Mwana wa Mulungu;
Adzagonjetsa onse
Adani athuwo.

2. Tigwire nkhondo yomwe
Ya Mbuye wathuyo;
Tileke zakuipa
Zokhala m’mtimamo.
Sitikwanira tokha
Kuleka zathu zomwe,
Koma Mbuyathu Yesu
Atithangatatu.

3. Tsopano timenyana
Ndi zakuipazi;
Pamene nkhondo yatha
Tidzanka kwathuko.
Yesu adzalandira
Ankhondo ake onse;
Adzakhalira naye
Kumwamba komweko.

hymns.title: Mbuye, ndapangana
hymns.text:
1. Mbuye, ndapangana
M’njira yanuyi,
Kuti ndidzayenda
Osaleka ’yi.
Mundipatse mtima
Wopiriramo,
Wakukana zonse
Zondipingazo.

2. Mzimu wakuipa
Undiyesa ’ne;
Mundithangatire
Ku’thawitsabe.
Akandisautsa
Kum’dzi kunoku,
Mulowetse mphamvu
M’mtima mwangamu.

3. Akathira nsembe
Ku mizimuyo,
Ndipenyera kwanu,
E, Kumwambako.
Tsoka ndi zonyenga
Za ufitizo,
Yesu, mndilimbitse
Ndisaopezo.

4. Pena kumwa nawo,
Ndisateroko,
Pena kukaona
Gule woipa,
Pena kuwombeza
Sindifuna ’yi;
Yesu mndithandize
Kuzikanazi.

5. Ndinu Mbusa wanga;
Mndithandizetu;
Ndisaipse nazo
Mtima wangawu.
Osaoopa konse,
Osachimwa ’yi.
Mndiyendetse Yesu
M’njira yanuyi.

hymns.title: Aulendo, munka kuti
hymns.text:
1. Aulendo, munka kuti
Ndi zindodo m’manja mwanu?
Paulendo tizipita;
Aitana Mbuye wathu;
Pamapiri, pamadambo,
Tizipita komwe kwawo
Kuli dzikolo labwino,
Tizipita komwe kwawo
Kuli dzikolo labwino.

2. Kodi simuona njira,
Inu anthu akufoka?
Ayi, atiperekeza
Mbuye wathu wotikonda
Iye amakhala nafe,
Natitsogolera ife,
Atitsogolera ife
Kuli dzikolo labwino.
Atitsogolera ife
Kuli dzikolo labwino.

3. Mundiuze, aulendo,
Muli chiani m’Mwamba muja?
Atibvekako zoyera,
Akorona natininkha:
Moyo, moyo atipatsa,
Kwa Mulungu tidzakhala.
Kuli dzikolo labwino,
Kwa Mulungu tidzakhala
Kuli dzikolo labwino.

4. Kodi inu, aulendo,
Ife titsagane nanu?
Inde, mudze inu nonse,
Mudze nafe paulendo.
Inde, mutiperekeze,
Yesu atilinda ife.
Yesu atilinda ife
Kuli dzikolo labwino,
Yesu atilinda ife
Kuli dzikolo labwino.

hymns.title: Ana akumwamba ndife
hymns.text:
1. Ana akumwamba ndife,
Paulendo timaimba;
Timatama Mbuye wathu
Wa ulemerero wonse.

Tilikupita kwathu kuja
Munjira ya atate athu,
Amakondwera lero lomwe;
Tinka kuonana nawo.

2. Mbuye anatiitana
Kukagwira ntchito yake,
Kuitana anthu onse
Atsatenso njira yino.

3. Inde Mbuye, tibweradi,
Zathu zonse tizisiya,
Mtsogoleri wathu ndinu,
Titsatabe Inu nokha.

hymns.title: Mbuye munditsogolere
Ndimayenda paulendo
hymns.text:
1. Ndimayenda paulendo,
Ndi yaminga njira yake;
Tsoka ndikapeza, koma
Ndinka kwa Atate;
Pena m’mtima mwanga mwada,
Pena andibvuta ’dani,
Ndikatenga nkhawa, mantha,
Amadziwako.

2. Ichi chindisangalatsa
M’mene nkhondo indigwira,
M’mene nsoni zazikulu
Zimanditsatira;
Mtima ukhazikika m’mene
Kwathu kuja ndikumbuka,
Kuti Mlungu ali ndine,
Andisungako.

3. Mbuye andipeza lero,
Andikonda, andisunga;
Adzapitikitsa mdani
Akamandibvuta.
E, ulendo wanga utha,
Tsono ine ndimwalira;
M’mene ndidzafika kwawo
And’landirako.

4. Komwe ndi chimwemwe ine
N’dzaonana ndi Atate,
N’dzamgwadira ndi kumtama
Amandikondabe.
Sakandisautsa kanthu
M’dziko lija lakukoma;
Adzandidalitsa Yesu,
Ndidzakondwako.

hymns.title: Mundiwalire m’njira mwangamo
hymns.text:
1. Mundiwalire m’njira mwangamo,
Mbuyanga ’Nu,
Kwada usiku, ndasokerako,
Mtsogoletu.
Phazi langali mndisungirenso,
Ndilonde Inu m’njira monsemo.

2. Sindidapempha kale Mbuye ’yi,
Mtsogole ’Nu;
Ndasankha ndine, koma leroli
Nditsatatu.
Ndidadzikuza osaopa ’yi;
Ambuye, msakumbuke zomwezi.

3. Ndi kale lonse mnandisunga ’ne;
Tsopanonso.
M’khwawa, paphiri, mundisungebe
M’tsogolomo.
Ndipo mamawa n’dzaonana ndi
Abale anga adafikadi.

hymns.title: Tiyeni nonsenu okonda Yesuyo
hymns.text:
1. Tiyeni nonsenu okonda Yesuyo,
Tiimbe nyimbo yabwino,
Tiimbe nyimbo yabwino,
Ku mpando wakewo,
Ku mpando wakewo.

Tiyeni pamodzi,
Tilikupita Kumwamba;
Akristu tilikupita
Ku Mzinda wa Mlungu.

2. Ngakhale enawo aleke kwimbako,
Akristu ’fe tidzaimba,
Akristu ’fe tidzaimba,
Kulemekeza ’Ye,
Kulemekeza ’Ye.

3. Akristu tonsefe, tikondwe m’Dzikoli
Koposa anthu enawo,
Koposa anthu enawo,
Tisanafikeko,
Tisanafikeko.

4. Tiimbe mokondwa, misozi iume;
Poyenda kunka kwathuko,
Poyenda kunka kwathuko,
Kwa Mlungu wathuyo,
Kwa Mlungu wathuyo.

hymns.title: Ndamvatu kuti tifika komweko
hymns.text:
1. Ndamvatu kuti tifika komweko
Kuli Ambuye, Mtetezi wathuyo
Inde, pakutha zobvuta zathuzo
Iye tidzamuona maso ndi maso.

Ndi Mbuyeyo tikhalamo,
Kupenyanso wokondatu;
Tidzakondwera E
nthawi zonse,
Ndicho chimwemwe ndi ulemutu.

2. Kaamba chisomo cha Mbuyathu uyu,
Malo koma tipeza m’Mwambamo;
Kumva Mtetezi amene ndi Yesu,
Ndicho chimwemwe ndi chachikulutu.

3. Onse aliko takonda kalelo,
Kale napita kwa Yesu Mbuyawo;
Koma kumwona Mtetezi wathuyo
Ndicho chimwemwe choposa,
nchathucho.

hymns.title: Ukatha moyo wanga
hymns.text:
1. Ukatha moyo wanga
Kumwamba kundichera;
Dzuwalo ndimalira
Lafika lokomera.
Usiku m’nali mdima,
Tsopano mbanda kucha;
Kudzawalitsa ndithu
Ku Dziko la Mulungu.

2. Chitsime chachikondi
Ndi Yesu Mbuye wanga;
Ndalawa mtsinje pano
Ndzamwetsa ine m’Mwamba.
Komweko zidzakula
Chisomo ndi chifundo,
Pondiwalira kuja
Ku Dziko la Mulungu.

3. A! Yesu Bwenzi langa
Inenso bwenzi lake,
Woipa ’ne alola
Ndilowe m’Nyumba mwake;
Ndikhulupira Iye
Achotsa mphulupulu;
Kudzandiwalitsira
Ku Dziko la Mulungu.

4. Ambuye andisunga
M’chifundo chachikulu;
Zisoni zisanduka
Chimwemwe cha Mulungu.
Dzanjalo ndilitama
Ndi mtima wachifundo,
Mpakatu kwawalitsa
Ku Dziko la Mulungu.

hymns.title: Tikagwidwa ndi chisoni
hymns.text:
1. Tikagwidwa ndi chisoni,
Ikayendanso misozi,
Poliriratu abale,
Yesu mutimveretu.

2. Munabvala thupi lathu,
Munadziwa masauko,
Mnalirira bwenzi lanu;
Yesu mmutimveretu.

3. M’mene imfa yathu idza,
Mweya wathu ukaleka,
M’mene ife timwalira,
Yesu mutimveretu.

4. Mnamwalira Inu paja,
Mwazi wanu munakhetsa,
Koma Inu munadzuka;
Yesu mutimveretu.

5. Mtima ukachita nkhawa
Ndi zoipa zotimanga,
M’mene tikachita mantha,
Yesu mutimveretu.

hymns.title: Kodi uli ndi chisoni
hymns.text:
1. Kodi uli ndi chisoni
Choliritsa mtima wako?
Kweza maso ndi Atate
Akumvetsa zonsezi.

2. Kodi umadandaula:
"Mbale wanga waferanji?"
Kumbukira Wakumtenga
Saphophonya konse ’yi.

3. Mbale wako unamkonda,
Koma Yesu amkondetsetsa;
Anamfuna nangomtenga;
Usammane Yesu ’yi.

4. Pakutsazikana nanu
Ndi potseka maso ake,
Imfa, bii! Anangogona
Koma adzadzukanso.

5. Usalire; Mpulumutsi
Analawa imfa Yekha;
Imfa yomwe nagonjetsa
Potuluka m’mandamo.

6. Chikondano sichifera;
Mbale wako udzamwona
Kwathu komwe; zipirira
Mpaka ukafikako.

7. Leroli chisoni chokha,
Tsiku lija kungokondwa;
Kweza maso osalira,
Yesu akukondadi.

hymns.title: Ntchito yonse yakeyo
hymns.text:
1. Ntchito yonse yakeyo
Yatha m’dziko linoli;
Mlendo wafikatuko
Pokocheza leroli.

’Tate, mwa kusunga kwanu
Timusiya mwana wanu.
’Tate, mwa kusunga kwanu
Timusiya mwana wanu.

2. Yatha misoziyo,
Zobisika zonse mbee!
Aweruza bwinoko
Ndiye Wolungamayo.

3. Komwe Mbusa kwawoko
Atengera nkhosa zonse,
Zake asungiramo
Zosaopa kanthu konse.

4. Onse akulapawo
Ayang’ana mtanda wake;
Aphunzira komweko
Zonse za kukonda kwake.

5. Dothili kudothilo,
Pfumbili kupfumbi tere;
Mpaka adzadzukanso
Timusiya mumtendere.

hymns.title: Mumzinda wa Mulungu
hymns.text:
1. Mumzinda wa Mulungu
Moyera mulimo,
Ndiye amathu omwe
Olera ifewo;
Mitima yathu yomwe
Ikondwereratu,
Nikhala nawo Mzinda
Wakukongolawu.

2. Akondwerera anthu
Zokoma zonsezi
Za midzi ya padziko
Lapansi lonseli;
Mtendere wake koma
Wa Mzinda wathuwo
Upambanitsa zonse
Zapansi pomwepo.

3. Ndi nkhondo ikaleka
Kwa Mulungu komweko,
Ndi ukapolo watha,
Udani wathanso;
Ndi zakuopsa zonse
Ndi zosauka zii!
Ndi mwayi wa kwa Mlungu
Udzaza mutu tho!

hymns.title: Nlokoma Dziko langa
hymns.text:
1. Nlokoma Dziko langa!
Ndiyang’anirapo,
Ndilira ndi chikondi
Poona dzinalo;
Pakumva mbiri yanu
Mumtima muti duu!
Ndi moyo ndi mtendere
Imalowetsamo.

2. Mokhala mokhamokha
Mokondwa momwemo;
Misozi yatha yonse,
Angosekeramo;
Panyezimira ponse,
Panyumba pati mbee!
Pamyala pakongola
Yoyala ponsepo.

3. Makomo afanana
Ndi myala yoti mbuu!
Ndi Kristu wopambana
Aonekeramo;
Ndi mtanda woyeretsa
Wopachikidwapo,
Amamlambira Mfumu
Namlemekezanso.

4. Kulibe gombe, nyanja,
Kulibe nthawi ’yi
Alendo alandira
Zoziziritsazi;
Pa Mwala Wamuyaya
Amanga Nyumbayo,
Ndi omwe opambana
Adzakondweramo.

5. Nlokoma Dziko langa!
Kopita onsewo
Mulungu awasankha,
Tifuna kunkako.
Ambuye, mutsogole
Ku Dziko komweko;
Tidzakuimbirani
M’ulemereromo.

hymns.title: Ndikondwa kuganizabe
hymns.text:
1. Ndikondwa kuganizabe
Za Dziko la Mulungu;
Momwemo muli abwenzitu
Okhala mumtendere.

Iwo salekana, iwo salekana,
Ayi salekana abwenzi omwewo.

2. Komweko akhala Yesuyo
Mtetezi wa inedi
Pakati pa ’womboledwawo;
Sadzamva kuwawanso.

Iwo asekera, iwo asekera,
Inde asekera kumwona Yesuyo.

3. Mulibe zoipa m’Dzikolo,
Nzokomazo zabwino;
Ndi nthenda, imfa, misoziyi
Kumwamba kulibenso.

Dziko labwinotu, dziko labwinotu,
Nawo mtenderewo, tikhumba ilotu.

4. Ndikonda kuganizirabe
Za Dziko la Mulungu,
Za zonse zotikondweretsamo,
Nzosathanso chikondi.

Ife tikondwera, ife tikondwera,
M’mene tidzampenya Ambuye wathuyo.

hymns.title: ’Tate wa Kumwambako
hymns.text:
1. ’Tate wa Kumwambako,
Likayere Dzinalo,
Udzetu Ufumu wanu;
Chifuniro chanucho
Chichitike pansipa
Monga chachitika kwanu.

2. Mutipatse leroli
E, chakudya chathuchi
Tsiku n’tsiku tichilira.
Mukhululukiredi
Tchimo lathu, monga ’fe
Iwo adatichimwira.

3. Musatifikitsemo
Muli mayeserowo,
Koma mutipulumutse.
Wanu ndi ufumuwo,
Mphamvu ndi ulemunso
Kufikira nthawi zonse.

hymns.title: Mtima wanga ndikonzera
hymns.text:
1. Mtima wanga ndikonzera,
Mbuye Yesu aitana;
Ati: "Mwana, tapemphera,
Ine sindidzakukana."

2. Mbuye, ndinu Mfumu yanga
Yolemera ndi yamphamvu;
Ndikapemphatu zambiri,
Simundimanira kanthu.

3. Ndikabwera ndi katundu
Wa zoipa zanga zonse;
Mwazi wake wa Ambuye,
Udzandiyeretsa konse.

4. Mbuye, ndinalema ine,
Mlowe Inu m’mtima mwanga;
Mkhale m’mwemo mwini wake
Mantha mwandichotsera ’ne.

5. Ndine mlendo pansi pano,
Mndilimbitse ndi chikondi;
Bwenzi, mundilondolere
Njira pa ulendo wonse.

6. Mndidziwitse ntchito yanga,
Mphamvu yake mundipatse;
Mundilimbikitse m’mtima
Ndikakhale kwa Atate.

hymns.title: Pemphera m’mbanda kucha
hymns.text:
1. Pemphera m’mbanda kucha,
Pempheranso usana;
Pemphera m’dzulo momwe,
Pemphera ndi usiku.
Ndi mtima wonse idza,
Tulutsanso zachabe;
M’nyumbamo ugwadire
Ndi kukapempherabe.

2. Kumbuka ’bale ako
Ndi onse uwakonda;
Pemphera ’dani ako
Amene akutonza.
Dzipempherere wekha
Mulungu akusunge;
Tchulanso popemphera
Dzinalo la Ambuye.

3. Akakusowa malo
Opempheramo m’tseri,
Komatu m’mtima mwako
Mwalowatu zoyera;
Anazilonga m’mwemo
Ndi Mzimu Wakuyera;
Zolingirira zija
Kwa Mulungu zidzakwera.

4. Tilibe madalitso
Akulingana n’lino
Atate atipatsa,
Kupempherabe bwino.
Ukamvatu chisoni,
Kwa Ambuye kapemphera.
Adzakusangalatsa,
Pemphero adzamvera.

hymns.title: Pokupempherani
hymns.text:
1. Pokupempherani
Mundiphunzitse ’ne
Ndi Mzimu wanu Woyera,
Ndikayanjane nanu, Atate,
Ndi kukulemekezani ’Nu.

2. Mndikumbutse zomwe
Munandichitira
Ndikakuyamikireni,
Ndikweze Dzina lomwe angelo
Aliimbira Kumwambako.

3. Mndimvetse chisoni
Pakuululira
Zochimwa zanga zambiri;
Mumtima ndi kupatsa mtendere
Mutachotsera zoipazo.

4. Chikondi, chimwemwe,
Chifatso, chiletso,
Zipatso zonse za Mzimu
Mundibalitse, ndikafanane
Ndi Mbuyathu popempherapo.

5. Pakupempherera
Anzanga ndi onse
Akusokera mumdima,
M’wapulumutse ndi k’wachitira
Zomwe mufuna k’wapatsawo.

6. Polowa ndi Inu
M’chipinda cham’tseri,
Posonkhananso pamodzi,
Muyandikire nafe, Atate,
Mtibvomere, mtidalitsepo.

hymns.title: Bwenzi lathu ndiye Yesu
hymns.text:
1. Bwenzi lathu ndiye Yesu
Atikonda ifetu;
Zifunsiro zathu zonse
Tipemphere Mbuyathu.
Mtima phee tisowa tonse,
Zitibvuta chabeko,
Kaamba sitimanka konse
Kumpemphera Mlunguyo.

2. Tili nazo zotiyesa,
Zitidetsa nkhawamu;
Tisadandaule chabe,
Timpemphere Mbuyathu.
Kodi tikaona wina
Timkhulupiriremo?
Yesu atidziwa bwino,
Timpemphere yekhayo.

3. Kodi tikulema nazo
Zotiwawa m’mtimamo?
Atipulumutsa Yesu,
Timpemphere Iyeyu.
Kodi adathawa ’bale?
Pempheratu Bwenzilo;
Akusunga m’mkono mwake,
Udzapumuliramo.

hymns.title: Zokoma ndithu nthawizi
hymns.text:
1. Zokoma ndithu nthawizi
Kwa Mlungu zondifitsadi;
Kumpando wachifumuwo
Ndiuza zanga zonsezo
Pobvuta ine mtimamo
Nditulapo pa Yesuyo;
Pakuyesedwa ndinkatu
Kwa Mbuye, sindikhala duu,
Pakuyesedwa ndinkatu
Kwa Mbuye, sindikhala duu.

2. Zokoma inde nthawizi
Zotama Dzina lomweli
La Yesu, ndi woonayo
Ndilakalaka Iyeyu
Wofera ine pansitu;
Pakuda nkhawa ine bii
Nditchula Dzina lomweli
Pakuda nkhawa ine bii
Nditchula Dzina lomweli.

3. Zokoma etu nthawizi"
Ndicheza naye Mlungudi;
Komatu kwathu m’Mwambamo
Kumwona ndi koposako.
Pobvula ine thupili,
Ndilowa Dziko lakedi;
Ndidzati nthawi yomweyo;
"Tsalani bwino pansipo."
Ndidzati nthawi yomweyo;
"Tsalani bwino pansipo."

hymns.title: Mtidzutse, Mbuyetu
hymns.text:
1. Mtidzutse, Mbuyetu,
Mtionekeremu;
Munene zakumvekazi,
Timvere ifetu.
Mtidzutse, Mbuyetu,

Mtipatse moyonso;
Mudzetu, Mbuye, mudzetu,
Tidalitseni ’fe.

2. Mtidzutse, Mbuyetu,
Tikweze Dzinali;
Tiuzireni Mpweyawo
M’mitima yathuyi.

3. Mtidzutse, Mbuyetu,
Timvere Mawudi;
Zoona zanu tonsefe
Tikhulupire ’zi.

4. Mtidzutse, Mbuyetu,
Mthirenso moyowo;
Ulemu ngwanu nokha ’Nu,
Dalitso nlathulo.

hymns.title: Akristu ndi abale, tiziyenderana tonse

lines: Ndi Mzimu yemwe ayeretsa akumvera onse;
Kumwamba komwe tinka ndi kulonda njira yomwe.

hymns.title: Mbuye, Mpingo wanu usauka kwa kukuludi

lines: Mbuye, Mpingo wanu usauka kwa kukuludi;
Kale lija munatsitsa Mzimu wanu Wakuyera;
Tidza kwa Mulungu Inu, ndinu wa chifundo;
Tikakhale ndi chimwemw kuti tilimbike ndithu.
Adasokerera kale ndi zoipa zapa dziko.
Mwa kulema ndi kulimba mutipempherere ife,
Kuti tilimbike ife ndi kumchotsa m’mtima mwathu.
Pa la Mulungu tibwera kulandira zidazo;
Mphamvu yanu ndi chikondi zititsogolere ife;
Machitidwe ndi mkhalidwe zikokere ena kwanu.

hymns.title: Aulendo amayenda
hymns.text:
1. Aulendo amayenda
Muusiku wo’psyawo,
Namaimba nyimbo zawo
Kunka kwawo m’Mwambamo.

2. Kuunika kuoneka
Koingitsa mdimawu;
Mbale amakondwerera,
Osaopa konse ’yi.

3. Mlungu amaunikira
Anthu ake onsewo,
Namachotsa mantha omwe,
Nayeretsa m’njira mbee!

4. Anthu osawerengeka
Amtamira onsewa,
Nagonjetsa zosautsa
Pomtamira Mbuyeyo.

5. Pakufika tsidya lija,
Zotibvuta zonse phee!
Mfumu yathu yopambana
Idzatikondweretsadi.

6. Nthawi yina adzadzuka
Ogonera m’mandamo,
Kuthawatu mphamvu zonse
Zotivuta pansipa.

hymns.title: Tadzuka mzimu wanga’we
hymns.text:
1. Tadzuka mzimu wanga’we
Ugwire ntchito zakozi;
Kukondwa uketengedi,
Pemphero ulikwezedi.

Pemphero, pemphero,
Pemphero ulikwezedi;
Pemphero, pemphero,
Pemphero ulikwezed i.

2. E, nthawi ya mamawayi
Umtamandire Mbuyeyo,
Nuyese lero ngatitu
Tsiku lakumalizalo.

3. Munkhani zako zonsetu
Unene molungamadi,
Nudziwe kuti Mbuyako
Adziwa zachinsinsizi.

4. Pa tsikuli, Mbuyanga ’Nu,
Munditsogoze m’njiramo;
Ulemerero wanuwo
Undilimbitse monsetu.

5. Timlemekeze Mlunguyu
Wa madalitso onsewo;
Timlemekeze tonsefe,
Atate, Mwana, Mzimunso.

hymns.title: Kristu wakuyeratu
hymns.text:
1. Kristu wakuyeratu,
Kristu wakuwalayo,
Wolungama mdzuketu,
Muingitse mdimawo.
Dzuwa lathu m’Mwambamo,
M’wale m’kati m’mtimamo.

2. Konse kuli mdima bii
Kosakhala Inutu;
Nlosakondwa tsikuli
Mosawala Inu ’mu.
Ndionetu m’katimo
Mwakuwala kwanuko.

3. Mudze, mlowe m’mtimamu,
Mchotse monse mdima bii;
Mdzaze ndi kuyeraku,
Mchotse zosamverazi;
Ndi kuyera kwanuku
Ndikaone bwinotu.

hymns.title: Ambuye munapatsa tsiku
hymns.text:
1. Ambuye munapatsa tsiku
Limene langopitali,
M’mamawa nyimbo zathu zomwe;
Mukhale nafe nthawiyi.

Mukhale, mukhale,
Mukhale nafe nthawiyi;
Mukhale, mukhale,
Mukhale nafe nthawiyi.

2. Tipempha kuti Mpingo wanu
Ukhale ponse m’dzikoli;
Mumdima monse muwaletu,
Kuwala kwanu kudzedi.

3. M’maiko monse, zisi zomwe,
Kuwala kumafikamo;
Kupempha sikuleka konse
Kuyamikira Yesuyo.

4. Pogona ife, amadzuka
Abale akutaliwo;
Panthawi yonse anthu ena
Alemekeza Mbuyeyo.

5. Ufumu wanu, Mbuye Yesu,
Ukhala nthawi zonsedi;
Magulu onse adzagonje,
Nalowe m’njira mwanumu.

hymns.title: Mukhale ndine, dzuwalo lalowa
Atate ndiyamika, mwandisamalira leroli

lines: Mulungu wondikonda, mndisungenso m’mdima muno bii.
Mtendere wanu mulowetse m’mtima ndikagone phee.
Mundilimbitse ndikayese manda ngati m phasayi,
Amyamike onse a Kumwamba ndi apansipa.

hymns.text:
1. Atate ndiyamika, mwandisamalira leroli;
Mulungu wondikonda, mndisungenso m’mdima muno bii.

2. Mundikumbutse, ndikapanda tulo,
za Kumwambako;
Zoganizira zoipitsa m’mtima muchotseremo.

3. Zochimwa za usana uno mndikhululukire ’ne;
Mtendere wanu mulowetse m’mtima ndikagone phee.

4. Mundilimbitse ndikayese manda ngati m phasayi,
Nditagonamo ndikadzuke tsiku lomalizalo.

5. Tiyamike Mlungu wotipatsa zachifundozi,
Amyamike onse a Kumwamba ndi apansipa.

hymns.title: Dzuwa lapitira
hymns.text:
1. Dzuwa lapitira,
Wadza mdimawo,
Mthunzi wamadzulo
Wagwa m’mwambamo.

2. M’mwambamo nyenyezi
Zithwanima mbee;
Zonse zili m’tulo,
Pansi pali duu.

3. Yesu mutipatse
Tulo toti phee;
Ndi mdalitso wanu
Mndifonetse ’ne.

4. Mpatse ana ’ng’ono
Alotemo mbee;
Anthu aulendo
Msungesungebe.

5. Mutonthoze mtima
Wopwetekawo;
Akutsata tchimo
Mletse onsewo.

6. Wonsewu usiku
Andisunge ’ne
Amithenga anu
Akuyera mbee.

7. Ndidzukanso m’mawa,
Kucha koti mbuu,
Ndiyeretu mtima
M’maso mwanumo.

8. Titamadi ’Tate,
Mwana wakeyo
Mzimu Woyeranso,
Nthawinthawizo.

hymns.title: Dzuwa lapita
hymns.text:
1. Dzuwa lapita,
Dzuwa lapita,
Mlungu, mutigonetse phee.

2. Mdima wafika,
Mdima wafika,
Mutisunge tonse bwino.

3. Tibvomereze,
Tibvomereze
Zakuchimwa zathu zonse.

4. Mkhululukire,
Mkhululukire
Zoipazi zathu zonse.

5. Lero tigone,
Lero tigone,
Tigonemo mumtendere.

6. Ndife ananu,
Ndife ananu,
’Tate Mlungu wotikonda.

7. Aleluya!
Aleluya!
Aleluya! Aleluya!

hymns.title: Madzulo aja kalelo
hymns.text:
1. Madzulo aja kalelo
Odwala anagona duu;
Opwetekedwa nthendazo
Munachiritsa Inutu.

2. Tsopano lino kwada bii,
Nafenso timva m’mtimamo;
Simuoneka, komatu
Tidziwa muli nafedi.

3. Wopulumutsa mudzetu;
Adwala ena m’mtima bii,
Ena sakukondani ’Nu,
Ena sasamalira ’yi.

4. Ndi ena sanamvera ’yi,
Enanso alemedwatu,
Zoopsya nazo tifadi;
Mukadza tidzaposatu.

5. Wopulumutsa, Inunso
Munasauka kalelo;
Muona zoda m’mtimamu
Tibisa ndi manyaziwo.

6. Mutichiritse ifenso
Mutiphunzitse zanuzi;
Timve tsopano mawuwo
Ochiza nthenda yathuyi.

hymns.title: Mpulumutsi tikagona
hymns.text:
1. Mpulumutsi tikagona
Mtidalitse m’mtimamo;
Tingolapa zakuipa,
Muzichotse zonsezo.
Kukadetsa bii usiku
Inu mutipenya ’fe;
Simulema, simugona;
Anthu anu msungabe.

2. Atipsinjadi masoka,
Mibvi iponyekatu;
Atisungadi angelo,
Moyo mutipatsa ’Nu.
Ngatitu usiku uno
Ikabwera imfayo,
Mtiukitse m’mawa kwanu,
Mpatsenso zoyerazo.

hymns.title: Mulungu wanga, Dzuwatu
hymns.text:
1. Mulungu wanga, Dzuwatu
La mtima wanga ndinudi;
Palibe mdima ngatitu
Mukawalira inedi.

2. Muchotse zonse zoti bii
Zobisa nkhope yanuyo;
Mudzazetu mtimangawo
Ndi kuunika kwanuko.

3. Madzulo ano mkhaletu
Pafupi ndine, Yesudi;
Ndisanagone tuloto,
Ndilingalira Inudi.

4. Kapena wina leroli
Wasokerera m’njirayi
Ya Inu Mbuye, mbwezetu,
Mumpulumutse iyedi.

hymns.title: Lero mwatipatsa moyo
hymns.text:
1. Lero mwatipatsa moyo,
Wadza mdima, kwada bii;
Mtigonetsetu usiku,
Mchotse zakuipazi.
Yesu mutisunga ife;
Tidzakhulupirabe.
Yesu mutisunga ife;
Tidzakhulupirabe.

2. Ndife anthu aulendo,
Tili ndi adaniwo;
M’manja mwani mtigonetse,
Mtichotsere manthawo.
Ndipo pakumuka ife,
Kwanu tidzapumabe.
Ndipo pakumuka ife,
Kwanu tidzapumabe.

hymns.title: Kwacha lero kwati mbee
hymns.section: MPINGO WA MULUNGU / TSIKU LA MULUNGU
hymns.text:
1. Kwacha lero kwati mbee,
Tsikku la Mulunguli;
Dzuwa liwaliradi
Thambo ndi zapansipa;
Upumira mpweyawu
Wa Mulungu konseku.

2. M’nyumba yanu, Mlungu, ’yi
Tisonkhana teretu,
Ndi mitundu yonseyi
Tikulambireni ’Nu;
Yesu Mbuye wathuyo
Ndiye Mfumu ponsepo.

3. Inu Mlungu kalelo
Mutalenga zonsezi
Munapuma tsikulo;
Tipumadi ifenso.
Mommo tilansiratu
Zopumitsa mtimawu.

4. Yesu munadzukanso
M’manda lero lomwetu;
Ntchito munayambayo
Yakudzutsa anthu ’fe,
Kuti ndi mitimayi
Tigwirebe ntchitozi.

hymns.title: Ambuye, tasonkhana
hymns.section: MPINGO WA MULUNGU / TSIKU LA MULUNGU
hymns.text:
1. Ambuye, tasonkhana
Tsiku lino lopatula;
Tidzapembedza Inu
Tsiku lino lopatula.
Bwenzilo lakufatsa,
Mbweretu kutipatsa
Mtima wakumvetsetsa
Tsiku lino lopatula.

2. Sitinanyalanyalaza
Tsiku lino lopatula,
Tigwadirira m’mantha
Tsiku lopatula.
Mbwezetu maganizo,
Mtimvetse malangizo;
Tchimo mufafanize
Tsiku lino lopatula.

3. Timvere Mawu anu
Tsiku lopatula;
Muwadalitse ndithu
Tsiku lopatula.
Mtiperekeze kwathu,
Msunge mitima yathu;
Mpatse chisomo chanu
Tsiku lino lopatula.

hymns.title: Dzuwa la Mulungu
hymns.section: MPINGO WA MULUNGU / TSIKU LA MULUNGU
hymns.text:
1. Dzuwa la Mulungu
Ladzatu labwino;
Ndi chimwemwe ife
Tiliona lero.
Lithawitsa nkhawa,
Lichotsanso mantha,
Ndimo m’mtima mwathu
Likhalitsa bata.

2. Tikondwera kuti
Tipumula lero;
Tazileka ntchito
Kuti tipemphere.
Koma ntchito zathu
Zapa lero lino
Nzakumvera Yesu,
Kumlandira bwino.

hymns.title: Ndi lokoma m’Mwambamo
hymns.section: MPINGO WA MULUNGU / NYUMBA YA MULUNGU
hymns.text:
1. Ndi lokoma m’Mwambamo,
Mbuye, Bwalo lanulo;
Ndi mwabwino muli ’Nu
Dziko losachimwali;
Mtima wanga wonsewu
Umakhumba m’Mwambamo
Nkhope ya Mbuyathuyu,
Mlungu wa chisomoyo.

2. Zimbalame zonsezi
Zimayamikira ’Nu;
Anthu amakondwanso
Okhumbira m’Mwambamo;
Njiwa yosapumayo
Inafika m’chombocho;
Okhulupirira ’Nu
Amapuma kwanuko.

3. Anthu opembedzawo
Amakondwa m’mtimamo;
Munapatsa madzitu,
Munagwetsa manawo;
Mumakoma mtimatu
Tidzayamikiratu,
Pa chimpandocho chanucho
Mkhale Mfumu yathudi.

hymns.title: Yesu mkhale nafe
hymns.section: MPINGO WA MULUNGU / NYUMBA YA MULUNGU
hymns.text:
1. Yesu mkhale nafe
Nthawi yomweyi,
Kuti mphamvu zanu
Tilandirezi.

2. Mzimu Wakuyera
Mutipatsetu,
Mtima wathu wonse
Usakhale duu.

3. Moyo watsopano
Ulimbitse ’fe;
Mlungu wathu yemwe
Timdikirabe.

hymns.title: Antchito a Mulungu ’nu
hymns.text:
1. Antchito a Mulungu ’nu
Olinda m’nyumba mwakemo.
Myamike, muimbiretu
Mulungu Mbuye wathuyo.

2. Mugwade pansi m’nyumbayo,
Mpembedze nonse Mlungutu;
Mugadamire m’Mwambamo,
Mtamande Mbuye wanutu.

3. Yehova adalitse ’nu,
Ndiyeyo wachifundocho,
Asunge moyo wanuwu;
Amtame anthu onsewo.

hymns.title: Kwezani mitu yanuyo
hymns.text:
1. Kwezani mitu yanuyo,
Zipata zamuyaya,
Ikalowemo Mfumu ya
Ulemereroyo!
Amfumu awa ndaniko?
Ambuye ndiyeyo,
Mulungu wogonjetsa onse,
Wolimba mphamvu njo!
Mulungu wogonjetsa onse,
Wolimba mphamvu njo!

2. Tatsegukani inutu,
Zitseko zosathera,
Amfumu a Kumwambako
Alowe mwanumo.
Amfumu awa ndaniko
Wolemereroyo?
Mulungu wa makamu ndiye,
Wolemereroyo.
Mulungu wa makamu ndiye,
Wolemereroyo.

Aleluya, aleluya,
Aleluya, aleluya,
Aleluya!
Amen, amen, amen.

hymns.title: Mulungu ali muno
hymns.text:
1. Mulungu ali muno,
Tonse timgwadire,
Mantha omwe timchitire;
Ali mukachisi,
Tonse tili chete,
Ndi ulemu timpembedze;
Ndiye yekha Mlungu wathu
Atipulumutsa,
Tizimlemekeza.

2. Mwini madalitso,
Mndikonzere m’mtima,
Mbuye, ndingokhulupira.
M’Mwambamo angelo
Agwadira Inu,
Ife tigonjanso kuno;
Mpingo wonse uchititse
Chifuniro chanu
Ponse pansi pano.

3. Yesu Mbuye wanga,
Mkhale m’mtima mwanga,
Ndiwotu kachisi wanu.
Ikafika imfa,
Mundisunge kwanu
Kuli Inu ndi angelo.
Moyo wanga ulimbike
Kufikira ine
Ndidzakupenyani.

hymns.title: Mtsinje woyerawo
hymns.text:
1. Mtsinje woyerawo
Wotuluka m’nyumbayo
Ya Mlungu wathuyo
Uyeretse tonsefe.
Ife tifikeko
Tibatizidweko,
Tiyeretsedwedi
Ndi Ambuye leroli.

2. Mwa anthu onsewo
Umayenda mtsinjewu,
Nuwachiritsadi
Okhulupirirawo.

3. Tikondwereratu
Pakumvera Yesuyo,
Abwere onsewo
Ndi kulowa m’mtsinjewu.

hymns.title: Atate, muwapenye
hymns.text:
1. Atate, muwapenye
Anzathu ali pano,
Abvomereza Inu
Ambuye Mfumu yawo;
Alonjezetsa lero
Kutsata Mbuye onse,
M’wathangatire iwo
Asabwerere konse.

2. Tsopano alandira
Chizindikiro chanu
Munachiika ndinu
Cha Ubatizo wanu.
Mulembe Dzina lanu
M’mitima mwa onsewa;
M’wabatizenso Mbuye,
Ndi Mzimu Wakuyera.

3. Muwalimbikitse onse
Akhazikike m’mtima,
Akhale chikhalire
Oyera ndi olimba;
Mutithandize tonse
A Mpingo wa Mulungu
Tikhale oyera
Ndi okondana ndithu.

hymns.title: Monga zomera zonsezo
hymns.text:
1. Monga zomera zonsezo
Zikulua ponsepo,
Mulungu mumeretsazo,
Momwemo anawo.

2. Munali mwana, Yesu ’Nu
Wamng’ono kalelo,
Ndi munakula m’msinkhu ndi
Kutama ’Tatewo.

3. Ndi ife tinga mbewuzo
Zomera m’mundawo;
Mumtima mutidyetsedi,
Tikule bwinomo;

4. Ndi kutsukidwa m’mwazimo
Mumtima mwathu mbee,
Tionetsedwe konseko
A Mlungu ana ’ke.

hymns.title: Usiku uja kalelo
hymns.section: MPINGO WA MULUNGU / MGONERO WA AMBUYE
hymns.text:
1. Usiku uja kalelo
Anampereka Yesuyo,
Usiku womwe m’manja mbuu
’Natenga mkate Iyeyo.

2. Natamndira Mlunguyo
Wolamulira pansipa,
Natema mkate, natitu
Kwa omwe anatsatawo:

3. "Ndi thupi lopatsidwali
La Ine, mtenge, mudye, ndi
Muchite ichi nonsenu,
Ndi chikumbutso changatu."

4. Ndiponso m’manja chikhocho
’Nakweza, natamandamo
Mulungu, mtima wake mya,
Nanena mawu omwewa:

5. "Chikho cha mwazi wangachi
Chitsuka mtima woda bii,
Cha mapangano omwewo
Chisomo cha Kumwambako.

6. Chikondi chili m’chikhomu
Chodzala; ’mwani nonsenu,
Chipitirire konseko,
Ndi chikumbutso changacho."

hymns.title: Sindili woyenera ’ne
hymns.section: MPINGO WA MULUNGU / MGONERO WA AMBUYE

hymns.title: Mongatu mawu anuwo
hymns.section: MPINGO WA MULUNGU / MGONERO WA AMBUYE
hymns.text:
1. Mongatu mawu anuwo,
Ndi mtima chete phee,
Mbuyanga kufa kwanuko
Ndikumbukire ’ne.

2. Chakudya chakumwambachi
Ndi thupi lanudi;
Chikho cha chipanganochi
Ncha mwazi wanuwo.

3. Getsemane ndionako
Ndi nkhope yanu dwii,
Thukuta la pamphumilo
La myazi yanuyi.

4. Ndi mtanda uli m’maso mbuu,
Ndiona m’menemo,
A Yesu kufa kwanuko,
Kuthetsa imfazo.

5. Pamene padzakhalapo
Milomo yanga phee,
Mukadza ndi Ufumunso,
Mukumbukire ’ne.

hymns.title: Mudze, anthuni, talawani ’nu
hymns.section: MPINGO WA MULUNGU / MGONERO WA AMBUYE
hymns.text:
1. Mudze, anthuni, talawani ’nu
Mkate ndi chikhocho cha Mbuyathu.

2. Kristu ndi mwini moyo wathuwu,
Pamtanda anafera ifetu.

3. Anatifera nsembe Iyeyo,
Ndiye Wamsembe wake Iyenso.

4. Imfa ndi mdima zinathawa zii!
Ndipo chisomo chikuwala mbuu.

5. Tadzanitu, okhulupiradi,
Talandira zachinsinsizi.

6. Ndiye wa moyo wonse Mwiniyo,
Moyo wosatha atipatsa ’fe.

7. Ndiye wodyetsa anthu omwewo,
natipatsa mwazi, moyo wakewo.

8. Yesu Mbuyathu, Inu nomwe ’Nu,
Tsopano mkhalebe ndi ifetu.

hymns.title: Mommuno, Mbuye, tionanetu
hymns.section: MPINGO WA MULUNGU / MGONERO WA AMBUYE
hymns.text:
1. Mommuno, Mbuye, tionanetu,
Mommuno ndizikhudza zanu phee,
Mommuno zachinsinsi zanu mbuu,
Mwa Inu mtima ndipumirabe.

2. Mommuno, Mbuye, mkate wanuwu,
Mommuno vinyo yakumwambako,
Mommuno zolemera zanga du,
Chisomo chanu ndidzalawanso.

3. Ndilibe wondithangata ’ne ’yi,
Ndilibe wina wondisunga ’ne;
Zikwaniratu mphamvu zanuzi,
Inde, Ambuye, mphamvu nzanudi.

4. Tsopano nthawi yake phwandili,
Loyala ili m’gome mwanumu;
Ndidye ndimwere zakukomazi,
Ndiyanjanebe nanu, Mbuyathu.

5. Chakudya ichi chidzapita du,
Chizindikitsa za Kumwambazo;
Zosapitazo tidzalawatu,
Za Yesu mwini wakukondako.

6. Tikadya phando zaka zonsezi,
Ndipo zakudya zimalozatu
Kuphwando lija la Kumwambako,
Komwe tidzadya kwa Mulungutu.

hymns.title: Ndinamva njala, Yesu
hymns.section: MPINGO WA MULUNGU / MGONERO WA AMBUYE
hymns.text:
1. Ndinamva njala, Yesu,
Ya mtima wakusowa;
Mndidyetse ngati mana
Anagwa m’chipululu.

2. Ndimamva ludzu Yesu,
Mulowe mwanga lero;
Mndimwetse ngati madzi
Anatuluka m’mwala.

3. Ndi mkate wanu, Yesu
Ndi thupi lobvulala,
Mndilimbitse, Mbuye,
Mundikhutitse mtima.

4. Mwa chikho chokumbutsa
Chikondi chopambana,
Mndipatse moyo wanu,
Ndikayanjane nanu.

5. Mndidyetse m’chipululu
M’ulundo wanga wonse;
Mndimwetse, ndipirire
Osalefuka konse.

hymns.title: A! Yesu, ndapangana
hymns.section: MPINGO WA MULUNGU / MGONERO WA AMBUYE
hymns.text:
1. A! Yesu, ndapangana
Kutumikira ’Nu
Ndi moyo wanga wonse,
Mbuyanga ndinutu;
Mukhaletu pafupi
Masikku onsewo,
Sindidzaopa konse,
Mutsogolereko.

2. Ndifuna kumva Inu,
E, Mawu anuwo,
Ndisamve za Satana
Zonyenga zakezo;
Adani anga onse
Andizingiratu;
Mukhaletu pafupi,
Mundithangate ’Nu.

3. A! Yesu mwapangana
Ndi anthu anuwo
Adzakhala ndinu
Ku Dziko lanulo;
Inenso ndapangana
Ndisabwerere ’yi;
Mndipatse mphamvu yanu
Ambuye ndinudi.

4. Mundionetse, Yesu,
Mapazi anuwo,
Ndidzapondera awa
Munjira monsemo;
Ndithangateni ine
Ndisalefuke ’yi;
Mundilandire m’Mwamba
Ndikamwaliradi.

hymns.title: Mundimvere, Mbuye wanga
hymns.section: MPINGO WA MULUNGU / MGONERO WA AMBUYE
hymns.text:
1. Mundimvere, Mbuye wanga
Nkana ine ndimalakwa,
Koma ndinu moyo wanga;
Mbuye, mkhale ndine.

2. Ndine mlendo pansi pano,
Msanditaye m’dzanja lanu,
Mundisunge mwana wanu;
Mbuye, mkhale ndine.

3. Munafera ine kale
Kuti mukandimasule,
Lero lino mndinyamule;
Mbuye, mkhale ndine.

4. Mundidzze ndi chikondi,
Mndiyeretse m’mtima monse,
Chifuniro change mthyole;
Mbuye, mkhale ndine.

5. Imfa ikandifikira,
Inu ndidzakangamira;
Ndikalowa ine m’mdima,
Mbuye, mkhale ndine.

hymns.title: Anu Mbuye ndifetu
hymns.section: MPINGO WA MULUNGU / MGONERO WA AMBUYE
hymns.text:
1. Anu Mbuye ndifetu!
Mutimvere kwanuko;
Anu tikhalirebe
Kuno ndi Kumwambako.

2. Anu Mbuye ndifetu!
Mwanu tipumiredi;
Ndinu Mbuye wanthu ’fe,
Mutisunge nthawizi.

3. Anu Mbuye ndifetu!
’Dikireni tonsefe;
Moyo ndinu, n’choona,
M’njiramo tiyendebe.

4. Anu Mbuye ndifetu!
Ndife nkhosa zanuzi;
Mwanu tibisalemu,
Mwanu mosungikadi.

5. Anu Mbuye ndifetu!
Tsogolani nthawizo;
Mtiyendetse m’moyomu
Kunkabe Kumwambako.

hymns.title: Ambuye, Mwini zonsezi
Peturo ’nafusa Hananiya
hymns.text:
1. Peturo ’nafusa Hananiya:
"Zopereka zili kuti?"
Hananiya ananena:
"Zopereka ndinapereka.”

Munthu aganize
Zimene anachita Hananiya;
Munthu aganize
Njira yakuunika.

2. Nthano ya Hananiyayo
Inali yodabwitsatu;
Ananyengatu Peturo:
"Zopereka ndinapereka."

3. Ife tonse tichenjere
Tingadzachite zomwezo;
Tisaname ndi kunena:
"Zopereka ndinapereka."

4. Mulungu akondadi leroli
Wopereka mokondwera;
Tikapereka motero
Tidzalandira dalitso.

hymns.title: Mbuye wathu mutipatsa
hymns.text:
1. Mbuye wathu mutipatsa
Zonse tili nazozo,
Mutikomeratu mtima
Osaleka konseko,
Mutikonda, mutisunga,
Mutisamalira ’fe.

2. Dzuwa, madzi, kudya, mpweya,
Moyo, zonse nzanuzi,
Si za ife, nzaulere,
Tingozilandiradi;
Zifumira kwa Atate
Wotikondakondatu.

3. Monga tilandira, Mbuye,
Mtiphunzitse tonsefe
Tipereke chuma chathu
Ndi kusangalalatu;
Zakukhalala m’manja mwathu;
Tiziyese nzanudi.

4. Tikhaletu nawo, Mbuye,
Mtima wosauma ’yi
Ndi wofatsa ndi wabwino
Ndi woyerayeradi,
Kuti tiyenere Dzina
La Mbuyathu Yesuyo.

5. Tisaiwalire ’bale
Athu osadziwa ’Nu,
Akulira ndi odwala
Tiwapemphereratu;
Titsanzenso Mbuye Yesu
Ndi k’wathangatira ’wo.

6. Dalitseni, Mbuye, zonse
Zomwe taperekazi,
Mzilandire, nsambe yathu yonse
Tikuyamikirani.

hymns.title: Polenga dzikoli
hymns.text:
1. Polenga dzikoli,
Pakumva Inudi,
Kwayeratu;
Mumve pempheroli,
Ndipo pamenepo
Palibe mawuwo,
Muwaletu.

2. Inu wakudzatu
Kuwachiritsadi
Anthendawo,
Kupatsa moyowo,
Kuona m’masomo,
Pa anthu onsewo
Muwaletu.

3. Mzimu woonadi
Ndi wachikondicho,
Idzanitu;
Muunikepo
Pali zamdimazo,
Pa dziko ponsepo
Muwaletu.

4. Inu Atatuwo,
Wodala Mlunguyo,
Timveretu;
Pa dziko ponsepo
Muchotse mdimawo,
Mutume Mawuwo,
Muwaletu.

hymns.title: Adzapambana Yesu ponse
hymns.text:
1. Adzapambana Yesu ponse
Pakuyenda dzuwalo;
Adzamverabe namgwadira
Pa dziko lonse pansipa.

2. Sadalekeza kuyamika
Ndi kuimbaimbabe;
Adzapemphera nsiku zonse
Natchula Dzina lakelo.

3. Pomveka konsekonse mbiri
Yake ya Wokondayo,
Ang’ono akwezanso mawu
Poimba nyimbo zawozo.

4. Ufumu wake udalitsa
Osauka onsewo;
Otopa amapuma chete,
Magoli amathyoka thyo!

5. Zolengedwa zonse zidze
Kugwadira Mfumu yathu,
Amlemekeze akumwamba,
Tiimbe pansipa: Amen.

hymns.title: Anthu akum’mawa
hymns.text:
1. Anthu akum’mawa
Nanka msangako,
Nzure ’nali nazo,
Nafatsansowo;
Nanka kuli Mwana
Anabadwayo;
Anatsogozedwa
Ndi nyenyeziyo.

2. Anapeza Mwana
Ali m’kholamo,
Namgwadira Iwo
Mbuye wawoyo;
Anthu onse omwe
Ali pansipa,
Azitsata Mbuye
Ndi nyenyeziyo.

3. Mu ulemerero,
Yesu m’Mwambamo
Muli eni ake;
Anthu onsewo
Osadziwa konse,
Akutalinso,
Akokedwe iwo
Ndi nyenyeziyo.

4. Akukhala kunja,
Osokeranso,
M’wawalire Mbuye,
Asagone ’wo;
Amumdima omwe,
Olemedwanso,
Mtsogoleri wawo
Ndi nyenyeziyo.

5. Paulendo wathu
Tili pansipa,
Muwalire tonse
Tili m’njiramo;
Mutitsogolere
Anthu tonsefe,
Mutifitse tonse
Ndi nyenyeziyo.

hymns.title: Tamva mawu amwewo
hymns.text:
1. Tamva mawu amwewo
Atitu: Yesuyo
Mpulumutsi ndiyedi,
Yesuyo, Yesuyo.
Pita m’midzi monsemo.
Dziko lonse limvetu,
Pita iwe konseko,
Mveratu Mbuyeyo.

2. Imbadi za Iyeyo,
Amvetu anthuwo
Kuti Yesu ’nafadi
Kalelo, kalelo.
Atikonda ifetu,
Natifera indedi
Kuchotsera tchimoli,
Yesuyo, Yesuyo.

3. Bukitsani mawunso
Konseko, konseko;
Kaitane anthuwo
Ponsepo, ponsepo.
Kodi wina samvatu?
Pitako, pitako ’we;
Angofuna onsewo
Yesuyo, Yesuyo.

hymns.title: Zipata zachitsulo zitseguke zonse mbee

lines: Tsatani Mbuye Yesuyo ndi mtanda wakewo;

hymns.text:
1. Zipata zachitsulo zitseguke zonse mbee!
Ambuye wa Kumwamba alowe
momwemo

2. Mbendera yake ikupiza m’mlengalengamo,
Kufanana ndi nyenyezi younika m’mdimamo.

3. Ankhondo a Mulungu ’nu, yendani m’njiramo,
Mitima yanu yonseyo iyeretsedwe mbuu!

4. Tsatani Mbuye Yesuyo ndi mtanda wakewo;
Mlaliketu Uthengawo kwa anthu onsewo.

5. Musamaopa kanthu ’yi, tamani Yesuyo;
Kaimbireni nyimboyi ndi mphamvu zonsezo.

6. Zipata zatsegudwa mbee! Za
m’dziko monsemo;
Ambuye wapambanatu ndi mtanda wakewo.

hymns.title: Pamaiko pali mdima
hymns.text:
1. Pamaiko pali mdima,
Penya mtima chetetu;
Leroli malonjezano
Angokwaniridwatu.
Kondwerani, kondwerani,
Yesu muwalitsetu.

2. Adze amitundu yonse,
Adze akutaliwo;
Ayang’ane mtanda uja
Woti nji paphiripo.
Mbiri yanu, mbiri yanu
Ibukike ponsepo.

3. Ponse padakhala mdima
Pakawale dzuwali;
Kumalire konsekonse
Muthawitse mdima bii!
Mpulumutsi, Mpulumutsi,
Muyeretse zonsezi.

4. Ibukike mbiri yanu,
Ifikire konseko,
Iwagwire anthu mtima,
Iwathyole m’katimo.
Mphamvu yanu, mphamvu yanu,
Idziwike konseko.

hymns.title: Mbwere Mlungu Mbuye wathu
hymns.text:
1. Mbwere Mlungu Mbuye wathu,
Msunge zakuonazo,
Mudalitse anthu onse
Ndi chifumu chanucho.

2. Mbwere Yesu Mwini moyo,
Ukuletu ’lemuwo;
Gonjetsani anthu onse,
Mpatsenso mtenderewo.

3. Mbwere Mzimu Wakuyera,
Mutitsitsimutseko;
Muthawitse mdima wonse,
Muwalitse m’mtimamo.

4. Anthu onse taukani,
Imbarani Mlunguyo;
Zichuluke zomtamanda
Pansi ndi Kumwambako.

hymns.title: Anyamata a Mulungu
hymns.text:
1. Anyamata a Mulungu,
Muzigwira nkhondoyo,
Mumenyane ndi Satana
Mzimu wakunyengayo.

2. Komwe asauka anthu
Akukhala m’mdimamo
Osamdziwa Mpulumutsi,
Phunzitsani konseko.

3. Pomangidwa anthu nayo
M’yambo yoipitsayo,
Pomwe amaopa chabe,
Masulani golilo.

4. Walitsani nyali yanu
Ikachotse mdima bii!
Mpaka ikainga zonse
Zasautsa m’dzikoli.

5. Akutopa ndi ofoka
M’watonthoze mtima phee!
Osokera, onyozeka
Muwafunefunebe.

6. Achisoni, obvutidwa,
M’wathandize msangatu;
Zosautsa zawo zonse
Yesu azichotsadi.

7. Anyamata limikani,
Gwirani nkhondoyi;
Yesu salephera mwini,
Satiiwalira ’yi.

8. Isaleke ntchito yake
Mpaka anthu onsewo
Alambira Mfumu yathu,
Namgonjera konseko.

hymns.title: Anthu ali m’mdima akuitanitsa
hymns.text:
1. Anthu ali m’mdima akuitanitsa
Unikani! Unikani!
Alikumwazika mungawalanditse,
Unikani! Unikani!

Tumizani kuunikako,
Kuoneketu kwa onsewo;
Tumizani kuunikako,
Nthawi zonsedi kuwaletu.

2. Tamva aku Makedonyako atero,
Unikani! Unikani!
Tititu, Ambuye tizinka komweko,
Unikani! Unikani!

3. Tisaleme pakuchita zabwinozi,
Unikani! Unikani!
Tidziunjikire ngale zakumwamba,
Unikani! Unikani!

hymns.title: Munene Mbuye ’nenetu
hymns.text:
1. Munene Mbuye ’nenetu,
Nditsanze mawu anuwo;
Munandifuna inetu,
Ine ndifune zanuzo.

2. Nditsogolere m’njirayi
Nkhosazo zisokerazo;
Ndidyetse, Mbuye, zanuzi
Zimene zifa njalayo.

3. Ndilimbikitse, Mbuye, nji!
Pamwalapo ndiimebe;
Onse alibe mphamvu ’yi
Omwewo ndithangate ’ne.

4. Ndiphunzitseni, Mbuyetu,
Ndidziwe nzeru zanuzo;
Munole mibvi yangayi,
Ipyole yonse m’mtimamo.

5. Ndipumulire panupo,
Ndinene motonthoza phe!
Ndi mawu opumitsawo
Olema ndikanenebe.

6. Ambuye, ndi chikondi tho!
Mudzaze mtima wangawu;
Ndinene zachikondicho,
Ndiyamikire monsemu.

7. Ndichitireni, Mbuye ’ne,
Monse mufuna mwanumo;
Kumwamba tionane mbee,
Maso ndi maso Kwanuko.

hymns.title: Mulungu wa Kumwamba
hymns.text:
1. Mulungu wa Kumwamba,
Tabwera kunoku
Ndi mtima wokondwera
Kulowa m’nyumbayi;
Chifukwa cha zabwino
Mwatichitirazi
Tikukuyamikirani.
Leroli.

Inde, tikuyamikani, Atate, leroli,
Mwatimangira ’fe kuno
Kachisi wanuyu!
Ndi ulemerero wanu
Mudzaze m’nyumbayi;
Muyeretse, mudalitse munomu.

2. Tikondwa tonse ndi kukuthokazani Nu
Poyamba kupemphera
Ndi kuimbiramu;
Mommuno nsiku zonse
Mukhale nafetu,
Monga angelo anu
M’Mwambamo.

3. Ikhale ngati nyali
Yowala nyumbayi,
Yakutsogoza onse
Ophunthwa m’mdima bii;
Akunja ndi Akristu
M’wapulumutse ndi
Kuunika kotuluka
Munomu.

hymns.title: Kristu ndiye mwala wathu
hymns.text:
1. Kristu ndiye mwala wathu,
Kristu timangirapo;
Wosankhidwa ndi Mulungu,
Atimange tonsefe;
Iye ndi Mthandizi wathu,
Timkhulupirira ’Ye.

2. Mudalitse nyumba yathu;
Mbuye, nthawi zonsetu
Muthandize anthu onse
Odza kuphunzira ’mu,
Ndi antchito anu omwe
Odza k’waphunzitsa ’mu.

3. Tiyamike Mlungu ’Tate,
Tiyamike Mwanayo,
Tiyamike Mzimu wake,
Onse omwe Mmodzitu,
Waulemerero wonse
Ndi wamphamvu ponsepo.

hymns.title: Anakwatira kale
hymns.text:
1. Anakwatira kale
Pa Edeni pajapo;
Ulipo lero lino
Mdalitso womwewo.

2. Awiri aimamu,
Mwamuna ndi mkaziyu;
O! Mzimu Wakuyera,
Madalitso mpatsetu.

3. Mulunzanitse awa,
Atate, leroli;
Munakwatits’ Adamu
Ndi Hava kalelo.

4. Mukhale nawo, Yesu,
Mongatu kalelo
Ukwati mnadalitsa
Pa Kana pajapo.

5. M’wasunge, m’wayendetse
Munjira yanuyo,
Akhale ndi kudala
Pabanja pawopo.

hymns.title: Yehova Mlungu wathu
hymns.text:
1. Yehova Mlungu wathu,
Amene mumapatsa
Zipatso za chikondi
Polenga anthu anu,
Mupatse awa ’wiri
Mitima yokondweretsa,
Yofana m’munda muja
Munayendamo kale.

2. Mbuyathu wokondedwa,
Pokhala m’dziko muno
Munadza ku ukwati,
Ukwatiwu mukonze,
Mukhale nafe pano;
Iwowa m’wadalitse
M’chifundo chanu chonse.

3. Ndi Mzimutu Woyera
Mufike nayo mphamvu,
Mukatsagane nawo
Akupangana omwe;
Mupatse ’wo chisomo
Chokometsa mtima;
Chikuletu chikondi
Chitsanzo nchanu chomwe.

4. Mulungu mwa Atatu,
Atate, Mwana, Mzimu,
Tikhaletu wokondwa
Ndi Inu m’chiyanjano;
Titama Inu Mlungu,
Wokonda ife ndinu;
M’ulendo wathu wonse
Tiyende m’chikondano.

hymns.title: Mulungu wa Yakobo Inu, mdyetsa anthu anu

lines: Mulungu wa Yakobo Inu, mdyetsa anthu anu,
Chakudya ndi chobvala mutipatse tsiku n’tsiku.
E, tikafike okondwera kwa Atate wathu.
Tipempha madalitso ano mpatse ife tonse;
Tisankha Inu ndithu Mlungu wathu nthawi zonse.

hymns.text:
1. Mulungu wa Yakobo Inu, mdyetsa anthu anu,
Kalelo munatsofolera makolo athuwo.

2. Tsopano tipereka mapemphero athu ano,
Mulungu wawo mukhalenso
Mulungu wa anawo.

3. Tikasokera m’njira mutilondolere ndithu,
Chakudya ndi chobvala mutipatse tsiku n’tsiku.

4. Mtifungatire ndi mapiko paulendo pathu,
E, tikafike okondwera kwa Atate wathu.

5. Tipempha madalitso ano mpatse ife tonse;
Tisankha Inu ndithu Mlungu wathu nthawi zonse.

hymns.title: Mlungu wathu mwatifitsa
hymns.text:
1. Mlungu wathu mwatifitsa
Kufikira leroli;
Moyo wathu munasunga
M’njira yonse yathuyi;
Mtsogoleri wathu ndinu
Paulendo pomwepo;
Tingakutameni bwanji
Kaamba zonse zanuzo?

2. E! chisomo chosaleka
Tichiona kalelo;
Masungidwe ndi chikondi
Zikalimo momwemo;
Pausana, pausiku,
Muli nafe ponsepo;
Madalitso anu omwe
Tili ndi ambiriwo.

3. Tinayenda muli mdima
Wotidetsa nkhawawo,
Pena tinangosauka
Ndi zobvuta zathuzo;
Koma Inu munalimo
Mumitambo yomweyo,
Nafe tinathandizana
Ndi mdalitso wanuwo.

4. Ena atsagana nafe
Natsiriza njirayo,
Nafikira kuli Inu,
Natilindirirako;
Tithadi ulendo wathu
Ndi kupita komweko,
Mutitsogolere ’Tate
Kukuwala kosatha.

hymns.title: Mbuye, tikuthokozani
hymns.text:
1. Mbuye, tikuthokozani,
Ndinu mwatitsogolera;
Zaka zonse mwatisunga;
Tiyamika mokondwera,
Zotibveka, zotidyetsa,
Mphamvu, moyo zonsezi;
’Tate tikuthokozani
Chaka chatsopanochi.

2. Ndinu mwatithangatira
Pakuona zosautsa;
Polefuka ndi podwala
Ndinu mwatitsitsimutsa.
Munatiteteza bwino
Tili ana kalelo,
Ndipo zomwe mwazichita
Chaka chotitheracho.

3. Chaka chino mutipatse
Mphamvu zosachimwa konse;
Zoipitsa mtichotsere zonse.
Mtithandize tizimvera
Kuyambira leroli,
Ndi kugwira ntchito zanu
Chaka chatsopanochi.

4. Inde, ’Tate, mtiyendetse
M’njira yolungamo yanu,
M’mtima mwathu mtiyeretse
Kuti tikondane nanu.
Zaka zonse muli nafe,
Sitiopa konse ’yi.
’Tate tikkuthokozani
Chaka chatsopanochi.

hymns.title: Tilimalima m’minda
hymns.text:
1. Tilimalima m’minda,
Tibzala mbewu zathu,
Komatu zibvumbidwa
Ndi Mlunguyo wamphamvu.
Dzuwalo awalitsa
namatumiza mphepo,
Mbewuzo nameretsa
Mulunguyo wabwino.

Mphatso zonse zathu
Zifunika wa Mulungu,
Tilemekeze Mbuye wathu,
Atikondadi

2. Wolenga ndi Yemweyo
Wa zinthu zonse zathu;
Maudzu ameretsa,
Nayatsanso nyenyezi.
Mphepozo zonse zimva,
Nyamazo aziweta;
Sadzaiwala konse
Anake kuwadyetsa.

3. Tiyamikira ’Tate,
Zabwino zonse zino,
Kubzala ndi kukunkha
Ndi moyo tili nawo.
Kuninkha Inu Mbuye
tilibe mtulo wina,
Komatu tipereka
Mitima yoyamika.

hymns.title: Yamikani nonse ’nu
hymns.text:
1. Yamikani nonse ’nu,
Pomwimbira nyimbozi
Za masika athuwa;
Potumiza mvulayi,
Mlengi wathu yemwedi
Atipatsa zonsezi;
Timwimbire m’nyumbayi
Za masika athuwa.

2. Dziko lathu lonseli
Nla Mulungu yemweyu;
Atumiza mphatsozi
Zakutilimbitsadi,
Mmera wathu wonsewu,
Mbewu zathu zonsezi;
Timtamande Mbuyeyu
Wotipatsa zonsezi.

3. Nthawi yina Mbuyeyu
Adzafika pansipa,
Nadzakonza zonsetu;
Zosakondweretsazi
Naziponya m’motowo,
Koma m’nkhokwe mwakemo
Mudzadzala mbewu tho!
Zomkomera bwinotu.

4. ’Dzani Mbuye msangatu,
Msonkhanitse zonse phe;
Anthu anu onsewa
Muwapulumutse ’wo;
Zopweteka zawozo
Ziwathere zonse phe;
’Dzani mu Ufumu ndi
Kwasonkhetsa onsewo.

hymns.title: Oyamika Mlungu mbwere
hymns.text:
1. Oyamika Mlungu mbwere,
Za masika mudzaimbe;
Dzinthu zathu takolola,
Siziwonongeka m’minda.
Mlungu Mlengi asamala,
Zotisowa, akonzera;
Mlowe m’nyumba ya Chauta,
Mkweze nyimbo zamasika.

2. Dziko lonse nla Mulungu
Kuti limbalire dzinthu;
M’munda zonse zimamera
Zakukoma ndi zoipa;
Mmera udza, bwino ngala,
Maso omwe amakwima;
Mutilole, Mwini dzinthu,
Tikakhale dzinthu zanu.

3. Adzabwera Mbuye wathu
Kukulola dzinthu zawo;
M’munda mwawo akachotse
Minga ndi zoipa zonse.
Adzatumanso angelo
Minga akaponye m’moto,
Koma tirigu amsunge
M’nkhokwe yake nthawi zonse.

hymns.title: Chifukwa cha zokoma mtima zonse za u lerezo

lines: Chifukwa cha zokoma mtima zonse za u lerezo,
Maluwa abwino aphuka m’mapiri ndi m’madambomo,
Tidzakhala naye nthawi zonse ndi kuimbako,

hymns.text:
1. Chifukwa cha zokoma mtima zonse za u lerezo,
Timlambire Mbuye;
Tikweze nyimbo yathu yakukondwa
kuli ’Ye,
Timgwadiretu.

2. Dzinja lokondweretsa lafikanso,
litapumatu,
Timlambire Mbuye;
Mvula igundanso, Mulungu wotikonda ’fe,
Timgwadiretu.

3. Dziko lonse lilikukondwa,
mlengalenga mpheponso,
Timlambire Mbuye;
Zapansi pano zonse zimtamandire
Mulungu wathuyo,
Timgwadiretu.

4. Maluwa abwino aphuka m’mapiri ndi m’madambomo,
Timlambire Mbuye;
Masamba awisi ang’ono agwedezekanso,
timgwadiretu.

5. Zanu zapansi nzokoma Mbuye;
tikondwera ’fe,
Timlambire Mbuye;
Koma kwanu Kumwamba komwe kwapambanatu,
Timgwadiretu.

6. Nafenso tidzadzuka kwa ’ke ngati maluwawo,
Timlambire Mbuye;
Oyera mtima adzabvala mbuu!
Pakudza Kristuyo,
Timgwadiretu.

7. Tidzakhala naye nthawi zonse ndi kuimbako,
Timlambire Mbuye;
Kumene moyo wa anthu okhulululukidwa
uli wokomatu,
Timgwadiretu.
Alaluya, Amen!

hymns.title: Mlengi wathu Wakuyera
hymns.text:
1. Mlengi wathu Wakuyera,
Mutimvere ’fe,
M’wasungire akutali,
Bwinodi.

2. Mbuye Yesu, myandikire,
M’wakondweretsebe;
Mulimbitse mphamvu zawo
Zonsezo.

3. Akaona masautso
Mkhale nawodi;
Akondwere mwa chikondi
Chanucho.

4. Mpulumutsi wakukoma,
Muwagwirize;
Nsiku zonse akulemekezeni (Akule-mekezeni)

5. Mzimu wanu Wakuyera,
Awayeretse;
Agonjetse ndi chisomo,
M’nkondoyi.

6. ’Tate, Mwana, Mzimu, ndinu
Mlungu mmodzitu,
Muwasunge m’fupi mwanu
Ponsepo.

hymns.title: Yesu, munditsogoza
hymns.text:
1. Yesu, munditsogoza
M’njira yanga yonseyo;
Wakunditsogozatu
Ndinu, mundisungetu;
Inde, paulendowo
Mundisunge kolimba.

2. Monga may’asusuza
Mwana wake polira,
Wakunditonthozatu
Ndinu, munditonthoze,
Inde, m’njira yanuyi
Munditsogoleretu.

3. Mbuye, ndinu wamphamvu,
Mumatola ananu,
Anthu onse pansipa
Ali otaikatu;
Muchitire chifundo,
Muwatole onsewo.

hymns.title: Mlungu ali nane
hymns.text:
1. Mlungu ali nane;
Amadziwazi
Ndizinena, penanso
Za mumtimamo.

2. Mlungu ali nane
Ndi usikuwo,
Nandiona momwemo
Mu usanamo.

3. Mlungu ali nane;
Zachinsinsizo
Zosaonekerako
Azidziwatu.

hymns.title: Mlungu, Inutu
hymns.text:
1. Mlungu, Inutu,
Mwalenga dzuwali,
Nyenyezi, mwezi mbee,
Ndi dzikoli.

2. Koma ineyu
Simuiwala ’yi;
Mundisamala ’ne
Ndisagwe ’yi.

3. Mbuye, Msungi ’Nu,
Mutuma indedi
Za moyo wangawu
Zokomazi.

4. Yesu Mwanatu
Anafa imfayo
Achotsa zoti bii;
Nadzukanso;

5. Kuti m’Mwambamo
Ndikatamandetu
Wondisamalabe,
Mbuyangayu.

hymns.title: A! Mulungu
hymns.section: NYIMBO ZA ANA / KUBADWA KWA KRISTU
hymns.text:
1. A! Mulungu,
A! Mulungu
Anatuma Mwana wake
Uja, ndiye Yesu.

2. Anabadwa,
Zachinsinsizo
Anabadwa,
Ndi Mariya mbeta ija
M’Betlehemu muja.

3. Ndi angelo,
Ndi angelo
Anaimba: "Ndiye Yesu
Mpulumutsi wanu."

4. Alanditsa,
Alanditsa
Ife anthu muzoipa
Zonse tazichita.

5. Yesu Mfumu,
Yesu Mfumu,
Timagonja, mutisunge
Moyo wathu wonse.

6. Mutitsuke,
Mutitsuke,
M’mwazi wanu, tikakhale
Ana anu tonse.

hymns.title: Taonani m’kholamo
hymns.section: NYIMBO ZA ANA / KUBADWA KWA KRISTU
hymns.text:
1. Taonani m’kholamo
Mwabadwira Mfumuyo
Yakulonjezedwadi,
Nsembe yathu ndiyeyu.

Kondwerani nonsenu
Pomvetsedwa mbiriyi
Yakumveka m’mzindamo:
"Wabadwira m’Betlehemu."

2. Adagona m’ndyeromo
Wochokera m’Mwambayo,
Adasiya mpandowo
Yesu Kristu Mfumuyo.

3. Falitsani mbiriyi,
Inudi abusa ’nu;
Nkhosa zanu zonsezo
Mwasiy’ranji m’phirimo?

4. Pochezera m’dambomo,
Tinaona ’ngelotu
Oimbira mawuwo
A mtendere pansipa.

5. Mwana wakuyera ’Nu,
Munakonda ifedi;
Munasiya kwanuko
Ndi kufika pansipa.

6. Mtiphunzitse bwinotu,
Mwana wakuyera ’Nu,
Tifanane nanudi
M’makhalidwe anuwo.

hymns.title: Tiimbe ndi kulalikira
hymns.section: NYIMBO ZA ANA / KUBADWA KWA KRISTU
hymns.text:
1. Tiimbe ndi kulalikira
Mthenga wa chikondicho
Anamva Mlungu m’Mwambamo
Kulira kwathu pansipa.

(Ndikhulupirira Yesu
Wobadwira m’kholamo;
Iye ndiye Mfumu yathu,
Timtame nthawi zonse.)

2. Kwa ife lero anabadwa
Mwana wa Mariyayo,
Pamsinkhu, inde mn’gono koma
Mwini dziko lonseli.

3. Anadza nazo mphatso zake
Anatikonzeratu;
Anatseguliradi
Pakhomo pa Ufumuwo.

4. Ambuye, tikutamandani
Tsiku lakubadwali,
Mwa Inu tonse tikondwera,
Tisekera tonsefe.

5. A! Yesu Mbuye wakuyera,
Munagona m’kholamo;
Mudzikonzere leronso
Mugona m’mtima mwangamu.

6. Ulemerero m’Mwambamwamba
Ndi mtendere pansipa;
Tiimbe nafe nyimboyi,
Timyamike Mbuyathu.

(Yesu ndiye Mfumu,
Yesu ndiye Mfumu!
Ndikhulupirira Yesu
Wobadwira m’kholamo.)

hymns.title: Ana inu, ana inu
hymns.section: NYIMBO ZA ANA / KUBADWA KWA KRISTU
hymns.text:
1. Ana inu, ana inu,
Taukani, ndi kumvera
Amithenga akumwamba;
Anafika kalelo,
Natiuza Mpulumutsi
Anabadwa pansipa.
Zaka zonse, tsiku lomwe
Umamveka mthengawu.

2. M’nyumba zonse ponseponse
Zimamveka nyimbo izi,
Kuti Yesu anabadwa,
Anagona m’kholamo.
Anafika Mpulumutsi
Wotikondweretsadi,
Kondwerani, kondwerani,
Inu nonse ana ’nu.

3. Taukani, taonani
M’mwamba monse mwakuyera;
Amithenga a Mulungu
Aimbabe nyimboyo.
Yesu Kristu anatsika,
Anachoka kwawoko;
Lero lonse tiimbenso
Nyimbo yathu yomweyo.

hymns.title: Kale m’mzinda wachifumu
hymns.section: NYIMBO ZA ANA / KUBADWA KWA KRISTU
hymns.text:
1. Kale m’mzinda wachifumu
Munalimo m’kholamo,
Momwe mkazi anaika
Mwana wake m’ndyeromo,
Ndiye mkaziyo Mariya,
Yesu Kristu Mwanayo.

2. Uyu ’natsikira kuno,
Mlungu Mbuye wathuyo
Anabadwa uyu m’khola
Anagona m’dyeromo.
Mwa osowa ndi oipa
Yesu anakhalamo.

3. Mwa ubwana wake wonse
Anakula m’mtima phee!
Anakonda, anafatsa,
Amay’wake namvabe;
Ndipo ana nonsenu,
Mukamtsate bwinotu.

4. Ndipo Mwana uyu Yesu
Anakulakulabe;
Ndi wamng’ono ndi wofoka,
Anangonga enawo.
Nsoni zathu anazimva
Ndi chimwemwe chathunso.

5. Ndi chifukwa atikonda,
Tidzampenya masowa,
Kuti Mwanayo wofatsa
Ndiye mwini m’Mwambamo;
Atengera ana ake
Komwe adapitako.

6. Koma sitimpenya m’khola
Muli ng’ombe momwemo;
Ayi, tidzamwona m’Mwamba
Muli Mlungu ’Tatewo.
Ana akuyera mbuu
Adzamzunguliratu.

hymns.title: Usikuwo woyerawo
hymns.section: NYIMBO ZA ANA / KUBADWA KWA KRISTU
hymns.text:
1. Usikuwo woyerawo!
Mwana adamlerayo
Akakhale Mfumuyo.
Anabadwa m’kholamo,
Mfumu ya mafumu
Ndi ya anthuwo.

2. Mwanayo wa Mulunguyo
Andikonda inetu,
Nan’tayira chumacho
Nadzagona m’udzumumo.
Ndiyamika Mbuye
Wanga Yesuyo.

3. Usikuwo woyerawo!
Wadzatu mtenderewo
Ife tonse anthuwo
Atitenga Mlunguyo.
Mlemekeze ’Tate,
Mwana, Mzimunso.

hymns.title: Kale anthu m’kholamo
hymns.section: NYIMBO ZA ANA / KUFERA KWA KRISTU
hymns.text:
1. Kale anthu m’kholamo
’Napembedza Mwanayo.

Ndiye Mbuye, Mfumu yanga,
Ndiye Mbuye wa Kumwamba.
Agwadire anthuwo,
Timtamande Mfumuyo.

2. Wosauka Iyedi
Anagwira ntchitozi.

3. Ndani kodi Munthuyo
Woyesedwa m’bwinjamo?

4. Analira ndaniyo
Pomwalira Bwenzilo?

5. M’munda muja ndaniyo
Mwazi wake dontho do?

6. Iye ndani pamtanda
Anafera ’daniwo?

7. Mkucha wake ndaniyo
’Natuluka m’mandamo?

8. Ndani pachimpandocho
Alamula ponsepo?

hymns.title: Kuli kaphiri m’talimo
hymns.section: NYIMBO ZA ANA / KUFERA KWA KRISTU
hymns.text:
1. Kuli kaphiri m’talimo
Kunja kwa mzindamo
Kwapachikidwa Yesuyo
Nafera ifetu.

(Kuli kaphiri m’talimo
Kunja kwa mzindawo,
Kwapachikidwa Yesuyo
Nafera ifetu.)

2. Zoopsya sitidziwapo
Anazitengazo,
Komatu tidziwitsa ’fe
Anatiferapo.

3. Anatifera tonsefe
Towomboledweko,
Tifike momwe m’Mwambamo
Ndi mwazi wakewo.

4. Kulibe wokwanira ’yi
Kulipa mlanduwo,
Wina wakutsegula ’yi
Pakhomo pakepo.

5. Anatikondakonda ’Ye.
Timkonde ifenso;
Tizimtsatira, tithetu
Zintchito zakezo.

hymns.title: Ana inu, myamikeni
hymns.text:
1. Ana inu, myamikeni
Mpulumutsi Yesuyo,
Kaamba ka chikondi chake
Ndi chipulumutsocho.

Aleluya! Aleluya!
Timwimbire Yesuyo.
Aleluya! Aleluya!
Timwimbire Yesuyo.

2. Iye anachoka kwawo,
Anakhala pansipa,
Kale ana ’namwimbira
Namukondweretsadi.

3. Anafika ’kazi omwe
Ndi tiana tawoto;
Yesu anatiyangata,
Anatidalitsatu.

4. Amithenga akumwamba
Amamyamikiratu;
Zikwi zosawerengeka
Zimtamanda Mfumuyo.

5. Ana inu, yamikani
Bwenzi lanu lomweli;
M’Mwamba momwe mudzampenya
Ndi kumtamandirabe.

hymns.title: Ananu, ziimbani
hymns.text:
1. Ananu, ziimbani,
Aleluya, Amen.
Ambuye tamandani,
Aleluya, Amen.
Kwezani mawu anu,
Patsani mtima wanu,
Afuna kumva inu,
Aleluya, Amen.

2. Bwerani, kondwerani,
Aleluya, Amen.
Ambuye akumvani,
Aleluya, Amen.
Amatitsogolera,
Kalelo natifera,
Kukonda salekera,
Aleluya, Amen.

3. Mbuye timlemekeze,
Aleluya, Amen.
Kwawo tikabwereze,
Aleluya, Amen.
Kumwamba timtamire,
Tikamgwadire ife,
Tikhale chikhalire,
Aleluya, Amen.

hymns.title: Mnandidzera, Ambuye
hymns.text:
1. Mnandidzera, Ambuye,
Kumwambako,
Munasiya ukuluwo;
Koma m’mudziwotu munabadwamo
Munasowa pogonapo.

Idzani mumtima mwanga,
Muli malo a Inu’mo.

2. Amithenga ’naimba pamlengapo,
Nalalika ulemuwo;
Koma Inu munadza mofatsatu,
Munabadwa mukholamo.

3. Zili nazotu nkhwimba zirombozo,
Ndi mbalamenso zisatu;
Koma Inu Ambuye mwapandadi
Potsamirapo mutu duu!

4. Munaneneratu mawu a moyonso
Omasula ochimwawo;
Koma omwe ochimwa ’nanyozatu,
Nakuphani pamtandapo.

5. Pakubweranso Inu m’Ufumuwo
Ndi zamphamvuzo zanunso,
Mundimvetse za kwanu.
Kumwambako
Kuli malo a ine ’ko.

Ukondwere mtima wanga
Pakumvera zokomazo.

hymns.title: Akazi anadza
hymns.text:
1. Akazi anadza
kwa Yesu ndi anawo,
Anawaletsa anyamata
nawakana ndithu;
Ambuye nawapezadi,
Anati: "Musatero ’yi,
Lolani ana abwere kwa Ine,
Lolani ana abwere kwa Ine.

2. "Ndidzawalandira,
k’wasunga m’manja mwanga;
Ndi Mbusa wao Inetu,
msachotse ana anga;
Akandipatsa mtimawo,
Adzanka ndine Kwathuko;
Lolani ana abwere kwa Ine,
Lolani ana abwere kwa Ine."

3. Wokoma Mbuyathu
kwitana ana onse;
Atsalanso ambiri ena
sanamvera zake;
Sanamva mawu akewo,
Sadziwa kuti ’natinso;
"Lolani ana abwere kwa Ine,
Lolani ana abwere kwa Ine."

4. Afike masiku
akuti anthu onse
Adzamva mawu anu
ndi kutsata inu nokha;
Muwale mtima mwawomo,
Adziwe muwakondanso;
Kopani anthu abwere kwa Inu,
Kopani anthu abwere kwa Inu.

hymns.title: Ana a Yerusalemu
hymns.text:
1. Ana a Yerusalemu
Anatama Mbuye wawo;
Lero lomwe ife ana
Timwimbira nyimbo yawo.

Mverani, aimba anawo,
Mverani, aimba anawo
Zakutama, zakutama,
Zakutama Mbuyeyo.

2. Tamva tikondane naye,
Tiwerenge Mawu ake,
M’njira mwake tiyendemo,
Tiziimba nyimbo zake.

3. Apunzitsi, ana omwe,
Ndi akulu, t’iimbe tonse;
Nyimbo zathu zidzakwera
Zikamveke m’Mwamba monse.

hymns.title: Osanatu, osana
hymns.text:
1. Osanatu, osana,
’Naimba anawo;
M’kachisi wa Mulungu
Mwamveka nyimboyo.
’Nalemekeza Yesuyo
Wak’wadalitsayo;
Anamuyamikira
M’ubwana wawowo.

2. Kuphiri la ’Zitona,
Mumpingo wa ’nthuwo,
’Namkupizira mnjedza
Naimba nyimboyo.
Angelo akumwambako
Napokerezanso;
“Osana m’Mwambamwamba
Kwa Mlungu wathuyo.”

3. Zitsamba zakuyera
’Naponya pansipo;
Kukondwa kunamveka
Paphiri ponsepo.
ambuye yemwe Mfumutu
Nakwera cheteko;
Tiana toyamika
Sanatinyozato.

4. "Osana m’Mwambamwamba!"
Nyimboyi t’iimbenso,
Pokhala Kristu Mfumu
Ndi Mpulumutsiyo.
Timtamandire Iyeyu
Ndi mtima wonsewo;
Tipite kwawo komwe
Tikaimbirenso.

hymns.title: Ngolizo zilira
hymns.text:
1. Ngolizo zilira
Za ’mithengawo,
Ndi zipata zonse
Zatsegudwa mbee!
Kristu, Mfumu yathu,
Mbuye wathudi,
Wapambana monse,
Alamulabe.

Ntchito zake zatha,
Timwimbiretu;
Yesu wakwera,
Timtamandetu.

2. ’Natipulumutsa
Natiferako,
Ali Mfumu ndithu
Kwa Atatewo;
Osasautsidwa,
Osafanso ’yi,
Yesu, Mfumu yathu
Adakweradi.

3. Atipempherera
M’malo ’dalawo,
Tinke kwathu komwe
Ndi chisomocho;
Akonzera malo
Ana akewo;
Yesu alipobe,
Atikondanso.

hymns.title: Ndikondwa kuti Atate wam’Mwamba
hymns.text:
1. Ndikondwa kuti Atate wam’Mwamba
Atidziwitsa chikondicho chake;
Ndimawerenga m’Uthenga Wabwino
Kuti Ambuye akonda anake.

Ndikondwa kuti Yesu akonda,
Yesu akonda, andikondabe,
Ndikondwa kuti Yesu akonda,
Amandikondabe.

2. Yesu ndimkonda, akondanso ine,
Anandifera pamtanda woopsa.
Wosayenera, woipa ndi ine;
Tsoka langalo Ambuye ’nachotsa.

3. Mzimu Woyera akhala mwa ine,
Atsimikiza chikondi cha Yesu;
Ine n’tachimwa amandikumbutsa;
"Lapa mwana ’we, akukonda Yesu,"

4. Ndikadzaona Ambuye Kumwamba,
Sindidzaopa pokhala akonda;
Anandikonzera kalelo nyumba,
Ndidzakhalamo wokondwa,
wokoma.

hymns.title: Ndikonda mbiri yomwe
hymns.text:
1. Ndikonda mbiri yomwe
Ya amithengawo
Ya Mbuye, Mfumu yathu
Pofika pansipa;
Zochimwa zindizinga,
Koma ndidziwatu
Anawombola ine
Pakundikondadi.

2. Ndikondwa kuti Yesu
’Nakhala mwanatu,
Chitsanzo atipatsa
Cha moyo wakewo;
Ndikati ndimtsatire
Zochita zakezo,
Sadzandiyoza konse
Pakundikondadi.

3. Pakumyamika Iye
Ndidzamwimbiratu;
Ngakhale sindimwona
Amandimveradi;
Pakuti walonjeza
Adzalandira ’ne
Ndiimbe ndi angelo,
Pakundikondadi.

hymns.title: Yesu andikonda ine
hymns.text:
1. Yesu andikonda ine,
Amatero m’Buku Iye;
Akafoka mwana wake
Adzamlimbikitsa Mbuye.

Yesu akonda,
Yesu akonda,
Yesu akonda,
Atero m’Bukumo.

2. ’Nafera Mbuye wanga
Anditsegulire m’Mwamba,
Ndi machismo anga onse
Adzandichotsera konse.

3. Mbuye Yesu andisunga
M’njira ya Kumwamba kuja;
Andigwira m’dzanja langa
Ndingagweremo m’makwawa.

4. Yesu andikonda ine;
Ndikadzafa tsiku lina
Atengera ine kuno,
Ndikakhale naye kwawo.

hymns.title: Yesu Mbuye ’Nu wafatsa
hymns.text:
1. Yesu Mbuye ’Nu wafatsa
Muyang’anedi kamwana,
Mndichitiretu chifundo;
Mundilole kwa Inutu.

2. Ndimalira kwa Inutu,
Mpatse mtimawo wabwino;
M’Dziko lanu lowalalo
Mulandire mwana wanu.

3. Yesu, E, ndikufunani,
Ndinu chuma change chonse
Mtima wanu ngwofatsadi;
Kale munali kamwana.

4. Wonga Inu ndikhaledi,
Mtima wanu mundipatse;
Yesu ndinu wokomatu,
Mndiphunzitse kukonda ’Nu.

5. Yesu Mbuye ’Nu wabwino,
M’manja mwanu ndikhalemo;
Mzimu wanu mundipatse,
M’mtima mwangatu mukhale.

hymns.title: Yesu, ndikabwera
hymns.text:
1. Yesu, ndikabwera
Mundikondweretsa,
Nsoni zanga mun’chotsera
Zonsezo.

Ndikabwera, Mbuye
Ndidzakondwa ine;
Muitana ana onse
Onga ’ne.

2. Yesu, ndikabwera,
Mumva mapemphero.
Mundikonda, mnandifera
Inetu.

3. Yesu, ndikabwera
Dzanja mdzandigwira;
Nokha mdzandilondolera
Njirayo.

4. N’takafika kwanu
Ndidzakhala bwino,
N’dzaonana ndi ananu,
Ndi Yesu.

hymns.title: Yesu wa Kumwamba
hymns.text:
1. Yesu wa Kumwamba,
Mutimvere ife;
Tikugwadirani,
Mwana wa Mulungu.

2. Ndinu wakuyera,
Mfumu yakumveka;
Ife sit’yenera,
Koma mutimvere.

3. Ndife akuchoka,
Mwina tisokera;
M’njira ya Kumwamba
Mutitsogolere.

4. Mutiletse, Mbuye,
Lero tisachimwe;
Tikondane ndinu
Mutitsuke m’mtima.

5. Mukatiitana
Tikakhale kwanu,
Tidzayankha, "Mbuye,
Tsono tili pano.”

(Yesu, Yesu,
Tikugwadirani
Mwana wa Mulungu!)

hymns.title: Mpulumutsi, Mbusa wathu
Mzinda woyerawo
hymns.text:
1. Mzinda woyerawo!
Konse nkotsekako;
Kanthu koipa,
Kanthu koipa,
Sikangalowemo.

2. Yesu ndafikatu,
Mbuyanga kwanuku;
Mundiyeretse,
Mundiyeretse,
Mnditsuke m’mtimamu.

3. Mbuye ndikhaletu
Mwana wokonda ’Nu,
Ndi wosungidwa,
Ndi wosungidwa,
Ndi mphamvu zanuzo.

4. Mpaka ndabvala mbuu!
Wowomboledwatu,
Woyera mtima,
Woyera mtima,
Kwanu Kumwambako.

hymns.title: Mbuye, tili ana anu
hymns.text:
1. Mbuye, tili ana anu,
Tiyamike Inutu;
Zinthu zonse zili zanu,
Tingadike m’mtimamo.
Tiganize zake Yesu,
Za Kumwamba kuli ’Ye;
Tisachite zomsautsa,
Aziona zonsezo.

2. Amakumbukira zonse
Tizichitia zomwezo.
Tidzamukomana tonse,
Sitinyazitsidwako.
Mukhululukire ife
Tchimo lathu lonselo;
Mutitsogolere ife
M’njira ya Kumwambako.

hymns.title: Yesu, muli pa chimpando
Yesu atiuza tiwale ’fe
hymns.text:
1. Yesu atiuza tiwale ’fe,
Monga nyali m’mdima tiunike
mbee!
Pansi pali mdima walanitu,
Inu m’malo mwanu ndi ine ’mu.

2. Yesu atiuza tiyambemo,
Ationa bwino ndi kuwalako;
Ayang’ana pansi powala ’fe,
Inu m’malo mwanu ndi ine ’mu.

3. Yesu atiuza tiwale pa
Anthu ali m’mdima osaukawa;
Tiwalire onse, tonsefetu,
Inu m’malo mwanu ndi ine ’mu.

hymns.title: Anyamata inutu
hymns.text:
1. Anyamata inutu,
Anamwali inunso,
Muti: "Tingachitenji,
Ang’ono ndifetu,
Kuthandiza Ufumu
Wa Yesu?"

2. Aphunzitse anthuwo,
Awalalikiredi,
akukhala moipa
Mumdima wakunja,
Alowetu m’Ufumu
Wa Yesu.

3. E! ang’ono ndifetu,
Nzeru sizimafika
Kuti tingaphunzitse;
Titani tonsefe
Kuthandiza Ufumu
Wa Yesu?

4. Inu nonse anzanga,
Tiziganiza bwino,
tinganene mofatsa,
Timverenso Mbuye
Kuthandiza Ufumu
Wa Yesu.

5. Pothandiza amathu,
Pak’wakonda anzathu,
Pakusiya zoipa,
Pokhaladi bwino,
tithandize Ufumu
Wa Yesu.

hymns.title: Tiana ife tingofoka
hymns.text:
1. Tiana ife tingofoka,
Sitikhala ’mphamvu ’yi;
Tikhoza kukachitiranji
Yesu kumkondweretsadi?

2. Tiana ta Ambuye tili
N’ntchito yaikuludi,
Kudzichepetsa, ndi kusiya
Tchimo lili lonseli.

3. Kapena m’mtima ndimakwiya,
Nditukwana mnzangayo,
Kapena ndidzitama - izi
Ndilekere Mbuyeyo.

4. Mdileke kulimbna ndi
Kuwanamiza enawo;
Ndinena zakufatsa,
Zakukondweretsa Yesuyo.

5. Tizikondana, tisekere
Tsiku lonse kwathuko,
Muyere m’mtimamo popeza
Yesu ndi Woyerayo.

6. Palibe mwana wakuchepa
Kunyamula mtandawu;
Ambuye Yesu mutipatse
Mtima wokondanatu.

hymns.title: Usachimwe konse
hymns.text:
1. Usachimwe konse,
Lekati kukwiya;
Uli mwana wake,
Mwana wa Mbuyathu.

2. Yesu ndi wofatsa,
Yesu ndi woyera;
Ana ake omwe
Aziyera m’mtima.

3. Mzimu wakuipa
Ukusuzumira,
Umakuyesera
Kuti ukachimwe.

4. Koma usalole
Mawu a Satana;
Bweza tchimo lake,
Chita zolungama.

5. Yesu ndi Mbuyako,
mbuyeyo ngwabwino;
Ana ake omwe
Aziyera m’mtima.

hymns.title: Tchimo musalole
hymns.text:
1. Tchimo musalole,
Musadziipitse,
Myese kudzikana,
Muzilimbikadi;
Mwamphamvu mpirire,
Mgonjetse zabiizi;
Mpenye kuli Yesu,
Adzakusungani.

Mpemphe Mbuye asunge
Atonthoze m’mtimau,
Alikukufunani,
Akasunge inutu.

2. Mlewe oipawo,
Ayi msatukwane,
Dzina la Mbuyathu
Muzilikwezadi;
Khalani achangau,
Oona, abwino;
Mpenye kuli Yesu,
Adzakusungani.

3. Yesu alandira
Akupirirawo;
Chikhulupiriro
Chiwathandizadi.
Mbuye athangata
Onse akumvera;
Mpenye kuli Yesu,
Adzakusungani.

hymns.title: Nthawi yaubwana yatha
hymns.text:
1. Nthawi yaubwana yatha,
Sukulu yathu yathanso;
Nkhawa ndi zowawa zomwe
Zitibisaliranso.

2. Yesu wakufatsa mtima
Mlendo pansi pano ’Ye,
’Natifera, natisunga,
Atitsogolere ’fe.

3. Tamverani, aitana:
"Ana, munditsatetu."
Yesu, tisapite kwina,
Tizikutsani ’Nu.

4. Posachedwa tilekana
Osalankhalananso,
Koma tidzaona tonse
Wina mnzake m’Mwambamo.

hymns.title: Yesu ndiye Mbusa
hymns.text:
1. Yesu ndiye Mbusa,
Mbusa wakukoma,
Anyamula ana
Ake akuopa;
Tizitsata Yesu,
Atitsogolera,
Kwina kuli mdima,
Kwinanso koyera.

2. Yesu ndiye Mbusa,
Atipenyetsetsa,
Mawu ake onse
Atikondweretsa.
Mwina alangiza
Mwana wakulakwa;
Atsogola bwino,
Ife tizimtsata.

3. Yesu ndiye Mbusa,
Anafera kale
Kuyeretsa ana
Nawo mwazi wake,
Tsono awalemba
Ndi chizindikiro:
"Ana anga onse
Andikhulupira."

4. Yesu ndiye Mbusa
Wakusunga ife,
Ali wachifundo
Chachikulu ndithu;
Sitiopa imfa
Akhala nafe,
Yesu Mbuye wathu
Alandira ife.

hymns.title: Pompano pandikonda
hymns.text:
1. Pompano pandikonda
Poyendayenda ’ne;
Pawala mosekera
Ndi dzuwa loti mbee!
Ndikondwa nsiku zonse
Ndikale m’dzikoli,
Potsata Yesu m’njira yake
Yonseyi.

2. Ulendo ungoyamba
Wakunka kwathuko;
Amati: ”Udzapeza
Zakusautsa ’mo."
Zobvuta ndi chisoni
Sindiziopa ’yi;
Ndidzangomtsata Yesu m’njira
Yonseyi.

3. Zoipa ndi zabwino
Zakundigwerazo,
Ndingonka nazo zonse
Ndimuze Yesuyo;
Zowawa adzachotsa
Zondiliritsazi;
Ndikangomtsata Yesu m’njira
Yonseyi.

4. Zondipingitsa zonse
Zolowa m’mtimamo
Achotsa, nandisunga
M’ulendo wonsewu.
Sindidzaopa kanthu,
Ngakhale imfayo,
Pomtsata Yesu yekha kunka
Kwathuko.

hymns.title: Mpulumutsi Yesu
hymns.text:
1. Mpulumutsi Yesu,
Mumve nyimbo yathu;
Tikuyamikani
Mumitima mwathu.
Zonse tili nazo;
Thupi, mzimu womwe,
Inde, moyo wonse,
Tipereka zonse.

Komwe ndi chimwemwe
Tidzaimba tonse,
Tidzatama Mbuye
Osalema konse.

2. Tiyandika, Mbuye,
M’fupifupi ndinu,
Tikugwadirani,
Mtilandire bwino.
Inu munatsika
Kutifera ife;
Inu munakwera
Kuti titsatire.

3. Haya! Tipitenso
M’njira yomwe ija
Ana a Mulungu
Onse adaponda.
Tizisiya zonse,
tiziyenda msanga,
Tisamachewuka
Mpaka tapambana.

4. Tero tidzakwera
Kwawo kwa Mulungu,
Tidzaziiwala
Zotibvuta ife.
Komwe ndi chimwemwe
Tidzaimba tonse,
Tidzatama Mbuye
Osalema konse.

hymns.title: Ine ndine mlendo
hymns.text:
1. Ine ndine mlendo
Wa Kumwambako;
Pansi pandikonda,
Koma mpoipa.

2. Kwathu nkopambana,
Nkosachimwako;
Zosautsa zonse
Sizikhalamo.

3. Koma azibvala
Mwana zoti mbuu!
Woachmwa konse
M’mtima mwakemu.

4. Yesu, mndiyeretse,
Mndimveretsedi;
Mzimu, mndiyendetse
M’njira yanuyi.

5. Ine ndine mlendo
Wa Kumwambako;
Kundiyandikira
Kwathu komweko.

hymns.title: M’manja a Yesu wanga
hymns.text:
1. M’manja a Yesu wanga
Ndilikugonamo,
Mommo aphimba ine
Nacho chikondicho.
Mvera! Mudzera m’Mwamba
Mawu a Yesu wanga;
"Mwana, ndidzakusunga
Pano pamtima panga."

M’manja Yesu wanga
Ndilikugonamo,
Mommo aphimba ine
Nacho chikondicho.

2. M’manja a Yesu wanga
Nkhawa zonsezo zi!
Momwe zoipa zanga
Sizindibvuta ’yi.
Mommo mulibe nsoni,
Mommo mokoma monse;
Sindiliranso msozi,
Ndikondwa m’mtima monse.

3. Mtima umabisala
M’manja mwa Yesumu;
Mbuye, musunge ine,
Munandifera ’ne.
Ndilinda mopirira
Mpaka wachoka mdima.
Ndikaonana naye
Yesu Ambuye wanga.

hymns.title: Yesu ndiye Bwenzi lathu
hymns.text:
1. Yesu ndiye Bwenzi lathu,
Kumwamba kuli kwawo;
Amakonda tonse,
Akulu ndi tiana;
Anzathu sapirira;
Amalekana nafe,
Komabe kutiyanja
Saleka Yesuyo.

2. Ana ake adzapuma
Kumwamba mokondwera,
Amene anamkonda
Natsaka Yeu yekha;
Sauko ndi zobvuta
Zotitopetsa kuno,
Sitiziona konse
Kumwamba kwathuko.

3. Tidzalandirabe komwe
Zobvala za mitima
Yoyera, ndi kubvula
Zakale za kuchimwa;
Chimwemwe ndi chikondi
Tidzangokhala nazo,
Za ndewu ndi chisoni
Sitizipeza ’yi.

4. Woyenera ndani kunka
Kukhala ndi Atate,
Kuimba nyimbo zake,
Za Mpulumutsi wathu?
Tidzanka ife tonse
Tamtsata pansi pano;
Tiyeni ana onse,
Yambani leroli.

hymns.title: Yesu adza kuwerenga
hymns.text:
1. Yesu adza kuwerenga
Ana ake abwino,
Ndi kubvala zachifumu
Zakuwalazo zake.

Ana ake angonga
Nyenyezi zam’mwamba,
Adzawala m’Ufumu
Wa Mbuye Yesu.

2. Yesu adza kukundika
Ana ake ankhosa,
Ndiye Mbusa wakufatsa
Namalezatu lere.

3. Kudzachera tsiku lijalo
Msangatu msanga,
Kudzawala m’mawa wake
Pompano ponse.
