hymns.title: Kwa Yesu ndi kwabwinoko
hymns.text:
1. Kwa Yesu ndi kwabwinoko,
Nkoti mbee! Nkoti mbee!
Kulibe zoipitsako,
Nkoti mbee! Nkoti mbee!
Kuimba amaimbako,
Ndi amithenga omweo
Akondwerera kokhako.
Nkoti mbee! Nkoti mbee!

2. Zochimwa sizilowako,
Mwayitu! Mwayitu!
Misozi m’maso mwawo ’yi,
Mwayitu! Mwayitu!
Chisomo chili m’mtimamo,
Aona nkhkope yakeyo
Ya Yesu adalitsawo.
Mwayitu! Mwayitu!

3. Oipa tili tonsefe;
Mwaziwo, mwaziwo,
Wa Yesu watigulatu;
Mwaziwo! Mwaziwo!
Tiyeretsedwa nawowo,
Mtendere wa Mbuyathuyo
Ukhala nafe komweko.
Mwaziwo! Mwaziwo!

hymns.title: Dziko lilipolo
hymns.text:
1. Dziko lilipolo
Lokondwatu,
Oyera ’khalamo,
Abvala mbuu!
Tamvani nyimboyo;
"Mfumu tiyamikeyo,
Mkwezeni Dzinalo,
Mwimbenibe."

2. Tiye kudzikolo,
Tiyeni ’nu;
Musakayikebe,
Muchedwatu.
Tikondwendwedi,
Tchimo ndi zoipa zii!
Mbuye timwona ndi
Kukondwabe.

3. Maso a m’dzikomo
Onse nga mbuu!
Mkono wa ’Tatewo
Ngwosungatu.
Tiye ku dzikolo,
Mgwira ’nu ufumuwo.
M’mwamba mwa dzuwamo
Tikhalebe.

hymns.title: Dzuwa liwala, m’tulotu
hymns.text:
1. Dzuwa liwala, m’tulotu
Landidzukitsamo;
’Tate chikondi chanucho
Chindidalitsapo.

2. Dzuwa la lero lonseli
Mundisungire ’ne;
Mchotse zoipa zangazi,
Nanu ndikhalebe.

3. M’mtima mwangamu mlowemo,
Mwini chifundocho,
Kuti ndikafananetu
Ndinu Mbuyangayo.

hymns.title: Yesu Mbusa, mutimvere
hymns.text:
1. Yesu Mbusa, mutimvere,
Dalitsani ifetu,
Ndi usiku mutisunge,
Tidzukenso bwinotu.

2. Lero lino mwatipatsa
Zonse tili nazotu,
Moyo womwe; miyamiko
Landireni Mbuye ’Nu.

3. Tchimo lathu lonse, Yesu,
Mukhululukire ’lo;
Mtitengere kwanu komwe
Kumpumulo wanuwo.

hymns.title: Tilikuimba nyimbo yomweyi
hymns.text:
1. Tilikuimba nyimbo yomweyi,
Yakuyamika Mbuye wathuyo;
Mtendere wake tiufunadi,
Titapemphera tinke kwathuko.

2. Titanka kwathu mkhale nafeko,
Tikufunani Yesu Mbuyathu;
Musunge ife nthawi zonsezo,
Mutiyeretse m’mtima mwathu mbuu!

3. Usiku uno mutisungedi,
Khalani m’fupi m’nyumba mwathumo;
Mamawanso mudzatidzutse nji!
Kuti tigwire ntchito zathuzo.

4. Mtitsogolere nthawi zonsezo;
Kuyenda tokha sitikhoza ’yi.
Ngati mukhala Mbuye m’fupimo,
Sitidzaopa kanthu kena ’yi.

hymns.title: Ambuye, mtidalitsetu
hymns.text:
1. Ambuye, mtidalitsetu,
Musunge Mawu m’mtimamu;
Muyatse moto wanuwo,
Chikuletu chikondicho.
Pokhala moyo imfanso,
Ambuye mtiwalirepo.

2. Lalowa dzuwa, kwada bii!
Mwapenya ntchito zathuzi;
Taletsa mwina tchimolo,
Mwinanso tangolakwapo.

3. Mufafanize m’bukumo
Zolakwa zathu zonsezo,
Ndi kutipatsa ifetu
Mtendere wanu m’katimu.

4. Chimwemwe chomwe mpatseko
Ndi kukondana ndinunso
Tifuna kufananadi
Ndi Yesu Bwenzi lathuli.

hymns.title: Tikutha kupemphera
hymns.text:
1. Tikutha kupemphera,
Tipita kwathu tonse;
Mtiperekeze, Mbuye,
Panjira zathu zonse;
Titamva Mawu anu,
Mawuwo ndi amoyo,
Alowe m’mtima mwathu,
Akhazikikemo.

2. Ambuye, Mzimu wanu
Atikumbutse tonse,
Atithandize lero
Kumvera Mawu onse.
Kumudzi mkhale nafe,
Musatisiye konse;
Machimo onse mletse,
Tiyere m’mtimamo.

hymns.title: Tiyamike Mlunguyo
hymns.text:
1. Tiyamike Mlunguyo,
Anthu ndi zinthu zonsezi
Ndi onse a Kumwambako
Mlungu amyamikiredi.

hymns.title: Mulungu akhale nawo
hymns.text:
1. Mulungu akhale nawo
ulemerero ndi dalitso,
Ndiye Atate, Mwana,
Mzimu Woyera, Mlungu mmodzi:

2. Tsopano, poyamba paja,
masiku onse alinkudza,
Mphamvu, ulemerero,
dalitso, chipambano.

hymns.title: Yehova, Mbusa wangadi
hymns.text:
1. Yehova, Mbusa wangadi,
Ndilibe kusowa;
Andigonetsa bwinoli
Mumsipu wokoma.

2. Ku madzi ake odikha
Anditsogolera;
Ndi moyo wanga wofoka
Aulimbikitsa.

3. Anditsogolera m’njira
Zakulungamazo;
Chifukwa changaay’, koma
Cha dzina lakelo.

4. Ndipyola kodi chikhwawa
Cha mthunzi wa imfa?
Ndilibe mantha ngati ’Nu
Mundiperekeza.

5. Chakudya changa chabwino
Mwandikonzera pha!
Pamaso pa adaniwo
Mudyetse mtimanga.

6. Mwadzoza mutu wanga ndi
Mafuta okoma,
Mwadzaza chikho changadi,
Inde, chisefuka.

7. Zokoma ndi zakuyanja
Zidzanditsatako;
Ndikhala m’nyumba ya Mlungu
Ku nthawi zonsezo.

hymns.title: Mulungu, anthu ’fe
hymns.text:
1. Mulungu, anthu ’fe
Mutidalitsetu;
Chisomo chiwalire ’fe
Cha nkhope yanuyo.

2. Potero onsewo
Okhala pansipa
Adzamva bwino msangatu
Za njira yanuyi.

3. Ayamikire ’Nu
Padziko ponsepa,
Mitundu yonse ipfu’le,
Mokondwereratu.

4. Pakuti Mfumuyo
Ndi Inu nokha ’Nu;
Mudzalangiza bwinotu
Mafuko onsewo.

5. Zipatso zakezi
Labala dzikolo;
Adzadalitsa ifetu
Mulungu wathuyu.

6. Adzadalitsa ’fe
Mulungu mwiniyo;
Padziko ponse anthuwo
Adzamuopatu.

hymns.title: Nonse okhala pansipa
hymns.text:
1. Nonse okhala pansipa,
Muyamike Mlunguyo;
Ndi nyimbo mtumikire ’Ye;
Mubwere mokondweratu.

2. Yehova ndiye Mlungudi,
Anatilenga yekhayo;
Amatidyetsa ake ’fe,
Ndi nkhosa zake ifetu.

3. Lowani m’nyumba mwakemu
Ndi nyimbo zokondweratu;
Mumyamikire Mlunguyo,
Mulemekeze Dzinali.

4. Pakuti Mbuye Mlunguyo
Wokoma mtima ndiyedi
Woona adzakhalabe
Kunthawi zonsetu.

hymns.title: Muli ndi ludzu, idzani
hymns.text:
1. Muli ndi ludzu, idzani
Kumadzi amoyo;
Imwani nonse kolere
Kuchitsime konko.

2. Munka kangati kulawa
Madzi onyengera?
Musataye mphamvu yanu,
Musataye chuma.

3. Imvani Yesu akuti:
"Chuma ndili nacho,
Landirani, yemwe amva
Akhale ndi moyo."

4. Funani Mlungu tsopano,
Akulindirani;
Iye ndiye wachifundo,
Akulandirani.

5. Ali wokhululukira;
Imvani ananu;
Mtima wake usiyana
Ndi mitima yathu.

6. Monga m’Mwamba mupambana
Zonse pansi pano;
Choncho maganizo ake
Apitira athu.

7. Anthu onse a padziko
Adzamvera Mlungu;
Adzakhala ndi chimwemwe,
Nadzamtama ndithu.

hymns.title: Tiyamike Mlunguyo
hymns.text:
1. Tiyamike Mlunguyo,
Tiyamike Mlunguyo,
Watidzera ndi mtendere
(Ndi mtendere.)

2. Anatuma Mtetezi,
Anatuma Mtetezi,
Ndiye Mfumu Yesu Kristu
(Yesu Kristu.)

3. Tinafunafunatu,
Tinafunafunatu,
Osapeza Mpulumutsi
(Mpulumutsi)

4. Tinafuna m’phirimo,
Tinafuna m’phirimo,
Koma osampeza mommo
(Osampeza)

5. Tinafena m’nyanjamo,
Tinafuna m’nyanjamo,
Koma osampeza mommo
(Osampeza)

6. Yesu ndiye Mtetezi,
Yesu ndiye Mtetezi,
Wina saoneka ayi
(Saoneka)

7. Dzina lake Yesuyo,
Dzina lake Yesuyo,
Lidzakhala nthawi zonse
(Nthawi zonse)

8. Tonse timyamiketu,
Tonse timyamiketu,
Mpulumutsi wamuyaya
(Wamuyaya)

hymns.title: Aitana
hymns.text:
1. Aitana,
Aitana dziko lonse,
Imvani,
Mukhaliranji chete? Aitana,
Aitana,
Aitana dziko lonse.

2. Mfumu iyi,
Mfumu iyi ya Kumwamba
Ndi Yesu,
Ndi Mpulumutsiyo wa anthu onse,
Anthu onse,
Anthu onse, tinke kwawo.

3. Aitana,
Aitana inu mayi,
Ndi Yesu,
Amene anakhetsa mwazi wake;
Mwazi wake,
Unagwera inu mayi.

4. Aitana,
Aitana inu ’tate,
Ndi Yesu,
Amene anakhetsa mwazi wake;
Mwazi wake,
Unagwera inu ’tate.

5. Yesu ati,
Yesu ati: " Muzisiye Zoipa
Zimene muzichita, muzisiye,
Muzisiye,
Muzisiye inu nonse."

6. Titi bwanji?
Titi bwanji ife anthu?
Ndi Yesu
Anatifera ife akuchimwa;
Akuchimwa,
Akuchimwa tinke kwawo.

hymns.title: ’ Tate ’Nu
hymns.text:
1. ’ Tate ’Nu,
’Tate ’Nu, mtione ’fe
Tadza kupemphera kwa Inu.

2. Imvani
Imvani Amfumu ’Nu
Mawu athu tinene lero.

3. Tipempha,
Tipempha mdalitsetu
mpingo wanu woyera uno.

4. Imvani,
Imvani akunjawo
Akulira opanda Yesu.

5. Ayenda,
Ayenda munjirazo
Zakupita kuchitayiko.

6. Ambiri,
Ambiri akufadi
Osadziwa za Krsitu Yesu.

7. Auke,
Auke akrsituwo,
Akhale antchito anu.

8. M’watame,
M’watame antchitowo
Alalike Uthenga wanu.

9. Ubwere,
Ubwere Ufumuwo,
Uoneke padziko ponse.

hymns.title: Perekani mtima wanu
hymns.text:
1. Perekani mtima wanu,
Yesu aitana nonsenu;
Osauka, amasiye,
Yesu anakuferani ’nu.

Perekani, perekani
Mtima wani nonsenu;
Yesu akulindirani,
Perekani mtimawo.

2. Tsugulani mtima wanu
Nonse, Yesu akalowemo;
Akuchimwa, Iye adzalowa
Nazo zakukomatu.

3. Mtembenuke mtima wanu,
Inu osamvera Mlunguyo;
Yesu aitana ife
tikamtsate m’njira yakeyo.

4. Perekani mtima wanu
Kwa Mbuyathu Mpulumutsiyo,
Ndiye wakudziwa kuchiritsa
Anthu akuchimwatu.

hymns.title: Yesu, Bwenzi la ochimwa
hymns.text:
1. Yesu, Bwenzi la ochimwa,
Yesu wondikondabe,
Ena samandikwanira,
Yesu salephera ’yi.
Aleluya Mpulumutsi!
Aleluya Bwenzilo!
Amakonda, amasunga;
Ndimufuna Yesuyo.

2. Yesu ndiye mphamvu yanga,
Andilimbikitsatu;
Poyesewa ndi adani andipambanitsadi.

3. Yesu atonthoza mtima
Ndikadera nkhawa ’ne
Pakukhala ndi chisono
Andisangalatsabe.

4. Yesu ndiye Mtsogoleri
Pakuyenda m’njiramo,
Ndipo ndikafuna kugwa
Andigwira dzanjalo.

5. Yesu ndimafuna Inu,
Mwapambana zonsezo;
Mlamulire mtima wanga,
Mndikhalitse wanutu.

hymns.title: Walira Yesu m’dziko linoli
hymns.text:
1. Walira Yesu m’dziko linoli,
Walira Yesu m’ntchito zakozi,
Walira Yesu pofanana ndi
Ambuyathu Yesu Kristu.

Tiwaliretu, tiwaliretu
Ambuye Yesu wotikonda ’fe,
Mlemekeze ’Ye tsiku lonseli,
Inde tiwalire Yesu.

2. Walira Yesu pazobvutazo,
Walira Yesu pakukondwanso,
Walira Yesu, imbani ’nu
Ambuyathu Yesu Kristu.

3. Walira Yesu wolimbitsayo,
Walira Yesu m’moyo monsemo,
Walira Yesu; tidzaonatu
Ambuyathu Yesu Kristu.

hymns.title: Zambiri zagona m’kholamo
hymns.text:
1. Zambiri zagona m’kholamo,
Zosungika bwino ’mo;
Koma imodzi inasokeradi,
Nitayika m’thengomo
Kutali kuphiri loopsalo,
Kutali ndi mbusa wakeyo.

2. Ambuye, muli nazo zambirizi,
Kodi sizifikirazi?
Koma Mbusa nanena, ’Yangayo
Yatayika naneyo;
Ngakhale njira njoopsadi,
Ndilinga kuphiri kuipezanso."

3. Koma zina sizinadziwa ayi,
Makwawa ’napyola ’ye,
ndi mdima woopsa wa usikuwo
Ambuye nailonda yake.
Anamva kulira kutaliko,
Naipeza yofoka, yakufayo.

4. Ambuye, wakuti ndi mwaziwo
Panjira ponsepo?
"Ndaukhetsa potsata iwetu,
Kukubweza ku kholalo,"
Ndi m’manja mwalaswa bwanjimo?
"Ndalaswa ndi minga pofuna iwe."

5. Ndi ponse paphiri ndi padambopo
Ndi makwawa, indetu,
Kunakwera kupfuula.
Kumwambako,
"Kondwani, ndaipeza yanga!"
Nd’angelo a Mlungu nabwezanso,
"Kondwani Ambuye ’napeza yawo.”

hymns.title: Muthire, Yesu, m’mtimanga
hymns.text:
1. Muthire, Yesu, m’mtimanga
Kukonda kwanuko;
Mwa Mlungu ndidzalimbika,
Ndisasokerenso,
Ndisasokerenso.

2. E, moto wanu woyera
Uyake mwa ine;
Utenthe zonse zoti bii,
Undiyeretsedi,
Undiyeretsedi.

3. Munagwa pa Atumwiwo;
Dzazani mwa ine;
Mzimu wamoto Woyera,
Ndipempha mudzetu,
Ndipempha mudzetu.

4. Ndikhazikike inetu,
Mumtima muli mwai;
Ndi Yesu ndikondanetu,
Si kanthu kena ’yi,
Si kanthu kena ’yi.

hymns.title: Atate Wamkulu ndi wamphamvu zonse

lines: Khalani ndi chifundo ndi ife lero.

hymns.text:
1. Atate Wamkulu ndi wamphamvu zonse,
Atate Wamkulu ndi wamphamvu zonse,
Khalani ndi chifundo ndi ife lero.

2. Ifetu kuchimwa, Mbuye,
Ifetu kuchimwa, Mbuye,
Mutume Mzimu wanu atiphunzitse.

3. Mwa Mzimu mulowe mumitima yathu,
Mwa Mzimu mulowe mumitima yathu,
Zoipa zathu zonse mtiululire.

4. Tafika kwa inu mutiunikire,
Tafika wa inu mutiunikire,
Chifuno chathu chonse taleka lero.

5. Tifuna kuchita chifuniro chanu,
Tifuna kuchita chifuniro chanu,
Chifuno cha Mulungu nchabwino chokha.

6. Atate, mupatse zomwe tapemphazi,
Atate, mupatse zomwe tapemphazi,
Tapempha m’Dzina lake la Mpulumutsi.

hymns.title: Ona Mwanawankhosayo
hymns.text:
1. Ona Mwanawankhosayo
Wakusenza zakuipa zathu zonse.
Mwanawankhosa

Watisenzera
Zakuipa zathu zonse.

2. Anasenza m’thupi mwake;
Pakukhomedwa pamtanda anali duu.

3. Ona pamtanda Yesuyo
Anabvutika chifukwa cha anthu ’fe.

4. Imva kulira kwa Yesu
Pamene anasiyidwa muimfayo.

5. M’mwazi wake tisambamo;
Zichotsedwa zakuipa zathu zonse.

(Ona Mwanawanakhosayo
Wakusenza zakuipa
Zathu zonse.)

hymns.title: Yesu anali khanda
hymns.text:
1. Yesu anali khanda
M’Betlehemumo;
Mngelo anasimba za
Kubadwa kwake.

Kubadwa kwa Yesu M’Betlehemumo;
Khandalo linagona
M’khola la ng’ombe.

2. Mngelo anatumidwa
Kuwasimbira
Abusa a nkhosa za
Kubadwa kwake.

3. Anapita nasiya
Nkhosa zawozo;
Anapita kumudzi
Kukamlambira.

4. "Tadodoma, abusa,
Kwachitikanji?
Mwazisiyira yani
Nkhosa zanuzo?"

5. "Posunga nkhosa ife
Kubusa kwathu
Mngelo anasimba za
Kubadwa kwake."

hymns.title: Atate, tifika pamaso panu

lines: Ndi maso athu awa nawo nganu,
Ndi manja athu awa nawo nganu,

hymns.text:
1. Atate, tifika pamaso panu;
Mukomane ndi ife, Mbuye wathu.

2. Mitima yathu iyi nayo njanu,
Muiyeretse zinthu zanu zokha.

3. Ndi maso athu awa nawo nganu,
Muwapenyetse zinthu zanu zokha.

4. Ndi manja athu awa nawo nganu,
Agwiretu ntchito yanu yokhayo.

5. Ndi miyendo yathu iyinso njanu,
Ithamange m’ntchito yanu yokhayo.

6. Ndi milomo yathu iyinso njanu,
Ilalike Mawu anu kwa onse.

7. Ndi makutu athu awanso nganu,
Muwamvetse Mawu anu okhawo.

8. Tidziperekadi konse kwa Inu
Tikakhale anthu anu okhawo.

hymns.title: Atate, ndipempha
hymns.text:
1. Atate, ndipempha
Tsopano mundimvere,
Ndipempha kuti mundithandize.

2. Ine ndili munthu
Wochimwa pansi pano,
Munditsuke Mbuye, ndiyeretu

3. Ndalema ndathodwa
Ndi zinthu zapadziko,
Zakhalatu goli londimanga.

4. Yesu Mfumu Inu
Mumandiuza kuti:
"Pemphera, ndipo udzalandira."

5. Ndipempha, Ambuye,
Mundidzaze n’chikondi,
Mtima wangawu ukukondeni.

hymns.title: Dziko lonse mlambire
hymns.text:
1. Dziko lonse mlambire
Yesu Mbuye wathuyi,
Muimbire ndi chimwemwe
Dzinalo.

2. Mbwere nonse muone
Zomwe achita Yesu;
Nzozizwitsa, nzodabwitsa
Ntchitozo.

3. Aweruza ndi mphamvu
Ku nthawi yamuyaya;
Diso lake lisamala
Am’dziko.

4. Mbwere mudzamve nonse
Zamphamvu za Yehova;
Mumwimbire, mumyamike
Yehova.

5. Tisonkhane tonsefe,
Timgwadire Ambuye;
Timlambire, timlambire
Yehova.

hymns.title: Mlungu akuyang’aniredi
Potuluka m’mudzimo
hymns.text:
1. Potuluka m’mudzimo
Yesu anasenza mtanda,
Pokwera ku Gologota
Kukampachikatu Mbuye.
Pilatoyo, mfumu yawo,
Inampereka kwa ’Yuda,
Kuti amapachiketu
Kufera zoipa zathu.

(Atate ’nu, amayi ’nu, nonsenu,
Onani Yesu wasenza mtanda;
Atate ’nu, amayi ’nu, nonsenu,
Onani Yesu wasenza mtanda.)

2. Zoopsya zopambana
Zinachitika pamtanda
Kuti mdima unadza,
Dzuwa linabisikanso.
Chinsalucho cha m’kachisi
Chinang’ambika pakati,
Myala inaswekanso,
Dziko linagwedezeka.

3. Pomwalira Mbuyeyo
Anapfuula kokweza
Naitana Atate
Kupereka mzimu wake;
"Mlungu wanga, Mlungu wanga,
Mwandisiy’ranjitu Ine,
Mundikweze m’Mwambamo,
Landirani mzimu wanga."

4. Ankhondowo poona
Zinachitika pamtanda,
Anabaya m’nthitimo,
Munatuluka magazi.
Paphirilo la Golgota
Anaferapo Mbuyeyo
Nasauka koopsya
Ndi zoipa zathu izi.

hymns.title: Tumphatumpha moyo wanga
hymns.text:
1. Tumphatumpha moyo wanga,
Sangalala ndi Mtetezi;
Kuwombola kwa Yehova
Kwatuluka m’dziko lako.

Mulungu wakwezekatu,
Mpulumutsi m’dziko lako,
Wakwezekatu Chitetezo
Wabvundikira iwedi,
Mzimu wanga ’we wafunda,
Lulutiratu moyo wanga.

2. Bvinabvina moyo wanga,
Lulutira mtima wanga;
Wa mawuwo a Yehova
Watuluka m’dziko lako.

3. Imbirira moyo wanga,
Mtendere wako wafika;
Mbendera ya Chitetezo
Waikwezetsa ndi Yesu.

4. Ukondwere moyo wanga,
Kuunika kuoneka,
Ndi mdimawo uthawatu;
Lulutira moyo wanga.

5. Usekere moyo wanga,
Ndi Yehova akufuna;
Wakwezatu mbenderayo
Ya Chitetezo, sekera.

hymns.title: Pakuona imfayo
hymns.text:
1. Pakuona imfayo
Chisonicho chikula,
Ndilira misozi.

Ndilira, ndilira,
Ndilira Mbuye Yesu wangadi.
Ndaimba ndi kulira ndi kusisima,
Ndimba ndi kulira ndi kusisima,
Ha! Ha! Aleluya!
Ha! Ha! Aleluya!
Mwasiyiranji Ambuye Yesu?

2. Ndinasiya amayi,
Ndinasiya atate,
Abale komweko.

3. Kazembe wanga m’matenda,
Ndili m’manja mwa Mbuye.
Abale tsalani.

4. Zoipa zakanikadi,
Sizikhoza kuchotseka,
Ndilira misozi.

5. Angelo aitana,
Aitana Kumwambako,
Tiyeni, tikwere!

6. Munafera pa mtanda
Chifukwa cha inedi,
Si cha wina ayi.

hymns.title: Lidze msanga dzuwa lanu
hymns.text:
1. Lidze msanga dzuwa lanu
Lolonjezedwa, Ambuye.
Mnalinena polawira
Kwa anyamata, Ambuye.

Kuli chimwemwe m’dzuwalo
Lakufika Ambuye,
Ha! Ambuye bwerani,
Ha! Ha! Ambuye bwerani.

2. M’dziko lino chimwemwecho
Chakudza ndi Yesu Mbuye.
Mfumu yathu ya Kumwamba
Ndi dziko lonse lapansi.

3. Adzakhala pampandopo
Wakuweruza makamu;
Amitundu adzaima
Pamoso pa Mbuye Yesu.

4. Adzanena kwa anthuwo
Akudzanjatu lamanja,
"Lowani ’nu m’chikondwero
Cha Atate nthawi zonse."

hymns.title: Amen, Amen, Amen
hymns.text: Amen, Amen, Amen.

hymns.title: Ndidze pafupi pa
hymns.text:
1. Ndidze pafupi pa
Mlungu wanga,
Ngakhale pamtanda
Mundikweza;
Koma ndiimbabe,
Mbuye mndikhalitse,
Mbuye mndikhalitse
M’fupi Ndinu.

2. Ngakhale kuthengo
Ndasokera,
M’mdima ndigonapa
E, pamwala;
Koma m’kulotako
Ndiyandikizanso
Ndiyandikizanso
M’fupi Ndinu.

3. Pajapo ndipenya
Pokwerapo,
Angelo atsika
Kumwambako,
Ndiwo akodola
Kuti ndikabwere,
Kuti ndikabwere,
M’fupi Ndinu.

4. Tsono poukanso
Wokondwatu,
Ndipeza pomwepo
Pali Mlungu;
Ndipo masautso
Andisendezanso,
Andisendezanso,
M’fupi Ndinu.

5. Pena pakufadi,
N’kweza m’Mwamba,
Dzuwa ndi nyenyezu
Zitsalira;
Pomwe ndiimbanso,
Ndidza pafupi pa,
Ndidza pafupi pa
Mlungu wanga.

hymns.title: Munasiyatu
hymns.text:
1. Munasiyatu
Dziko lanulo,
E, chifukwa cha ine;
Ndi ku Betlehemuko
Pakubadwa Inu,
Nyumba zawo ’nakukanani.

Mbuye Yesu, lowani m’mtima,
Nyumba yanu ndi mtimanga.
Mbuye Yesu lowani m’mtima,
Nyumba yanu ndi mtimanga.

2. Akumwambawo
Naimbitsatu
Kukulemekezani;
Koma monga mwana
M’dziko munabadwa,
Munadzichepetsadi.

3. Nyama za m’thengo
Ndi mbalamezo
Zili nazo zogonamo,
Koma Mwana wa Mlungu
Analibe nyumba,
M’mapululu nagonatu.

4. Munadzera ndi
Mawu a moyo
Akupulumutsa anthu;
Anakaniza,
Anasautsa,
Anapachika Inu.

5. M’mene mubwera
Kutiweruza
Ndi angelo aimbira,
Mundiitane,
Muti, "Idza ’we,
Khala nane Kumwamba."

Mtima wanga udzakondwera,
M’mene mundilandiranso.
Mtima wanga udzakondwera,
M’mene mundilandiranso.

hymns.title: Kasupe ali wodzaza
hymns.text:
1. Kasupe ali wodzaza
Ndi wazi wa Yesu;
Omwe asamba mwa uyu
Ataya zoipa.

Ataya zoipa,
Ataya zoipa;
Omwe asamba mwa uyu
Ataya zoipa.

2. Woba wakufa ’napenya
Kasupe, nakondwa,
Ndimo inenso mwa uyu
Ndisamba ndiyera.
Ndisamba ndiyera,

Ndisamba ndiuera;
Ndimo inenso mwa uyu
Ndisamba ndiyera.

3. Mwazi wa Yesu wokondwa
Ukhala wamphamvu
Kwa ana onse a Mlungu,
Uchita kwombola.

Uchita kwombola,
Uchita kwombola;
Kwa ana onse a Mlungu
Uchita kwombola.

4. M’mene ndapenya mwazi wa
Mabala anuwo,
Kukonda kwanu nditama
Kwa kutha kwa moyo.

Kwa kutha kwa moyo,
Kwa kutha kwa moyo;
Kukonda kwanu nditama
Kwa kutha kwa moyo.

5. Kumwamba ndikaimbanso
Zimphamvu za Mlungu,
Zopulumutsa onsewa
Omvana ndi Yesu.

Omvana ndi Yesu,
Omvana ndi Yesu;
Zopulumutsa onsewa
Omvana ndi Yesu.

hymns.title: Yesu and’itana
hymns.text:
1. Yesu and’itana,
Adzandiyeretsa
Ndi mwazi wake wokhetsa
Pa phiri Gologota.

Ndilikudzatu,
Ndidza kwa Inu;
Munditsuke m’mtimamo
Ndi mwazi wanuwo.

2. Ndafoka, ndaipa,
Mundilimbitsetu;
Mundiyeretse konseko,
Ndiyereyere mbuu.

3. Atero ndaniyo?
Ndi Yesu wabwino;
Apatsa mvani, mtendere,
Ndi mphamvu m’mtimamo.

4. Yesu akhazika
Zonse za m’katimo,
Nalonga Mzimu Woyera
Munafoipamo.

5. Nditama mwaziwo!
Nditama chifundo!
Nditama Yesu Ambuye,
Nditenga mphamvu ’ko.

hymns.title: Ndi misozi ndi chisoni

lines: E! kwa Inu, E! kwa Inu!

hymns.text:
1. Ndi misozi ndi chisoni
Ndiliratu kwa Inu Yesu,
Ndi chifundo chandigwira
ndilira kuti ndili wanu.

E! kwa Inu, E! kwa Inu!
Ndilira kuti ndili wanu.

2. Mbuye Yesu ndi Atate,
Mundiona ndili wosowa.
Ndimasowa Mzimu wanu
Kuyinga zonse za mumtima.

3. Mtenderewo wosanyenga
Ndilira ine m’mtima wanga,
Kundimvetsa chimwemwetu,
Ndilira ine m’mtima wanga.

4. Kalekale ndinathawa,
Ndinakana kumvera Inu;
Koma lero ndamva kuti
Muli Mwini wake wa moyo.

hymns.title: Malo alimo m’nyumba ya Yesu
hymns.text:
1. Malo alimo m’nyumba ya Yesu,
Ndi nyimbo zake zikuitana:

"Lowa, lowa
Tsopano lowatu."

2. Mdima ufika, dzuwa lalowa,
Nthunzi zilipo, wadza usiku.

3. Nyumba yodyera ilikudzaza;
Idza nulowe, Mkwati anena:

4. Chakudya ichi ndi cha iwenso,
Madzi amoyo umwe kolere.

5. Onse am’Mwamba ali mowemo,
ndimo angelo akuitana:

6. Mawu a Yesu ati: "Msangatu
Idza, wochedwa, lowa m’nyumbamo."

7. Msanga adzachitseka chitseko,
Adzakuuza: "Choka, chokatu."

Choka, choka,
Anena chokatu.

hymns.title: Pamtandapo, pamtanda
hymns.text:
1. Pamtandapo, pamtanda,
Yesu ’nafera;
Pamutupo chilemba,
Chisoni ine.
Analira, "Eloi, Mlungu wanga!
Lama sabakatani,
Mwandisiyiranji?"

2. Kumandako, kumanda
Yesu nauka;
Anaposa imfayo,
Watha zonsezi
Ndikondwera, Mbuyanga ’naukadi
Sekerani nonsenu,
Yesu ngwamoyo.

3. Pakukwera Kumwamba
Yesu anati,
"Musachoke m’mudzimu,
Pempheranitu;
Mzimu Wakuyeradi adzabwera,
Kuthangata nonsenu,
Kuti msafoke."

4. Uzanitu abale,
Onse alongo,
Ndi amitundu yonse
Adzakondwera,
Musaope ntchitoyo yokomadi,
Mphotho yake Kumwamba,
Moyo wosatha.

hymns.title: M’dziko lino tikhalamo
hymns.text:
1. M’dziko lino tikhalamo
Utibvuta moyo,
Koma dziko la mtendere
Lili kwa Mulungu.

2. Watitsogolera Mbuye,
Komwe kwa Atate,
Ndimo tidzatsata naye
Moyo wathu wonse.

3. Ndi tsopano tilindira
M’dziko lathu lino;
Ntchito atipatsa Mlungu,
Tizigwira bwino.

4. Ngati zakuipa zathu
Zikatisautsa,
Tithawire kwa Mbuyathu,
Atipulumutsa.

5. Timpemphere kutipatsa
Mtima watsopano,
Kutithandizira kunka
Paulendo uno.

hymns.title: Kuli dziko labwino m’Mwamba
hymns.text:
1. Kuli dziko labwino m’Mwamba
Lakuwala koposa dzuwa;
Yesu atikonzera malo
Pokhalira ife komweko.

Bwinoli tipita,
Tikumana mwa Dziko lija,
Bwinoli tipita,
Tikumana mwa Dziko lija.

2. Tidzimba komweko nyimbo
Za abwino omvera Yesu,
Sitidzamva chisoni ife,
Tidzakondwa masiku onse.

3. Tidzatama Atate wathu
Kuti Iye ’napatsa Yesu
Kuchotsera zochimwa zonse,
Ndi kutidalitsira ife.

hymns.title: Apita anzathu dzuwa lino
hymns.text:
1. Apita anzathu dzuwa lino
Kosaoneka,
Apita anzathu dzuwa lino,
Apita anzathu dzuwa lino
Kosaoneka.

A! Kumwamba
A! kuli a Yesu.

hymns.title: Ine ndili ndi manyazi
hymns.text:
1. Ine ndili ndi manyazi
Kuti kale lomwelo
Ndinanyoza kudza komwe
Kwa Mtetezi wanga Yesu,
Ndati sindimfuna ’yi.

2. Koma Iye wandipeza;
Ndamuona m’mtandamo,
Mwa kufera ine momwe;
Ndipo ndati m’mtima wanga:
Mbuye, ndikufunani.

3. Nsiku zonse kwanja kwake
Kunandithandizatu,
Kunandichiritsatu,
Ndipo ndati: Mpulumutsi Ndinu
Mbuye wangatu.

4. Sindifuna Mbuye wina,
Koma Yesu yekhayo;
Ine ndili munthu wake,
Iye anandigonjetsa
Ndi kukonda kwakeko.

hymns.title: Kondwani nonsenu
hymns.text:
1. Kondwani nonsenu,
Mpulumutsi anadza;
Onani kukhola,
Ndi mtanda ndi manda.

Mlemekeze, bukitsani,
Naferatu kale;
Kondwerani, mlemekeze
Akhaladi moyo.

2. Kondwani nonsenu,
Anakhetsa mwazi,
Natiwombola nawo,
Tikhale ana ’ke.

3. Kondwani nonsenu,
Atikhululukira,
Wosachimwa nafera
Anthu ’fe oipa.

4. Kondwani nonsenu,
Mfumu yathu yakwera;
Kwa Atate Kumwamba
Atipempherera.

5. Kondwani nonsenu,
Adzabweranso Yesu,
Waulemu, wamphamvu,
Kuweruza dziko.

hymns.title: Tate, ndili mwana wanu
hymns.text:
1. Tate, ndili mwana wanu,
Nkana ndinachimwa,
Ndingolirira kwa Inu;
Khululukireni.

Machimo anga ngambiri
Osawerengeka,
Ndingoyang’ana kwa Inu;
Khululukireni.

2. Ndinachimwa poganiza
Ndi polankhulanso,
M’ntchito zanga ndachimwanso;
Khululukireni.

3. Ndinachita mphulupulu,
Ndinakunyozani,
M’ntchito zanga ndalephera;
Khululukireni.

4. Zonse ndinakonda kale
Ndi zopanda pake,
Sindikhuta nazotu;
Khululukireni.

hymns.title: Mema nkhondoyo, wadza mdaniyo
hymns.text:
1. Mema nkhondoyo, wadza mdaniyo,
Kweza mbendera ya Mbuye.
Bvala zidazo, imba nyimboyo,
Khazikikatu pa Mulungu.

Haya, anzathu, itilinda nkhondo;
Limbikanitu, nkhondo nja Yesu.
Musafoke, m’thyole linga lawo;
Mbuye ndiye Wopambanayo.

2. Mlungu mverani, mphamvu patseni,
Tithandizeni, tipempha.
Nkhondo itatha, titapambana,
Tidzalandiratu korona.

3. Mleke mdaniyo, mwimbe m’njiramo
Mpaka nkhondoyo ileka.
Zida konzani,mantha tayani,
Pitikitsani adaniwo.

hymns.title: M’manda nagonamo
hymns.text:
1. M’manda nagonamo
Yesu Ambuye,
Anadikiratu
Tsiku lija.
M’manda naukamo

Napambana ’dani akewo;
Anauka kupambana imfayho,
ali moyo ndi oyera mtimawo.
Waukaka, wauka!
Aleluya, wauka!

2. M’manda munalibe
Yesu Ambuye,
Nadikira chabe
Alondawo.

3. Imfa yalephera
Kumutsekera,
Anachotsa zonse
Zomzingazo.

hymns.title: Yendani, Mfumu yamtendere
hymns.text:
1. Yendani, Mfumu yamtendere
Anthu akuimbirani;
Apfuuletu Hosana,
Agonjeranso athuwo.

Yendanitu m’ulemudi,
Pulumutsani anthuwo.

2. Yendani, Munthu Wachisoni,
M’mudzi wa Yerusalemu;
Angelo amapenya ’Nu
M’mene mwafera anthuwo.

3. Yendanitu, Wansembe wathu,
Mtanda wanu mwanyamula
Watisandukira dalo,
Watitengera moyowo.

4. Yendani mwaulemerero,
Akulindirani mphotho,
Moyo wanu wosatha
Watilonjezera moyo.

hymns.title: Kamwana Yesu ’nabadwa
hymns.text:
1. Kamwana Yesu ’nabadwa,
Ndi Iye Mlungu Wamphamvu;
Angelo anapembedza
Mwana wakhanda Iyeyu.

2. Kamwana kaja ’nayamba
Kuonetsera Atate,
Lero anena Kumwamba:
"Tiana tidze kwa Ine."

3. Tibwera ndi tianato
Kukabatiza ’menewa;
Muwachitire chifundo,
M’wapatse Mzimu Woyera.

4. Angelo anu asunga
Tiana tathu tofoka;
Pa njira yanu tiyenda,
Mulembe m’Mwamba maina.

5. Mukonda nyimbo za ana,
Kokoma amaimbatu;
Ndi ana athu atama
Atate, Mwana ndi Mzimu.

hymns.title: Yesu Mbuye, onani
hymns.text:
1. Yesu Mbuye, onani
Tadza poitana Inu;
M’dzina lanu tifika
Osekera kwa Atate;
Mkhale nafe Inu nokha
Tikaimba nkupemphera.

2. Mbuye, Mzimu Woyera
Munapatsa ana anu
Kukalonga mumtima
Mawu ndimo mvanu womwe;
Zinthu zonse pansi pano
Sizikondweretsa ife.

3. Mzimu, mlonge m’mtimamo
Maphunziro achifundo;
timve lero ndi mawa
Ndi masiku onse Yesu.
Ndimo m’Mwamba tidzaona
Tidazimva pansi pano.

hymns.title: Pemphero ndiko kufuna
hymns.text:
1. Pemphero ndiko kufuna,
Kulakalakatu;
Ndi monga moto liyaka
Mumtima wa munthu.

2. Pemphero ndiko kulira,
Ngakhale misozi,
Kupenyetsetsa Kumwamba,
Mulungu mpafupi.

3. Pemphero ndiko kufuna
Kwa mwana wamng’ono;
Ndiponso mawu amphamvu
A munthu wamvanu.

4. Pemphero ndiwo mweyawo
Apuma akhristu;
Ndi mapemphero tilowa
Dziko la imfalo.

5. Mutiphunzotse, Mbuyathu,
Kupempha kotero,
Kuyandikira kwa Mlungu
Ndi mtima wabwino.

hymns.title: Ndisauka, ndinachimwa
hymns.text:
1. Ndisauka, ndinachimwa,
Koma Inu mnandifera,
Ndimo ndamva mund’itana;
Mwana Mlungu, ndingubwera.

2. Ndisauka, ndimasowa
Mphamvu ya kuyera m’mtima,
Mwazi wanu wanditsuka;
Mwana Mlungu, ndingubwera.

3. Ndisauka, sindikhoza
Kuiletsa nkhondo m’mtima,
Ndi chisoni, mantha, nkhawa;
Mwana Mlungu, ndingubwera.

4. Ndisauka, sindiona;
Ndingudwala, ndilefuka,
Zonse ndizitaya kwa ’Nu,
Mwana Mlungu, ndingubwera.

5. Inde, Yesu, mulandira,
Muchiritsa, mpulumutsa,
Mawu anu ndibvomera,
Mwana Mlungu, ndingubwera.

6. Inde, Yesu, mundikonda,
Zonse zina ndazitaya;
Tsono kukakhala wanu,
Mwana, Mlungu, ndingubwera.

hymns.title: Yesu, ndipemphera
hymns.text:
1. Yesu, ndipemphera
Mndithangate
Kukonda Inutu,
E, kwambiri.
Koposa zonsezo
Za pansi panopo,
Ndikondane
Ndinu, Mbuye.

2. Kale ndinafuna
Za pansipa,
Tsopano ndilira
Inu nokha.
Ndifuna kukonda
Inu kopambana
Zinthu zonse
Za pansipa.

3. Inu ndidzatama
Nthawi zonse,
Imfa ikafika
Ndidzanena:
"Ndifuna kukonda
Inu, Mbuye wanga,
Kopambana
Zonse zanga."

hymns.title: Panalitu wakudwala
hymns.text:
1. Panalitu wakudwala
Amene anakhala
Pakhomo la sunagoge,
Kuti anthu ena
Amuone iye.

Yenda iwe, yenda,
Yenda iwe, yenda,
Silva ndilibe;
Mwa Yesuyo, yenda!

2. Kukondwa kwa wodwalayo
Kunali kopambana;
Iye anatumphatumpha,
Kuzungulira
Sunagoge yense.

3. Lero lino Mbuye Yesu
Aitana nonsenu;
Mukamvera ndi kumtsata,
Mudzakondwera
Ndi mdalitso wake.

hymns.title: Yesu watidzera, watidzera
hymns.text:
1. Yesu watidzera, watidzera,
Way’tana anthu onse,
Udzimvere wekha.

Aleluya, Aleluya!
Aleluya, Aleluya!
Udzimvere wekha.

2. Kudziwa ukudziwa,
Kulibe zachisoni,
Udzimvere wekha.

3. Atumwi atummika, atumika,
Akulalika Yesu.
Udzimvere wekha.

4. Yesu Mpulumutsi, Mpulumutsi
Wa dziko lili lonse.
Udzimvere wekha.

5. Kumva ulikumva, ulikumva,
Ungonyalanyaza.
Udzimvere wekha.

6. Bwerani inu nonse, inu nonse,
Mudzalandire moyo.
Mudzimvere nokha.

hymns.title: Mudze kwa Yesu, musachedwe
hymns.text:
1. Mudze kwa Yesu, musachedwe,
Kalata ilozera njira;
Amaitanatu tonsefe,
Bvomerani Iye.

Tidzakondweradi m’Mwambamo
Posonkana komwe kuli ’Ye;
Tidzakhala naye komweko
Ku Dziko losafa.

2. Lolani ana, mumve Mlungu,
Tsegulani mitima yanu,
Sankhani Iye, Bwenzi lanu;
Musachedwe, mudze.

3. Ganizansoni, ali pano,
Mthenga wake mverani lero;
Mawu okoma ati lero,
Musachedwe, mudze.

hymns.title: Mwa ine, moyo wanga ndi Yesu

lines: Mwa ine, moyo wanga ndi Yesu

hymns.text:
1. Mwa ine, moyo wanga ndi Yesu
(Yesu) Yemwe anafera ine,
Ndiye anandiwombola;
Yesu, Yesu.

2. Mwazi wake ndi chitsime changa,
(Yesu) Pamene ndikasambamo
Zochimwa zanga zidzatha;
Yesu, Yesu.

3. Yesu Mfumu, ine ndingadzafe
(Yesu) Ngati mundisiya ndekha,
Kukhala ndekha sinditha;
Yesu, Yesu.

4. Yesu Mfumu, ine ndisekere
(Yesu) Inu Mpulumutsi wanga
Pamene mukhala nane;
Yesu, Yesu.

hymns.title: Lekani kubvutika ndi zinthu za padziko

lines: Lekani kubvutika ndi zinthu za padziko,

hymns.text:
1. Lekani kubvutika ndi zinthu za padziko,
Musekere kuti tidzaimbira Yesu.

Imbira!
Timwimbire Yesu,
Mpulumutsi wathu!
Imbira!
Timwimbire Yesu,
Tonse tidzakondwera.

2. Musadziunjikire chuma cha padziko,
Dzimbiri ndi njenjete zimachiwononga.

3. Koma mudzisungire chuma cha Kumwamba
Kumene anapita Mtsogoleri wanu.

4. Aliponso adani am’kati ndi akunja;
Yesu watisekera, tidzakuimbitani.

5. Aliponso mabvuto, ena ndi oipa;
Yesu mutimasule kwa adani athu.

hymns.title: Ndine Mbusayo wabwino
hymns.text:
1. Ndine Mbusayo wabwino,
Ndinafera nkhosazo;
Yotayika ndaifuna,
Mpaka ndataya moyo.

Mbulu wanding’amba m’nthiti,
Wanding’ambanso m’manja,
Wanding’ambira zobvala,
Ndatsala waumphamw i.

2. Nkhosa zanga zimandimva
Ndikaziitanazo;
Ndimazipatsa moyowo,
Atate nazisunga.

3. Atate wondipatsazo,
Ali nazo mphamvutu
Kuzidyetsa, kuzisunga;
Palibe wolandazo.

4. Musaone zobvalazo,
M’kati ali fisiyo;
Musanyengedwa anthuni,
Ine ndine Mbusayo.

5. Tamverani anthu inu,
Ine ndine Mbusayo;
ndine Njira, ndine Khomo,
Thawani mimbuluyo.

hymns.title: Chiyembekezo changacho
hymns.text:
1. Chiyembekezo changacho
Chamangidwa pa mwaziwo;
Sindikhulupira pena,
Ndingotsamira pa Yesu.

Ndaima nji pa Kristuyo,
Ndiye Chinthathwe cholimba,
Maziko ena mpa mchenga.

2. Nkhope yake ’kabisika,
Ndipuma m’chisomo chake;
M’namondwe ndi mphepo zonse,
Nangula wanga ali nji!

3. Pangano lake m’mwaziwo
Lindisunga m’chigumula;
Zondizinga zikachoka,
Yesu ndiye Thathwe langa.

4. Likalira lipengalo,
Ndipezeke mwa Yesuyo
Wobvekedwa, wolungama,
Wopanda banga konseko.

hymns.title: Tiyamike Mbuye Yesu

lines: I MFA, imfa yoopsa ija ya pamtanda,
I MFA, imfa yoopsa ija yapamtanda.

hymns.text:
1. Tiyamike Mbuye Yesu
Yemwe anatifera
Imfa ija yoopsetsa
Kuwombola tonsefe.
I FE, tapulumukadi,
I FE, tapulumukadi,

I MFA, imfa yoopsa ija ya pamtanda,
I MFA, imfa yoopsa ija yapamtanda.

2. Panalibe mwa abale
Yemwe akadakhoza
Kupereka moyo wake
Kuwombola tonsefe.

3. Tikondwera ife tonse
Pakuona ntchitoyo
Anachita Mbuye Yesu
Kuwombola tonsefe.

hymns.title: Mzimu ndi mtsogoleri
hymns.text:
1. Mzimu ndi mtsogoleri
M’njira yachikristuyo,
Atitsogoleratu
Paulendo wathuwu.
M’yoyo ikondweratu
Pomva mawu akewo,
Pakunena Mzimuyo,
"Osokera, bwerani.”

2. Bwenzi lathu ndinutu,
Mkhale m’fupi nafetu;
Msatisiye tokha ’fe
Pakuyenda m’mdimamu;
pakuwomba mphepozo
Timaopa m’mtimamo,
Tsono timve mawuwo:
"Amantha ’nu, bwerani."

3. M’mene ntchito yathatu,
M’mene tidikira ’Nu,
pakukhumba m’Mwambamo,
Tsono tipempherabe.
Nthawi ya mabvutowo
Tikhulupirira ’Nu,
Tsono timve mawuwo,
"Okondedwa, bwerani.”

hymns.title: Maso ndi mason di Kristu
hymns.text:
1. Maso ndi mason di Kristu,
Kodi mndidzachitanji
M’mene ndidzaona Yesu,
Yemwe anandifera?

Ndidzamwona maso ndi maso
Kuseri kwa mitambo;
Posachedwa ndidzamwona
M’ulemerero wake!

2. Tsopano ndimwona Iye
Mwa chizimezimetu;
Tsiku lija ndidzaona
Ulemerero wake.

3. M’mene masautso onse,
Nthenda, infa zidzatha,
Dziko likadakonzedwa,
ndidakondwa koposa.

4. Lodala tsiku lomwelo
Ndidzamwona Yesuyo,
Mpulumutsi wanga yemwe
Anandikonda ine.

hymns.title: Mverani mbiri yozizwitsa
hymns.text:
1. Mverani mbiri yozizwitsa
Ya Yesuyo kalelo;
Iyeyo ’nandza pansi pano
Kutipulumutsa ’fe.

Ndani anatiwombola?
Mwana wa Mulungu pa mtanda,
Anatani?
Anafera.
Ali kuti?
Akhaladi m’Mwamba kutipempherera.

2. Palibe mmodzi akanatha
Kulowa m’malo mwake;
Ngakhale anali wamkulu
’Nasiyidwa namnyoza.

3. Kodi mudzampembedza Mbuye
Mpulumutsi wathuyo?
Kodi inu mudzalowamo
Mu Ufumu wakewo?

hymns.title: Ufuna kuwomboledwa kodi
hymns.text:
1. Ufuna kuwomboledwa kodi?
Ilipo mphamvu m’mwazi wake;
Ufuna kugonjetsa zoipa?
Muli mphamvu m’mwazi wake.

Muli mphamvu yodabwitsatu
M’mwazi wa Yesuyo.
Muli mphamvu yodabwitsatu
M’mwazi wa Mwana wankhosa.

2. Ufuna kuleka kunyadako?
Ilipo mphamvu m’mwazi wake;
Idzatu pa mtanda nutsukidwe,
Muli mphamvu m’mwazi wake.

3. Ufuna kuyera kopambana?
Ilipo mphamvu m’mwazi wake;
Zoipa zonse adzayeretsa,
Muli mphamvu m’mwazi wake.

4. Ufuna kugwira ntchito yake?
Ilipo mphamvu m’mwazi wake;
Ufuna kumuimbira Iye?
Muli mphamvu m’mwazi wake.

hymns.title: Mpulumutsi Wokondedwa
hymns.text:
1. Mpulumutsi Wokondedwa,
Mwandipulumitsa ine;
Ndine wanu, wanu nokha,
Wotsukidwa m’mwaziwo.

Aleluya, Aleluya,
Mwanawankhosa ndinutu;
Mwazi wanu wanditsuka,
Aleluya kwa Yesu.

2. Mtima wanga wabvutika,
Zaka zonse ndangochimwa;
Tsono sindikangalika,
ndingopuma mwa Yesu.

3. Mwandipatulira ine,
Kwa Inu ndidzipereka,
M’moyo, m’imfa mboni yanu
Ya chipulumutsocho.

4. Aleluya, mwandigula,
Ndipo mudzandisungabe;
Mwazi wanu ndi wamphamvu
Kuyeretsa konseko.

hymns.title: Mlendo ali pakhomo
hymns.text:
1. Mlendo ali pakhomo,
Mlowetseni (mlowetsenitu),
Wadza kalekalelo,
Mlowetseni (mlowetsenutu);
Mtsegulire msangatu,
Wakuyerayerayo,
Mwana wa Mulunguyo,
Mlowetseni (mlowetsenitu).

2. Utsegule mtimawo,
Mlowetseni (mlowetsenitu),
Ukachedwa achoka,
Mlowetseni (mlowetsenitu),
Ndiye Bwenzi lakolo,
’Dzakupulumutsa ’we;
’Dzakusamaliranso,
Mlowetseni (mlowetsenitu).

3. Imva mawu akewo,
Mlowetseni (mlowetsenitu),
Sankha Iye leroli,
Mlowetseni (mlowetsenitu),
Wangoima pa khomo,
’Dzakusangalatsa ’we,
Udzamlemekezatu,
Mlowetseni (mlowetsenitu).

4. Mlendo wa Kumwambayo
Mlowetseni (mlowetsenitu),
’Dzakupatsa zonsezo,
Mlowetseni (mlowetsenitu),
’Dzakhululukira ’we,
Ndipo potsirizapo
’Dzakutenga m’Mwambamo,
Mlowetseni (mlowetsenitu).

hymns.title: Ndipereka zanga zonse
hymns.text:
1. Ndipereka zanga zonse
Mwaufulu kwa Yesu;
Ndidzamkonda kopambana,
Tsiku lili lonsetu.

Ndiperekatu
Zonse kwa Yesu;
Ndipereka zonse kwa ’Nu,
Dalitseni.

2. Ndipereka zanga zonse
Pamapazi a Yesu;
Zapadziko ndazikana,
Nditengeni Yesu ’Nu.

3. Ndipereka zanga zonse,
Ndipo n’khale wanutu;
Mzimu wanu ’ndidziwitse
Kuti ndine wanudi.

4. Ndipereka zanga zonse,
Ndili wanu ndense ’ne;
Nditamanda Dzina lanu,
Aleluya, Ambuye.

hymns.title: Kwathu sipadziko, ndingopitirira
Chisomo chodabwitsacho
hymns.text:
1. Chisomo chodabwitsacho
Chapulumutsa ’ne,
Woipa wopambanatu;
Ndapeza moyo ’ne.

2. Chisomocho chachotsadi
Mantha a imfayo
Pakukhulupirira ’Ye,
Ambuye Yesuyo.

3. Chisomo chandisungadi
Panjira yangayo,
Chisomo chidzasunga ’ne
Mpakatu kwathuko.

4. Kwathu ndidzaimba nyimbo
Ya chisomo chake,
Yolemekeza Mlunguyo
Kunthawi zosatha.

hymns.title: Chitetezo chachikulu
hymns.text:
1. Chitetezo chachikulu
Chotuluka m’mwaziwo
Wa Ambuye Yesu Kristu
Mpulumutsi wathuyo.
Mpulumutsi, chitetezo
Chipezeka m’mwaziwo.

2. Ndi chimwemwe ndimaona
Mtsinjewo wa mphamvutu;
Zonditsutsa zachotsedwa,
Yesu wanditsuka mbuu!
Mpulumutsi, chitetezo
Chindisangalatsatu.

3. Tchimo lonse ligonjera
Chikondicho cha Yesu,
Maganizo ’yeretsedwa;
ndingofuna zakezo.
Mpulumutsi, chitetezo
Chagonjetsa mtimawu.

4. Ndili nawo moyo w’satha
Wochuluka mwa Yesu,
Mzimuyo wadzaza mtima
Ndi chimwemwe chakecho.
Mpulumutsi, chitetezo,
Chiyanjano chomwenso.

5. Mantha, nkhawa, ndi chisoni
Zochotsedwa zonsezo;
Mbuyeyo ndimkhulupira,
Anditsogoleratu.
Mpulumutsi, chitetezo
Ndimkonda Yesuyo.

hymns.title: Ambiri tikondwera mwa Yesu
Mbuye dalitsani Afrika
hymns.text:
1. Mbuye dalitsani Afrika,
Itukulidwa nyanga yake;
Mverani mapemphero athu,
Ndipo mtidalitse ife ana anu.

Mbwere Mzimu,
Mbwere Mzimu, mbwere!
Mbwere Mzimu,
Mbwere Mzimu, mbwere!
Mbwere Mzimu
Woyera, Woyera,
Mbuye, dalitsani
Ife ana anu.

2. Dalitsani mafumu athu,
Akumbukire Mlengi wawo;
Aope ndi kunjenjemera,
Ndipo m’wadalitse iwo ana anu.

3. Dalitsani mafuko onse,
Aweruze bwino maiko;
Adzichepetse ndi kuopa,
Ndipo mtidalitse tonse ana anu.

hymns.title: Mlungu dalitsani Malawi
hymns.text:
1. Mlungu dalitsani Malawi,
Mumsunge m’mtendere;
Gonjetsani adani onse,
Njala, nthenda, nsanje;
Luzitsani mitima yathu
Kuti tisaope,
Mdalitse Mtsogoleri, nafe,
Ndi Mayi Malawi.

2. Malawi dziko lokongola,
La chonde ndi ufulu,
Nyanja ndi mphepo ya m’mapiri,
Ndithudi tadala;
Zigwa, mapiri, nthaka, dzinthu,
Mphatso zaulere;
Nkhalango, madambo abwino,
Ngwokoma Malawi.

3. O! ufulu tigwirizane
Kukweza Malawi;
Ndi chikondi, khama kumvera,
Timutumikire;
Pa nkhondo nkana pa mtendere
Cholinga n’chimodzi,
Mayi, Bambo, tidzipereke
Pokweza Malawi.

hymns.title: Anthu m’maiko onse
hymns.text:
1. Anthu m’maiko onse
Akhala mitundu;
Kapena m’dziko lino
Akhala anzathu;
Agona mwa zoipa,
Apulukiradi,
Ati, Mutilangize
Abale, bwerani.

2. Ngakhale alemera
Ndi chuma cha dziko,
Kodi akakondwera
Opanda Mulungu?
Kodi akhala mwawi
Otsata zawozo?
Iyay’, awonongeka,
Apeza tsokalo.

3. Ndi ife akudziwa
Chikondi cha Mlungu,
Kodi tidzawamana
Kuwala kwa Ktistu?
Chipulumutso! Inde,
Tichibukitsetu,
Kuti mitundu yonse
Ibwere kwa Yesu.

4. Akhristu nyamulani
Maneno a Mulungu,
Ndi moyo lalikani
Pa dziko lonselo;
Ndi Yesu Mpulumutsi
Anatiferatu;
Adzabvomera onse:
Ndi Mwana wa Mlungu

hymns.title: Padziko pano tikhalira
hymns.text:
1. Padziko pano tikhalira
M’moyo wosauka;
Komatu kwa Mulungu kuli
Dziko lakudala;
mbuyathu Yesu wapitako,
Iye ’natsogola;
Tidzamtsatira ife tonse,
Tsiku lomaliza.

Tiyeni, tiyeni,
Ku dziko lakudala;
Tidzafikara m’dziko ilo
Tsiku lomaliza.

2. Masiku tikatsala ife
M’dziko mwathu momwe
Mulungu watipatsa ntchito,
Tikazigwiritse.
Pamene zakuipa zathu
Zisautsa ife,
Tikapemphera Mbuye wathu
Atipulumutse.

3. Ulendo wathu ukadzatha
Tidzafika kwathu,
Adzatifikitsa ife komwe
Yesu Mbuye wathu.
Sitidzapeza masautso
M’dziko la Mulungu,
Tidzakondwera chindwere
Nthawi zonse zathu.

hymns.title: Pozunzidwa inu ponseponsepo
hymns.text:
1. Pozunzidwa inu ponseponsepo
Ndi kufoka m’mtima nazo zonsezo,
Werengani madalitso anuwo
Ndimo mudzazizwa potsirizapo.
Werengani madalitsotu
Anakupatsani Mlungudi.
Werengani lina linanso,
Ndimo mudzazizwa
potsirizapo.

2. Kodi mubvutidwa naye katundu?
Ngwolemera mtanda muusenzatu?
Werengani madalitso anuwo,
Ndimo mudzimba dzuwa lonselo.

3. Poyang’ana ena ndi ndalamatu,
Ganizani kuti Mbuye wanudi
Adzakupatsani zake zonsezo,
Chosagula chuma chanu chonsecho.

hymns.title: Yesu Mbuyetu, mwafera
hymns.text:
1. Yesu Mbuyetu, mwafera
Mphulupulu zanga,
Ndimo ndamva mund’itana
Mutitu, Msachedwa.

2. Zonse za m’dziko zidzatha,
Koma za moyo m’Mwamba
Zomwe zidzakhalitsatu,
Chakatu ndi chaka.

3. Nyengo ifika, chenjera!
Adzakukana m’Mwamba.
Lapa zoipa zakozo,
Kuti ukalowe.

hymns.title: Tamandani Mbuye
hymns.text:
1. Tamandani Mbuye,
Inu atate,
Mpatse Yesu mitima yanu.

2. Tamandani Mbuye,
Inu mafumu,
Mpatse Yesu mitima yanu.

3. Tamandani mbuye,
Inu abale,
Mpatse Yesu mitima yanu.

4. Tamandani Mbuye,
Inu nonsetu,
Mpatse Yesu mitima yanu.

5. Tamandani Mbuye,
Mipingo yonse,
Aleluya, Aleluya!

hymns.title: Mvera mtima wanga ’we
hymns.text:
1. Mvera mtima wanga ’we
Akufunsa Ambuye:
"Wosauka wa’mphawi,
Kodi undikondadi?"

2. "Ndakupeza womanga,
Ndamasula zinsinga,
Ndakulonda kutali,
Kodi undikondadi?"

3. "Akaleka amake
Kusungira mwanake
Ine sin’kuleka ’yi,
Kodi undikondadi?”

4. "Ndakukonda ku imfa
ndi chikondi chosatha,
Kwaulere, kwambiri,
Kodi undikondadi?"

5. "Msanga ndidzabweratu,
Udzaona ulemu,
Udzakhala ndi Ine,
Kodi undikondadi?"

6. Mbuye ndisaukadi,
Chimachepa chikondi,
Mtima wanga mudziwa,
M’ndiphunzitse kukonda.

hymns.title: Mbuye mtsitsimutse
hymns.text:
1. Mbuye mtsitsimutse
Ntchito zonse zanu!
Utsani anthu akufa,
Ndi mawi a mphamvu.

2. Mbuye mtsitsimutse
Ntchito zonse zanu!
Tauzarani pa ife
Ndi mweya wa Mzimu.

3. Mbuye mtsitsimutse
ntchito m’mitimamo!
Mumvetse njala kwa Inu
Mutikhutitsenso.

4. Mbuye mtsitsimutse
Nchito m’kati mwa ’nthu!
Chikondi chawo chikule,
Muchikolezetu.

5. Mbuye mtsitsimutse!
Mawu alimbike,
Pamene aphunzitsidwa
Onsewa amvere!

6. Mbuye mtsitsimutse!
Mzimu adzazetu!
Kwa ife ’dzakhala mwayi,
Kwa Inu ulemu.

hymns.title: Chikhulupiriro chathu
hymns.text:
Chikhulupiriro chathu
Tatchulachi pakamwapo,
Mulungu athandize ’fe
Chikhale cha mumtimamo.
